É uma oportunidade única para você vivenciar o dinamismo de departamentos jurídicos, aperfeiçoar seus conhecimentos técnicos e habilidades comportamentais, experimentar diferentes culturas organizacionais e criar vínculos importantes para a sua carreira.

Seja um secondee!

Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Prestar assessoria jurídica às áreas de Manutenção, Operação, SSMA, Facilities, Suprimentos, Gestão de Contratos, Recursos Humanos, Segurança Patrimonial, Compliance e demais áreas envolvidas nas paradas de manutenção da companhia, sob gestão do responsável pela área.

  • Participar do planejamento jurídico das paradas de manutenção, contribuindo para a identificação antecipada dos riscos associados às contratações, à mobilização de terceiros e à execução dos serviços.

  • Elaborar, revisar e negociar contratos de prestação de serviços, fornecimento de materiais e equipamentos, locação, montagem, construção, manutenção industrial e demais instrumentos relacionados às paradas.

  • Revisar e negociar cláusulas relativas a escopo, preço, medição, reajuste, cronograma, garantias, seguros, responsabilidades, indenizações, penalidades, confidencialidade, propriedade intelectual, compliance, obrigações trabalhistas, segurança, meio ambiente, força maior, suspensão, rescisão e solução de controvérsias.

  • Apoiar juridicamente os processos de contratação emergencial, contratação direta, aditivos, alterações de escopo, prorrogações, claims, pleitos de reequilíbrio econômico-financeiro, divergências de medição, atrasos, aplicação de penalidades e encerramento antecipado dos contratos.

  • Avaliar juridicamente a operacionalização dos contratos, considerando não apenas o conteúdo dos instrumentos, mas também as condições práticas necessárias à execução segura e regular dos serviços.

  • Assessorar as áreas internas nos processos de mobilização e desmobilização de empresas contratadas e seus trabalhadores, incluindo análise de documentação, credenciamento, acesso às instalações, treinamentos, integração, jornada de trabalho, alojamento, transporte, alimentação e demais condições aplicáveis.

  • Orientar sobre riscos trabalhistas relacionados à terceirização, subcontratação, pessoalidade, subordinação direta, fiscalização de empregados terceirizados, jornada, horas extras, trabalho em turnos, saúde e segurança do trabalho e responsabilidade subsidiária ou solidária.

  • Apoiar a definição de mecanismos de controle e fiscalização do cumprimento, pelas contratadas, das obrigações trabalhistas, previdenciárias, fiscais, securitárias, ambientais e de saúde e segurança.

  • Avaliar juridicamente a contratação e atuação de subcontratadas, fornecedores críticos e empresas responsáveis por atividades de maior risco operacional.

  • Apoiar a análise e o tratamento de ocorrências contratuais, acidentes, incidentes, desvios de segurança, descumprimentos de procedimentos internos e demais situações verificadas durante a execução das paradas.

  • Orientar as áreas internas quanto à adequada formalização de notificações, registros, evidências, atas, comunicações contratuais, reservas de direitos e decisões tomadas durante a execução dos serviços.

  • Elaborar pareceres, memorandos, notificações, respostas contratuais, termos, aditivos, acordos e demais documentos necessários à prevenção ou resolução de conflitos.

  • Assegurar que as contratações e sua execução estejam em conformidade com a legislação aplicável, com as políticas internas, com o Código de Ética e Conduta e com as diretrizes de integridade e compliance da companhia.

  • Apoiar processos de auditoria interna e externa, investigações, fiscalizações e demandas de órgãos públicos relacionadas aos contratos e serviços das paradas de manutenção.

  • Elaborar relatórios executivos e indicadores jurídicos, comunicando de forma objetiva os principais riscos, contingências, decisões e medidas de mitigação.

Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Formação superior completa em Direito com OAB ativa e regular.

  • Experiência em departamento jurídico interno de empresas, preferencialmente dos setores industrial, óleo e gás, energia, petroquímico, infraestrutura, engenharia ou construção.

  • Experiência relevante na elaboração, revisão e negociação de contratos empresariais complexos, especialmente contratos de prestação de serviços, manutenção industrial, engenharia, construção, fornecimento e locação de equipamentos.

  • Conhecimento de Direito Contratual, Direito Empresarial, responsabilidade civil, gestão de riscos e prevenção de litígios.

  • Conhecimento aplicado de questões trabalhistas relacionadas à terceirização, mobilização de mão de obra, fiscalização de contratos e saúde e segurança do trabalho.

  • Experiência no atendimento direto a áreas internas e na interação com equipes técnicas, operacionais, corporativas e de suprimentos.

  • Disponibilidade para atuação no formato híbrido (3x por semana presencial), nas proximidades de Salvador, e para acompanhamento intensivo dos períodos de planejamento e execução das paradas de manutenção.

Job description

A Fundação José Silveira está em busca de um(a) Analista de Privacidade e Proteção de Dados para integrar a equipe responsável pelo desenvolvimento e pelo acompanhamento do Programa de Privacidade da Instituição.

A pessoa selecionada atuará em apoio à Encarregada de Dados, contribuindo para a atualização do inventário de dados pessoais e do ROPA, análises preliminares de riscos, elaboração e atualização de documentos, atendimento às solicitações de titulares, avaliação de fornecedores, registro de incidentes, realização de treinamentos e acompanhamento dos indicadores e planos de ação. Entre as atividades, também estará o contato com os setores envolvidos para solicitar atualizações, controlar responsáveis e prazos, documentar a evolução das medidas e consolidar as evidências de sua execução.

O(a) profissional fará parte de uma equipe que mantém interlocução constante com diversos setores da Instituição, especialmente no acompanhamento das atividades e medidas definidas nos planos de ação. Por isso, buscamos uma pessoa organizada, responsável, colaborativa, atenta aos detalhes e com facilidade para acompanhar atividades, documentar informações, controlar prazos e pendências e se comunicar com diferentes áreas e públicos

Main responsibilities

  • Apoiar a Encarregada de Dados na implementação, manutenção e atualização do Programa de Privacidade e Proteção de Dados;
  • Apoiar a manutenção e a atualização do inventário de dados pessoais e do Registro das Operações de Tratamento — ROPA, com base nas informações fornecidas e validadas pelas áreas responsáveis;
  • Levantar, organizar e registrar as informações necessárias à identificação das bases legais aplicáveis às operações de tratamento, submetendo-as à análise e à validação da Encarregada de Dados ou da área competente, conforme orientação da Encarregada de Dados;
  • Realizar análises preliminares de riscos à privacidade e apoiar a Encarregada de Dados na elaboração, revisão e atualização dos Relatórios de Impacto à Proteção de Dados Pessoais — RIPD;
  • Apoiar a elaboração e a revisão de políticas, procedimentos, avisos de privacidade, termos, formulários e cláusulas contratuais relacionados à proteção de dados, submetendo as respectivas minutas à validação da Encarregada de Dados e, quando necessário, as demais áreas competentes, conforme orientação da Encarregada de Dados;
  • Acompanhar os planos de ação decorrentes de mapeamentos, diagnósticos, avaliações de risco e auditorias, mediante o controle de responsáveis, prazos, status, pendências e evidências, solicitando atualizações aos setores envolvidos e consolidando as informações relativas à execução das medidas previstas;
  • Apoiar a Encarregada de Dados na realização de avaliações de privacidade e proteção de dados de fornecedores e prestadores de serviços;
  • Realizar a análise preliminar dos questionários, documentos e evidências apresentados por fornecedores e prestadores de serviços, encaminhando à Encarregada de Dados para análise e validação;
  • Apoiar o recebimento, o registro, a triagem e a análise preliminar das solicitações apresentadas pelos titulares de dados, submetendo-as à análise e à validação da Encarregada de Dados;
  • Solicitar informações às áreas responsáveis, conforme orientação da Encarregada de Dados, e organizar os subsídios necessários à elaboração das respostas aos titulares;
  • Apoiar a Encarregada de Dados e as áreas competentes na avaliação e no tratamento de incidentes de segurança que envolvam dados pessoais;
  • Registrar os incidentes de segurança envolvendo dados pessoais, organizar os respectivos documentos e evidências e acompanhar administrativamente a execução dos planos de contenção, correção e mitigação;
  • Apoiar a Encarregada de Dados na elaboração, organização e realização de treinamentos, campanhas e materiais de conscientização sobre privacidade e proteção de dados;
  • Prestar orientações operacionais aos colaboradores e às áreas internas quanto ao cumprimento das políticas, dos procedimentos e das boas práticas de privacidade previamente aprovados, encaminhando à Encarregada de Dados as questões que demandem interpretação técnica, avaliação de risco ou decisão institucional;
  • Acompanhar os indicadores do Programa de Privacidade e Proteção de Dados e apoiar a elaboração de relatórios gerenciais, produzindo relatórios periódicos e submetendo-os à avaliação da Encarregada de Dados;
  • Organizar, manter atualizados e preservar os registros, documentos e evidências relacionados às atividades de conformidade em privacidade e proteção de dados;
  • Apoiar a Encarregada de Dados na aplicação dos princípios da privacidade desde a concepção e por padrão, em projetos, processos, sistemas, produtos e serviços;
  • Acompanhar as atualizações legislativas, regulamentares e institucionais relacionadas à privacidade e à proteção de dados, consolidando as informações relevantes para análise da Encarregada de Dados;
  • Comunicar à Encarregada de Dados os riscos, atrasos, pendências, incidentes, não conformidades e demais situações que demandem avaliação técnica, definição de encaminhamento ou decisão institucional.

Requirements and skills

  • Ensino superior completo ou em andamento em Direito, Administração, Tecnologia da Informação, Segurança da Informação;
  • Conhecimento da Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados Pessoais — LGPD, de seus princípios e fundamentos e dos principais conceitos relacionados à privacidade, à proteção de dados, à segurança da informação e à governança;
  • Conhecimento dos principais instrumentos e processos de um Programa de Privacidade, incluindo inventário de dados pessoais, Registro das Operações de Tratamento — ROPA, bases legais, atendimento aos direitos dos titulares, avaliação de riscos, gestão de incidentes de segurança e Relatório de Impacto à Proteção de Dados Pessoais — RIPD;
  • Experiência anterior em atividades de privacidade e proteção de dados ou em áreas correlatas, como compliance, governança, gestão de riscos e segurança da informação;
  • Experiência com organização de documentos, acompanhamento de planos de ação, controle de prazos, atualização de indicadores e consolidação de informações;
  • Facilidade para utilizar sistemas de gestão de privacidade, riscos, processos e indicadores;
  • Boa comunicação oral e escrita, com capacidade para produzir registros, relatórios, procedimentos, apresentações e materiais de conscientização de forma clara e objetiva;
  • Organização, atenção aos detalhes, responsabilidade, discrição e compromisso com a confidencialidade das informações;
  • Capacidade de acompanhar simultaneamente diferentes atividades, controlar pendências e interagir com profissionais de diversas áreas;
  • Perfil colaborativo, proativo e orientado à solução de problemas, com disposição para aprender e contribuir para o desenvolvimento da cultura institucional de privacidade.

vagas.description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Applied Scientist – Computer Vision & Generative AI (LLM/VLM) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Senior Applied Scientist – Computer Vision & Generative AI (LLM/VLM)


Contract: PJ (Long-Term)

Location: Remote (100%)


Position Overview

A leading technology-driven organization is seeking a Senior Applied Scientist with deep expertise in Computer Vision, Vision Language Models (VLMs), Large Language Models (LLMs), and multimodal AI systems . This role will be responsible for designing, deploying, and optimizing advanced machine learning solutions that leverage image, text, and structured data to solve complex business challenges.

The ideal candidate combines strong research and applied machine learning experience with a proven track record of delivering scalable AI solutions in production environments. This position offers the opportunity to influence technical strategy, mentor team members, and contribute to the development of innovative AI-powered products.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, deploy, and optimize Computer Vision, VLM, and LLM solutions to address business needs.
  • Build and enhance multimodal AI models for product understanding, attribute extraction, classification, and authentication use cases.
  • Develop scalable Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines and AI-powered workflows utilizing structured and unstructured data sources.
  • Maintain clean, efficient, scalable, and production-ready code following industry best practices.
  • Analyze large-scale datasets to uncover actionable insights and support data-driven decision-making.
  • Apply state-of-the-art machine learning methodologies, frameworks, and architectures to create robust AI solutions.
  • Drive technical direction and own critical components of machine learning systems throughout their lifecycle.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Data Science, and Business stakeholders to deliver AI-powered applications.
  • Mentor junior team members and contribute to the growth of organizational expertise in Computer Vision and Generative AI.
  • Support innovation initiatives through research, publications, patents, open-source contributions, and industry engagement.


Required Qualifications

  • Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Statistics, or a related field, or equivalent industry experience.
  • 5+ years of professional experience in Machine Learning, Computer Vision, Artificial Intelligence, or Generative AI.
  • 3+ years of experience building, deploying, and managing machine learning and deep learning models in production at scale.
  • Strong expertise in Computer Vision, multimodal AI systems, transformers, CNNs, foundation models, and modern deep learning architectures.
  • Hands-on experience developing, fine-tuning, evaluating, and deploying LLM and/or VLM solutions.
  • Experience with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), vector databases, embeddings, semantic search, and prompt engineering.
  • Advanced Python programming skills and experience with machine learning libraries such as NumPy, Pandas, PyTorch, TensorFlow, Keras, and Scikit-Learn.
  • Strong data engineering and large-scale data processing experience.
  • Experience with experiment tracking, model evaluation, and automation platforms such as Weights & Biases, Ray Tune, Kubeflow, or similar tools.
  • Experience working with cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure.

Preferred Qualifications

  • PhD in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Statistics, Operations Research, or a related discipline.
  • Experience with multimodal foundation models and state-of-the-art Generative AI technologies.
  • Familiarity with LLM orchestration frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, DSPy, or similar platforms.
  • Experience designing and maintaining MLOps pipelines for machine learning and Generative AI applications.
  • Background applying AI and machine learning techniques to real-world business challenges within retail, e-commerce, recommendation systems, visual search, product catalog management, or authentication domains.
  • Experience fine-tuning open-source foundation models and evaluating model performance, safety, robustness, and hallucination mitigation strategies.
  • Publications, patents, conference presentations, or open-source contributions related to Computer Vision, Machine Learning, LLMs, VLMs, or Generative AI.


What Makes You Successful

  • Passion for solving complex business challenges through innovative AI and machine learning solutions.
  • Strong ownership mindset with the ability to drive initiatives from concept to production.
  • Ability to balance scientific rigor with practical business outcomes.
  • Excellent communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Results-oriented approach with a focus on delivering measurable business impact.
  • Commitment to building scalable, high-quality AI products and continuously improving model performance.

We are seeking a remote, full-time Senior Full Stack Software Engineer with 8+ years of software development experience. Candidates must have a strong background in React.js and experience with Golang, Node.js, or Java, with a strong desire to adopt Golang as the primary back-end technology.

In this role, you'll help build the core platform that enables power utilities to move from legacy systems to an AI-native future. Candidates must bring working proficiency with AI tools and APIs to ensure seamless integration of intelligent functionality into the client's products.

This role requires strong coding fundamentals, system design capability, and the mindset of a builder who thrives in a startup environment. You will work in small, agile teams reporting directly to the CTO, collaborating closely with AI engineers, security leaders, and product managers. Together, you will build and deliver AI-native services delivered at startup speed.

Our client is building an AI-centric operating system for utilities. It harnesses AI at the enterprise level to better orchestrate customer delight, facilitate power optimization, improve the health of the grid, and unlock flexibility at scale. Funded by a strategic industry partner and one of the founders at Groupon, the client is poised to transform how utilities run and how customers experience energy.


Responsibilities

  • Front-End Development : Build, implement, and maintain front-end applications
  • Back-End Architecture & Development : Design, implement, and maintain APIs, services, and distributed systems that form the backbone of the client's OS
  • AI Integration : Collaborate with AI engineers to integrate models, embeddings, and agent services into back-end systems. Operate AI APIs, ensuring outputs are production-ready and aligned with enterprise utility requirements.
  • System Modernization : Transform legacy workflows into modern, secure, scalable codebases using cloud-native best practices
  • Security & Compliance : Partner with security leaders to ensure all services adhere to stringent utility-sector regulations, implementing secure coding practices by default
  • Agile Delivery : Deliver features and improvements in cycles measured in weeks, balancing speed with reliability


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 8+ years of software engineering experience in SaaS or enterprise environments
  • Strong proficiency in Python, and either Golang, Node.js, or Java (non-Golang developers will learn and adopt Golang on the job)
  • Strong background in React
  • Demonstrated ability to deliver high-quality code in fast-moving teams
  • Basic proficiency with AI/ML tooling (e.g., calling APIs, integrating model outputs)
  • Solid understanding of databases (SQL and NoSQL), message queues, and distributed architectures
  • Cloud-native engineering experience (AWS, Azure, GCP)
  • Clear communicator, adaptable, eager to learn and grow AI capabilities over time
  • Strong sense of ownership and accountability in small teams


Desired Experience

  • University degree or relevant industry experience
  • Experience working on ERP systems or within the power utilities industry


Additional Information

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture, share knowledge, be inclusive, learn, and grow together. Embrace teamwork!
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

vagas.title: Product Designer (Estagiário/Trainee)
vagas.description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Product Designer (Estagiário/Trainee) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Procuram-se mentes criativas e estruturadas.


A AutoU e o que buscamos

  • A AutoU é uma empresa de IA em alto crescimento que desenvolve soluções digitais sob medida para grandes empresas.
  • Nossos clientes incluem Stellantis, Volkswagen, Nestlé, B3, Prudential, Petrobras, Johnson & Johnson e Embraer. Já geramos mais de R$60MM em ganhos e impactamos 150.000+ pessoas em 15+ países.
  • Crescemos aproximadamente 100% ao ano desde que fundamos a empresa, ganhamos por 2 anos consecutivos o Selo Dourado do CUBO Itaú e já fomos destaque em veículos como Exame e Globo.
  • Somos 45 pessoas hoje, com meta de dobrar de receita novamente em 2026.


Sobre a vaga

  • Buscamos um Product Designer com domínio profundo de Figma, paixão por produto digital e capacidade de transformar problemas complexos em interfaces simples, intuitivas e bonitas.
  • Você vai atuar na linha de frente da AutoU, tocando projetos do zero com nossos clientes enterprise, idealizando e construindo as soluções digitais que entregamos, ao mesmo tempo em que produz protótipos, apresentações e materiais visuais que sustentam tanto a entrega aos clientes quanto a expansão e a construção da marca AutoU.
  • Mais do que entregar telas, esperamos que você ajude a elevar o nível de design da empresa como um todo, evoluindo nosso design system e construindo padrões que vão escalar com o crescimento da AutoU.
  • Buscamos perfil de designer estruturado, com pensamento de produto, não apenas estético. Pessoas que entendem que design é resolver problema de usuário e gerar resultado de negócio, não só fazer interface bonita.


Seus principais desafios (dia a dia)

  • Prototipação no Figma. Construir wireframes, fluxos e protótipos navegáveis de alta fidelidade que traduzem desafios de negócio em produtos digitais reais.
  • Entendimento de produto. Mergulhar nos processos e nas dores dos usuários dos nossos clientes para projetar interfaces que resolvem problemas reais, com foco em usabilidade e adoção.
  • Fluxos e arquitetura de informação. Estruturar jornadas completas de usuário, fluxos de navegação e arquitetura de produtos digitais complexos do zero.
  • Apresentações e materiais comerciais. Construir apresentações de altíssima qualidade, materiais visuais e protótipos navegáveis que sustentam propostas comerciais, diagnósticos e showcases com diretores e C-levels.
  • Design system da AutoU. Evoluir e manter o nosso design system, criando padrões consistentes que escalam com o crescimento da empresa e dos nossos projetos.
  • Expansão e construção da marca. Apoiar diretamente a expansão da AutoU, produzindo materiais de proposta, identidade visual de projetos e ativos que fortalecem nossa presença com clientes enterprise.


O que oferecemos

  • Bolsa-auxílio competitiva. R$1.800 a R$3.600/mês de acordo com experiência prévia e portfólio, com feedbacks e promoções constantes conforme performance.
  • Cartão benefício CAJU. R$600/mês para apoiar nos dias presenciais.
  • Bônus. Premiação extra atrelada a metas e resultados da empresa.
  • Totalpass. Acesso a milhares de academias e estúdios em todo o Brasil.
  • Day off de aniversário.
  • 1 livro por mês. Investimos no seu desenvolvimento contínuo.
  • Plano de carreira estruturado, com efetivação ao término da faculdade e crescimento acelerado conforme performance.
  • Ambiente Cubo Itaú. Trabalhar dentro do maior hub de inovação da América Latina, com networking absurdo e acesso a eventos e fundadores das maiores startups do Brasil.
  • Modelo híbrido. 2x por semana presencial na nossa sede no Cubo Itaú, Vila Olímpia.
  • Mentoria direta. Trabalhar lado a lado com os founders da AutoU e nosso time de product designers experientes, aprendendo produto, IA e construção de negócios na prática.


Requisitos essenciais

  • Disponibilidade para ir 2x/semana à nossa sede na Vila Olímpia (SP Capital), além de eventos e visitas a clientes.
  • Cursando Design, Desenho Industrial, Comunicação, Publicidade, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas em universidades de excelência (FAAP, Mackenzie, Belas Artes, ESPM, USP, Insper, PUC, dentre outras).
  • Nos últimos 1 a 2 anos de graduação, com poucas aulas durante o horário comercial e ampla disponibilidade de tempo e dedicação ao trabalho.
  • Domínio real de Figma. Capacidade de prototipar fluxos completos, criar componentes reutilizáveis e trabalhar com design systems.


➕ Outros requisitos

  • Pensamento de produto. Entendimento real de UX, usabilidade, arquitetura de informação e jornada de usuário.
  • Portfólio sólido com projetos de produto digital, idealmente B2B ou SaaS. Apenas projetos artísticos ou de design gráfico puro não atendem o perfil que buscamos.
  • Capacidade comprovada de montar apresentações de altíssima qualidade e comunicar ideias com excelência.
  • Comunicação impecável, escrita e verbal, em português. Inglês fluente é diferencial forte.
  • Interesse e aptidão genuína por tecnologia, produto digital e Inteligência Artificial.
  • (Diferencial não obrigatório) Experiência prévia em startups, consultorias de produto, agências digitais ou projetos de tecnologia.


Requisito importante

É necessário residir no estado do Rio de Janeiro e ter disponibilidade para atuação presencial duas vezes por semana no Centro.

vagas.title: Marketing and Communications Coordinator
vagas.description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Marketing and Communications Coordinator em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Company Description Hjelle Consulting Group (HCG) is a specialized network of regulatory affairs, regulatory science, and product pipeline design experts serving the agricultural technology sector. Led by former Monsanto Regulatory Vice President Jerry Hjelle, the team includes experienced strategists, scientists, and government affairs professionals with deep expertise across plant and on-plant products, including gene-edited crops, biotech plants, agricultural chemistries, microbials, and biologicals. HCG aims to deliver top-tier regulatory expertise and execution that has traditionally been available only to large multinational companies, and at a more accessible cost. Through a “Regulatory on Demand” model, HCG helps clients scale strategic and execution support as needed, reducing the burden of building in-house regulatory teams. The company’s ongoing engagement with client product pipelines also provides investors with confidence in the quality, design, and capital efficiency of the regulatory work supporting those products.


Role Description Hjelle Consulting Group (HCG) is seeking an experienced Marketing & Communications Coordinator on a contract basis to support our growing thought leadership program in agricultural biotechnology regulation. This is a remote, operational role — you will own the execution of our content distribution, email marketing (Brevo), LinkedIn scheduling, and webinar coordination, working directly with senior regulatory scientists to extract and amplify their expertise to a global B2B audience. The ideal candidate has hands-on experience in agbiotech, agricultural inputs, or regulatory affairs marketing, writes and communicates with precision in English, and thrives in a lean, self-directed environment where building systems matters as much as executing them. Portuguese proficiency is a plus. If you have managed marketing operations for a technical B2B firm and understand what it means to communicate credibly to scientists, regulators, and investors — we want to hear from you.

vagas.title: Senior Solutions Architect
vagas.description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Solutions Architect em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Senior Solutions Architect


Compensation: $6,800–$7,800 USD/month (depending on experience)

Engagement Type: Full-Time Contractor

Duration: 6–7 months with potential extension into a long-term support phase

Allocation: 100% Dedicated Engagement

Location: Remote (Americas) with periodic travel throughout the Americas and occasional travel to Europe.


About the Opportunity


Our client is a premium international hospitality organization operating a portfolio of luxury properties across North America, Latin America, and Europe. As part of a major data modernization initiative, they are building a centralized data platform that will consolidate operational, financial, guest, marketing, and commercial data from dozens of business-critical systems into a modern Microsoft Fabric environment.


They are seeking a Senior Solutions Architect to serve as the primary delivery lead for a large-scale enterprise integration program. This individual will work directly with executive stakeholders, business leaders, technology vendors, and engineering teams to define integration strategies, align business requirements, and drive successful execution across a complex multi-system ecosystem.


This role combines solution architecture, stakeholder management, vendor coordination, and delivery leadership, making it ideal for someone who enjoys bridging business objectives with technical implementation.


What You'll Do


  • Lead requirements discovery workshops with stakeholders across Finance, Operations, Sales, Marketing, CRM, and Business Intelligence teams.
  • Translate business objectives into scalable data integration and architecture solutions.
  • Serve as the primary client-facing delivery lead alongside a Fractional vCTO.
  • Coordinate with third-party software vendors to obtain integration requirements, negotiate technical specifications, and resolve implementation blockers.
  • Establish and maintain data requirements for each source system throughout the engagement lifecycle.
  • Collaborate with downstream analytics and modeling partners to define data warehouse consumption requirements.
  • Drive project planning, status reporting, stakeholder communications, and executive updates.
  • Produce key discovery-phase deliverables, including source system assessments, integration recommendations, implementation roadmaps, and vendor evaluations.
  • Help shape architecture decisions for a modern enterprise data platform built on Microsoft Fabric and Azure technologies.


What We're Looking For


Required Qualifications


  • 8+ years of experience in Solutions Architecture, Data Architecture, or Enterprise Integration leadership roles.
  • Proven experience leading large-scale data integration initiatives involving numerous business systems and stakeholders.
  • Hands-on architecture experience with Microsoft Fabric, Azure data services, or comparable cloud data platforms.
  • Strong background facilitating requirements gathering with executive stakeholders and operational leaders.
  • Experience working directly with third-party SaaS vendors to define and negotiate integration approaches.
  • Deep understanding of data warehouse architecture, governance, data contracts, and scalable ingestion patterns.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Professional-level English proficiency.


Preferred Qualifications


  • Experience delivering technology solutions within hospitality, retail, multi-location, or franchise-based organizations.
  • Familiarity with hospitality technology ecosystems, property management systems, POS platforms, CRM solutions, HRIS platforms, or reservation systems.
  • Consulting experience with a systems integrator, Microsoft partner, advisory firm, or enterprise consulting organization.
  • Microsoft certifications such as Azure Solutions Architect, Fabric Analytics Engineer, or similar.
  • Spanish and/or Italian language skills are highly valued.


Technical Environment


The engagement leverages a modern Microsoft data stack, including:

  • Microsoft Fabric (Lakehouse, Warehouse, Data Factory, OneLake)
  • Azure ecosystem services
  • REST, SOAP, SFTP, and CDC integration patterns
  • Enterprise SaaS and hospitality platforms
  • Large-scale data ingestion and warehouse architectures


Team Structure


You will report directly to the engagement's Fractional vCTO and collaborate with a senior delivery team that includes Data Engineering, Backend/DevOps, and hospitality domain specialists. Together, the team is responsible for delivering a high-impact enterprise data platform that will support strategic decision-making across a global hospitality operation.


Why Join?


This is a unique opportunity to lead a highly visible enterprise transformation initiative for a sophisticated international organization. You'll work directly with senior leadership, influence architecture decisions, and help build a modern data foundation that will power business operations across multiple countries and brands.

vagas.title: Senior Solutions Architect
vagas.description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Solutions Architect em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Senior Solutions Architect


Compensation: $6,800–$7,800 USD/month (depending on experience)

Engagement Type: Full-Time Contractor

Duration: 6–7 months with potential extension into a long-term support phase

Allocation: 100% Dedicated Engagement

Location: Remote (Americas) with periodic travel throughout the Americas and occasional travel to Europe.


About the Opportunity


Our client is a premium international hospitality organization operating a portfolio of luxury properties across North America, Latin America, and Europe. As part of a major data modernization initiative, they are building a centralized data platform that will consolidate operational, financial, guest, marketing, and commercial data from dozens of business-critical systems into a modern Microsoft Fabric environment.


They are seeking a Senior Solutions Architect to serve as the primary delivery lead for a large-scale enterprise integration program. This individual will work directly with executive stakeholders, business leaders, technology vendors, and engineering teams to define integration strategies, align business requirements, and drive successful execution across a complex multi-system ecosystem.


This role combines solution architecture, stakeholder management, vendor coordination, and delivery leadership, making it ideal for someone who enjoys bridging business objectives with technical implementation.


What You'll Do


  • Lead requirements discovery workshops with stakeholders across Finance, Operations, Sales, Marketing, CRM, and Business Intelligence teams.
  • Translate business objectives into scalable data integration and architecture solutions.
  • Serve as the primary client-facing delivery lead alongside a Fractional vCTO.
  • Coordinate with third-party software vendors to obtain integration requirements, negotiate technical specifications, and resolve implementation blockers.
  • Establish and maintain data requirements for each source system throughout the engagement lifecycle.
  • Collaborate with downstream analytics and modeling partners to define data warehouse consumption requirements.
  • Drive project planning, status reporting, stakeholder communications, and executive updates.
  • Produce key discovery-phase deliverables, including source system assessments, integration recommendations, implementation roadmaps, and vendor evaluations.
  • Help shape architecture decisions for a modern enterprise data platform built on Microsoft Fabric and Azure technologies.


What We're Looking For


Required Qualifications


  • 8+ years of experience in Solutions Architecture, Data Architecture, or Enterprise Integration leadership roles.
  • Proven experience leading large-scale data integration initiatives involving numerous business systems and stakeholders.
  • Hands-on architecture experience with Microsoft Fabric, Azure data services, or comparable cloud data platforms.
  • Strong background facilitating requirements gathering with executive stakeholders and operational leaders.
  • Experience working directly with third-party SaaS vendors to define and negotiate integration approaches.
  • Deep understanding of data warehouse architecture, governance, data contracts, and scalable ingestion patterns.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Professional-level English proficiency.


Preferred Qualifications


  • Experience delivering technology solutions within hospitality, retail, multi-location, or franchise-based organizations.
  • Familiarity with hospitality technology ecosystems, property management systems, POS platforms, CRM solutions, HRIS platforms, or reservation systems.
  • Consulting experience with a systems integrator, Microsoft partner, advisory firm, or enterprise consulting organization.
  • Microsoft certifications such as Azure Solutions Architect, Fabric Analytics Engineer, or similar.
  • Spanish and/or Italian language skills are highly valued.


Technical Environment


The engagement leverages a modern Microsoft data stack, including:

  • Microsoft Fabric (Lakehouse, Warehouse, Data Factory, OneLake)
  • Azure ecosystem services
  • REST, SOAP, SFTP, and CDC integration patterns
  • Enterprise SaaS and hospitality platforms
  • Large-scale data ingestion and warehouse architectures


Team Structure


You will report directly to the engagement's Fractional vCTO and collaborate with a senior delivery team that includes Data Engineering, Backend/DevOps, and hospitality domain specialists. Together, the team is responsible for delivering a high-impact enterprise data platform that will support strategic decision-making across a global hospitality operation.


Why Join?


This is a unique opportunity to lead a highly visible enterprise transformation initiative for a sophisticated international organization. You'll work directly with senior leadership, influence architecture decisions, and help build a modern data foundation that will power business operations across multiple countries and brands.

vagas.title: Remote Mathematics Expert
vagas.description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Remote Mathematics Expert em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Role Overview:

We are seeking highly skilled and motivated mathematicians with a strong understanding of intermediate to advanced mathematical concepts and the ability to apply these concepts creatively to complex problems. This role is ideal for individuals who thrive in tackling challenging questions and have a passion for deep mathematical reasoning and problem-solving. We are hiring both individuals who are strong in undergraduate level mathematics and as well as those who are strong in masters/PhD level mathematics. Turing works with most of the leading LLM companies in the world today and your work will enable today’s leading LLMs to attain advanced mathematics proficiency.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop and implement advanced mathematical models and computational techniques to address complex problems across diverse mathematical domains.
  • Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams on research initiatives, providing mathematical expertise and analytical insights.
  • Review and engage with the latest mathematical literature, including cutting-edge research papers and emerging methodologies.
  • Apply quantitative and computational approaches to analyze data, optimize models, and support innovative problem-solving strategies.
  • Contribute to the advancement of research projects through rigorous mathematical reasoning and technical proficiency.


Desired Skills and Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s, Master’s, or PhD degree in Mathematics or a closely related field, with strong expertise in one or more of the following areas: computable functions and mathematical logic, algebra and number theory, linear algebra and matrix theory, topology and geometry, real analysis, probability, and statistics.
  • Proven ability to solve complex mathematical problems, demonstrated through research experience, publications, academic achievements, or project work.
  • Knowledge of Python and data analysis tools is preferred, though not mandatory.
  • Excellent analytical and critical thinking skills, with strong attention to detail and problem-solving capabilities.
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain complex mathematical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Collaborative mindset with experience working in multidisciplinary teams on research-driven or project-based initiatives.


More details on required skills:

Candidates should demonstrate strong expertise in at least 4 of the following 7 domains, with broader coverage considered a significant advantage:

Computable Functions and Mathematical Logic

  • Strong understanding of the theory of computation, computable functions, decision problems, and strategies for inferring functions from input-output relationships.

Algebra and Number Theory

  • Deep knowledge of algebraic structures, quadratic forms, signatures, prime numbers, Eisenstein series, and related concepts in number theory and their applications.

Linear Algebra and Matrix Theory

  • Proficiency in linear spaces, basis transformations, symmetric matrices, matrix equations, matrix diagonalization, and rank-related conditions.

Topology and Geometry

  • Understanding of vector bundles, cohomology, fundamental groups, commensurability, topological spaces, vector fields, and geometric proof techniques.

Analysis

  • Strong foundation in real analysis, including properties of functions almost everywhere, convergence concepts, continuity, and advanced analytical reasoning.

Probability and Statistics

  • Ability to apply probability theory to evaluate outcomes under varying conditions, along with experience using statistical techniques such as ANOVA for experimental and data analysis.

Applied Mathematics

  • Capability to apply mathematical reasoning and problem-solving techniques to practical scenarios, including logic-based and analytical challenges.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required: at least 4 hours per day and up to 40 hours per week with 4 hours of overlap with PST.
  • Engagement type: Contractor


Evaluation Process:

  • Shortlisted candidates will be sent a Job Interest Form.
  • After the profile review, an assessment will be shared, which must be completed within 24 hours.
  • Based on the assessment outcomes, shortlisted candidates will be contacted to schedule an interview.


After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.


Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

  • Capability to apply mathematical reasoning and problem-solving techniques to practical scenarios, including logic-based and analytical challenges.

vagas.title: Product Owner
vagas.description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Product Owner em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Company Description

Metrobi is a fulfillment platform designed to support local businesses, particularly in industries like food and beverage. The company simplifies delivery management by connecting businesses with local contractor drivers and optimizing in-house delivery operations. Through its logistics, financial, and marketing tools, Metrobi empowers local businesses to confidently grow their distribution networks. Metrobi operates with a mission to enhance efficiency and scale for local makers and distributors.


Intro video:


Responsibilities

  • Backlog & Kanban Management:

Own the Kanban board: organize tasks, ensure priorities are clear and understand what is stopping us from maintaining our task flow to hit our deployment goals. Communicate risks, issues, blockers, and quality concerns to the PM and relevant team members.

  • Task Definition & Refinement:

Review and write descriptions for tasks about new features, improvements and bug fixes. Ensure problems are well explained and solutions are testable and aligned with product goals. Collaborate with the Product Manager to translate strategy into actionable tasks.

  • Validate Outcomes, Not Just Output:

After new features or fixes go live, verify whether they truly solved the original problem and improved the targeted user or business metrics.


Qualifications

  • Strong skills in Product Management and Business Analysis to define and evaluate product requirements effectively.
  • Excellent Communication skills for collaborating with cross-functional teams and stakeholders.
  • Familiarity with Software Development processes and tools to coordinate effectively with technical teams.
  • Ability to adapt in a dynamic, fast-paced working environment and manage multiple priorities.
  • Prior experience in a similar role is preferred.
  • Skills like SQL, Git, reading Python code and doing data analysis are very beneficial, but not required


Notes

  • This is a full-time remote position.
  • Hiring interviews are online.

vagas.title: Subject Matter Expert - Finance
vagas.description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Subject Matter Expert - Finance em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L


Role Overview:

We’re hiring finance professionals who know AP, AR, accounting close, or finance systems inside-out — and want to help shape how AI understands finance workflows.

In this role, you’ll use your real-world experience with QuickBooks, Bill.com, and Concur to create realistic finance scenarios, evaluate AI outputs, and improve the accuracy of next-generation AI systems.


What does day-to-day life look like?

  • Create finance workflow prompts and real-world accounting scenarios
  • Review and evaluate AI-generated responses for accuracy and reasoning
  • Build synthetic invoices, bills, reconciliations, and GL datasets
  • Identify edge cases such as duplicate bills, sync failures, policy violations, and GAAP errors
  • Help improve AI performance across finance operations and controls


We're looking for:

Professionals with hands-on experience in one or more of the following:

  • Accounts Payable
  • Accounts Receivable
  • Accounting & Month-End Close
  • Controller / Finance Management
  • Finance Systems Administration


Requirements:

  • 4–12 years of finance/accounting experience
  • Strong working knowledge of QuickBooks, Bill.com, and/or Concur
  • Understanding of US GAAP and finance controls
  • Excellent written communication skills
  • Comfortable using AI tools like ChatGPT or Claude
  • CPA/CMA preferred (required for Controller-level roles)


Nice to have:

  • Experience with AI evaluation, RLHF, or LLM projects
  • ERP migrations, multi-entity or multi-currency exposure
  • Basic Python or SQL skills


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Work at the intersection of Finance + AI
  • Influence how AI systems reason about accounting workflows


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required: 40 hours per week with overlap of 4 hours with PST.
  • Engagement Type: Contractor assignment (no medical/paid leave)
  • Duration of contract : 4 weeks; (expected start date is next week)

vagas.title: Remote Physics Expert
vagas.description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Remote Physics Expert em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L.


Role Overview:

  • Design and solve challenging Physics problems to evaluate and identify the limitations of large language models.
  • Develop clear, high-quality, step-by-step solutions with precise and well-articulated reasoning.
  • Collaborate closely with LLM researchers to align problem design with evaluation objectives, particularly in areas where models typically struggle, such as abstraction, multi-step reasoning, and symbolic manipulation.
  • Contribute to the development of new evaluation benchmarks based on Physics curricula ranging from early undergraduate concepts to advanced PhD-level topics.
  • Analyze model outputs, identify reasoning gaps, and provide insights to improve model accuracy and performance.
  • Support the advancement of AI research by combining domain expertise in Physics with analytical and problem-solving methodologies.


Requirements :

  • Analytical Skills: Strong research and analytical abilities, with the capability to evaluate complex information and identify meaningful insights.
  • Feedback Skills: Ability to provide constructive feedback, detailed annotations, and clear evaluations to support continuous improvement.
  • Creative Thinking: Strong creative and lateral thinking skills, with the ability to approach problems from multiple perspectives and develop innovative solutions.
  • Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively in a remote and cross-functional environment.
  • Independence: Self-motivated, proactive, and capable of working independently while managing tasks and deadlines efficiently in a remote setting.
  • Technical Setup: Access to a reliable desktop or laptop and a stable high-speed internet connection to support remote collaboration and project work.


Preferred Qualification:

  • Candidates who have completed a Master’s, Ph.D., or Postdoctoral degree in Physics, Applied Physics, or a closely related field are eligible and strongly encouraged to apply.
  • Strong ability to analyze and solve complex Physics problems using a structured, logical, and methodical approach.
  • Ability to explain Physics concepts clearly and effectively through simplified explanations, visual representations, and strong conceptual reasoning.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required: at least 4 hours per day and up to 40 hours per week with 4 hours of overlap with PST.
  • Engagement type: Contractor


Evaluation Process:

  • Shortlisted candidates will be sent a Job Interest Form.
  • After the profile review, an assessment will be shared, which must be completed within 24 hours.
  • Based on the assessment outcomes, shortlisted candidates will be contacted to schedule an interview.


After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.


Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

vagas.description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Subject Matter Expert - Banking em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Turing

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L


Role Overview

We’re hiring banking and fintech professionals with hands-on experience across Chase, PayPal, Venmo, and Mint to evaluate AI systems handling payments, disputes, fraud, and personal finance scenarios.


What does day-to-day life look like?

  • Create banking and payments workflow prompts
  • Build synthetic transaction, dispute, and reconciliation scenarios
  • Evaluate AI responses for accuracy and compliance
  • Identify issues like failed transfers, fraud false positives, and sync failures


Requirements

  • 4–9+ years in banking, fintech, fraud ops, merchant payments, or personal finance
  • Experience with Chase, PayPal, Venmo, Mint, or related platforms
  • Understanding of consumer banking regulations (Reg E, Reg Z, AML/KYC)
  • Strong analytical and written communication skills
  • Comfort using AI tools like ChatGPT or Claude


Nice to have

  • Experience with Stripe, Square, Cash App, Plaid, or Robinhood
  • AI evaluation or RLHF experience
  • Knowledge of fintech integrations and data aggregation


Perks of Freelancing With Turing

  • Work in a fully remote environment.


Offer Details

  • Commitments Required: 40 hours per week with overlap of 4 hours with PST.
  • Engagement Type: Contractor assignment (no medical/paid leave)
  • Duration of contract : 4 weeks; (expected start date is next week)

vagas.title: Analista de Suporte e Integrações MFT / SWIFT
vagas.description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Analista de Suporte e Integrações MFT / SWIFT em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?


Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade .

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


O que estamos buscando

Um(a) profissional com perfil técnico, analítico e colaborativo para atuar no desenvolvimento, suporte e monitoramento de integrações utilizando MOVEit e SWIFT, em um ambiente dinâmico e global.


Principais Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver e manter integrações utilizando MOVEit e SWIFT.
  • Atuar no suporte e troubleshooting de integrações em produção, tanto on-premises quanto em cloud.
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com parceiros externos e áreas internas para implementação de integrações conforme necessidade dos clientes.
  • Monitorar transações via SWIFT Alliance Cloud e dashboards do MOVEit Automation.
  • Resolver incidentes rapidamente em parceria com back office, instituições bancárias e parceiros externos.
  • Realizar melhorias contínuas e mudanças na plataforma.
  • Criar e manter scripts e ferramentas de apoio às operações da equipe.
  • Promover documentação técnica e transferência de conhecimento entre os membros do time.


Requisitos Técnicos Obrigatórios

  • Conhecimento em topologias de rede e protocolos/serviços como:
  • DNS
  • HTTPS/API
  • SSH
  • FTPS/SFTP
  • SMTP
  • Experiência básica com administração de Windows Server e PowerShell.
  • Conhecimento em APIs (consumo e gerenciamento).
  • Conhecimento em Azure Administration, incluindo configuração de objetos, políticas e controles de segurança.
  • Conhecimento em autenticação OAuth2 e mecanismos de integração e acesso.
  • Boa lógica de programação.
  • Experiência com suporte e monitoramento de aplicações.
  • Forte capacidade analítica e resolução de problemas.


Idioma

  • Inglês avançado/fluente (leitura, escrita e conversação obrigatórios).


Diferenciais

  • Experiência prévia com MOVEit, SWIFT ou integrações financeiras.
  • Vivência em ambientes corporativos críticos e de alta disponibilidade.

vagas.title: Subject Matter Expert - Recruitment
vagas.description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Subject Matter Expert - Recruitment em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Turing

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L


Role Overview

We’re hiring recruiters and HR professionals who deeply understand hiring workflows across Greenhouse, LinkedIn Recruiter, and Workday. You’ll help build and evaluate AI systems that support sourcing, recruiting operations, and HR workflows.


What does day-to-day life look like?

  • Create realistic hiring and recruiting workflow scenarios
  • Evaluate AI-generated sourcing, screening, and recruiting outputs
  • Build synthetic candidate profiles, job reqs, and scorecards
  • Identify edge cases like duplicate applications, offer approval failures, and ATS/HRIS sync issues


Requirements

  • 4–10 years in recruiting, sourcing, HRBP, TA Ops, or HR Operations

vagas.title: Remote Mathematics Specialist
vagas.description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Remote Mathematics Specialist em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L


Role Overview:

The Mathematical Systems & Abstract Reasoning Engineer is responsible for developing advanced reasoning datasets that evaluate and improve the capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs). This role involves designing novel mathematical systems, defining custom rules and axioms, and creating rigorous reasoning challenges that require models to interpret definitions, perform symbolic computations, derive properties, and construct logically sound proofs. The ideal candidate combines deep expertise in abstract mathematics with exceptional analytical and communication skills to produce self-contained, verifiable, and high-quality evaluation tasks.

What does day-to-day look like:

  • PhD / Doctorate
  • Designed and defined novel mathematical systems, operations, and axiomatic frameworks for reasoning evaluations.
  • Authored multi-step reasoning tasks involving symbolic manipulation, expression evaluation, and proof-based problem solving.
  • Developed deterministic solutions, detailed reasoning traces, and comprehensive scoring rubrics for model assessment.
  • Identified and addressed edge cases, ambiguities, and logical inconsistencies to ensure task robustness and reproducibility.
  • Collaborated with reviewers and AI/LLM teams to refine task definitions, evaluation criteria, and dataset quality standards.


Required Qualifications:

  • Strong foundation in abstract mathematics, formal logic, algebraic structures, discrete mathematics, or theoretical computer science.
  • Minimum 2 years of experience in mathematics, computer science, data science, logic, or a related analytical discipline.
  • Proven ability to create structured reasoning problems that assess both conceptual understanding and procedural accuracy.
  • Excellent written communication skills with the ability to document rigorous definitions, proofs, and reasoning processes.
  • Experience evaluating LLM reasoning performance or developing AI training and assessment datasets is preferred.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required : 4 hours of overlap with PST.
  • Engagement type : Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • Duration of contract : 8 weeks.

vagas.title: Remote Mathematics Expert
vagas.description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Remote Mathematics Expert em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Role Overview:

We are seeking highly skilled and motivated mathematicians with a strong understanding of intermediate to advanced mathematical concepts and the ability to apply these concepts creatively to complex problems. This role is ideal for individuals who thrive in tackling challenging questions and have a passion for deep mathematical reasoning and problem-solving. We are hiring both individuals who are strong in undergraduate level mathematics and as well as those who are strong in masters/PhD level mathematics. Turing works with most of the leading LLM companies in the world today and your work will enable today’s leading LLMs to attain advanced mathematics proficiency.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop and implement advanced mathematical models and computational techniques to address complex problems across diverse mathematical domains.
  • Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams on research initiatives, providing mathematical expertise and analytical insights.
  • Review and engage with the latest mathematical literature, including cutting-edge research papers and emerging methodologies.
  • Apply quantitative and computational approaches to analyze data, optimize models, and support innovative problem-solving strategies.
  • Contribute to the advancement of research projects through rigorous mathematical reasoning and technical proficiency.


Desired Skills and Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s, Master’s, or PhD degree in Mathematics or a closely related field, with strong expertise in one or more of the following areas: computable functions and mathematical logic, algebra and number theory, linear algebra and matrix theory, topology and geometry, real analysis, probability, and statistics.
  • Proven ability to solve complex mathematical problems, demonstrated through research experience, publications, academic achievements, or project work.
  • Knowledge of Python and data analysis tools is preferred, though not mandatory.
  • Excellent analytical and critical thinking skills, with strong attention to detail and problem-solving capabilities.
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain complex mathematical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Collaborative mindset with experience working in multidisciplinary teams on research-driven or project-based initiatives.


More details on required skills:

Candidates should demonstrate strong expertise in at least 4 of the following 7 domains, with broader coverage considered a significant advantage:

Computable Functions and Mathematical Logic

  • Strong understanding of the theory of computation, computable functions, decision problems, and strategies for inferring functions from input-output relationships.

Algebra and Number Theory

  • Deep knowledge of algebraic structures, quadratic forms, signatures, prime numbers, Eisenstein series, and related concepts in number theory and their applications.

Linear Algebra and Matrix Theory

  • Proficiency in linear spaces, basis transformations, symmetric matrices, matrix equations, matrix diagonalization, and rank-related conditions.

Topology and Geometry

  • Understanding of vector bundles, cohomology, fundamental groups, commensurability, topological spaces, vector fields, and geometric proof techniques.

Analysis

  • Strong foundation in real analysis, including properties of functions almost everywhere, convergence concepts, continuity, and advanced analytical reasoning.

Probability and Statistics

  • Ability to apply probability theory to evaluate outcomes under varying conditions, along with experience using statistical techniques such as ANOVA for experimental and data analysis.

Applied Mathematics

  • Capability to apply mathematical reasoning and problem-solving techniques to practical scenarios, including logic-based and analytical challenges.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required: at least 4 hours per day and up to 40 hours per week with 4 hours of overlap with PST.
  • Engagement type: Contractor


Evaluation Process:

  • Shortlisted candidates will be sent a Job Interest Form.
  • After the profile review, an assessment will be shared, which must be completed within 24 hours.
  • Based on the assessment outcomes, shortlisted candidates will be contacted to schedule an interview.


After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.


Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

Company Description

Metrobi is a fulfillment platform designed to support local businesses, particularly in industries like food and beverage. The company simplifies delivery management by connecting businesses with local contractor drivers and optimizing in-house delivery operations. Through its logistics, financial, and marketing tools, Metrobi empowers local businesses to confidently grow their distribution networks. Metrobi operates with a mission to enhance efficiency and scale for local makers and distributors.


Intro video:


Responsibilities

  • Backlog & Kanban Management:

Own the Kanban board: organize tasks, ensure priorities are clear and understand what is stopping us from maintaining our task flow to hit our deployment goals. Communicate risks, issues, blockers, and quality concerns to the PM and relevant team members.

  • Task Definition & Refinement:

Review and write descriptions for tasks about new features, improvements and bug fixes. Ensure problems are well explained and solutions are testable and aligned with product goals. Collaborate with the Product Manager to translate strategy into actionable tasks.

  • Validate Outcomes, Not Just Output:

After new features or fixes go live, verify whether they truly solved the original problem and improved the targeted user or business metrics.

  • Strong skills in Product Management and Business Analysis to define and evaluate product requirements effectively.

  • Familiarity with Software Development processes and tools to coordinate effectively with technical teams.
  • Ability to adapt in a dynamic, fast-paced working environment and manage multiple priorities.
  • Prior experience in a similar role is preferred.
  • Skills like SQL, Git, reading Python code and doing data analysis are very beneficial, but not required


Notes

  • This is a full-time remote position.
  • Hiring interviews are online.

vagas.title: Marketing and Communications Coordinator
vagas.description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Marketing and Communications Coordinator em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Company Description Hjelle Consulting Group (HCG) is a specialized network of regulatory affairs, regulatory science, and product pipeline design experts serving the agricultural technology sector. Led by former Monsanto Regulatory Vice President Jerry Hjelle, the team includes experienced strategists, scientists, and government affairs professionals with deep expertise across plant and on-plant products, including gene-edited crops, biotech plants, agricultural chemistries, microbials, and biologicals. HCG aims to deliver top-tier regulatory expertise and execution that has traditionally been available only to large multinational companies, and at a more accessible cost. Through a “Regulatory on Demand” model, HCG helps clients scale strategic and execution support as needed, reducing the burden of building in-house regulatory teams. The company’s ongoing engagement with client product pipelines also provides investors with confidence in the quality, design, and capital efficiency of the regulatory work supporting those products.


Role Description Hjelle Consulting Group (HCG) is seeking an experienced Marketing & Communications Coordinator on a contract basis to support our growing thought leadership program in agricultural biotechnology regulation. This is a remote, operational role — you will own the execution of our content distribution, email marketing (Brevo), LinkedIn scheduling, and webinar coordination, working directly with senior regulatory scientists to extract and amplify their expertise to a global B2B audience. The ideal candidate has hands-on experience in agbiotech, agricultural inputs, or regulatory affairs marketing, writes and communicates with precision in English, and thrives in a lean, self-directed environment where building systems matters as much as executing them. Portuguese proficiency is a plus. If you have managed marketing operations for a technical B2B firm and understand what it means to communicate credibly to scientists, regulators, and investors — we want to hear from you.

Você está em uma jornada para ingressar em uma empresa emocionante e fazer parte de nossa história de sucesso. Aqui vamos equipá-lo com o know-how e a experiência que definirão seu crescimento. Nesta função em que você está prestes a embarcar, você deve cumprir as seguintes responsabilidades:

  • Negociar pacotes de equipamentos industriais, EPC/EPCM, obras e serviços técnicos.
  • Realizar equalização técnica e comercial, análises de TCO e estudos financeiros comparativos.
  • Atuar junto às áreas de Engenharia e Projetos, garantindo alinhamento de escopo, riscos e cronogramas.
  • Executar gestão de contratos, incluindo cláusulas críticas, KPIs, aditivos e governança.
  • Desenvolver e implementar estratégias de Strategic Sourcing, mapeamento de categorias e benchmarking global.
  • Criar e analisar dashboards em BI (Power BI) para suporte à tomada de decisão.
  • Utilizar IA e ferramentas inteligentes para análise de documentos, cenários e otimização de processos.
  • Preparar apresentações executivas para diretoria, com visão clara de riscos, recomendações e impactos no CAPEX.
  • Exercer liderança técnica, apoiando o time e garantindo boas práticas nos processos de Suprimentos.
  • Iniciar e acompanhar processo de criação de contratos jurídicos com os fornecedores, time de contratos e jurídico quando necessário.
  • Respeitar e seguir os processos, normas e procedimentos internos, assim como, toda legislação vigente pertinente as suas atividades, atuando e inspirando a atuação dos demais membros em conformidade com os valores institucionais, zelando pela imagem da Bracell e pela concretização de sua missão e visão, contribuindo de maneira efetiva para a seu fortalecimento e perenização.

Requisitos

  • Formação em Engenharia, Administração, Economia, Comércio Exterior ou áreas correlatas.
  • Pós-graduação/MBA em Gestão de Projetos, Supply Chain, Compras Estratégicas ou Engenharia Econômica (desejável)
  • Disponibilidade para atuação presencial em Feira de Santana - BA.
  • Disponibilidade para viagens e mobilidade nacional.
  • Experiência sólida em Compras CAPEX em indústrias de grande porte (celulose, papel, mineração, óleo & gás, energia etc.).
  • Vivência em projetos greenfield e gestão de escopo, riscos e interfaces de engenharia.
  • Experiência com gestão de contratos, negociação complexa e fornecedores globais.
