vagas.title: Key Account Manager / Presales Lead
vagas.description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Key Account Manager / Presales Lead em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About WorkPacks: Nestled in the vibrant tech ecosystem of the USA, WorkPacks is an innovative startup reshaping the construction industry's future. We're in search of daring individuals who are eager to disrupt, envision, and build anew. As trailblazers in the digital arena, we're stretching the limits of what's possible and warmly invite you to embark on this exhilarating venture with us.


Position Overview: We’re looking for a motivated Key Account Manager / Implementation Lead who will serve as both a relationship builder and implementation expert. In this role, you’ll be the primary point of contact for clients, ensuring our software solutions align with their needs and integrate seamlessly into their operations. This fully remote role combines client engagement with hands-on deployment, offering the opportunity to be directly involved in both client satisfaction and product success.


Responsibilities:


  • Client Relationship Management: Cultivate strong, lasting relationships with key clients, ensuring they feel supported and valued.
  • Primary Point of Contact: Serve as the primary liaison for assigned accounts, providing responsive and reliable client support.
  • Implementation Planning: Develop, document, and manage comprehensive implementation plans, including client-specific requirements, configurations, and any necessary customizations.
  • Data Specification Documentation: Prepare technical specifications and manage electronic data interface (EDI) setup with clients for seamless integration.
  • Deployment Leadership: Lead software implementations at client locations as required, managing deployment to ensure successful integration and operation.
  • Client Collaboration: Work closely with clients to thoroughly understand their project requirements and guarantee successful software adoption.
  • Technical Support & Troubleshooting: Deliver hands-on technical support during the implementation phase, addressing issues quickly to maintain satisfaction.
  • Client Training: Educate clients and their teams on using our software effectively, enabling them to gain maximum benefit from the tools.
  • Feedback Loop with Development: Collaborate closely with the product development team, sharing field insights and client feedback to support ongoing product improvements.


Qualifications:


  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Construction Management, or a related field.
  • Industry Experience: Minimum of 5 years of experience in the construction industry.
  • Technical Interest: Strong interest in construction technology and software solutions.
  • Communication Skills: Excellent interpersonal and communication skills for effective client engagement and support.
  • Problem-Solving Abilities: A detail-oriented approach with a proactive problem-solving mindset.
  • Multi-Project Management: Capability to manage multiple client accounts or projects simultaneously.
  • Willingness to Travel: Availability to travel to client sites as necessary.


Preferred Qualifications


  • Advanced Work Packaging (AWP): Familiarity with AWP methodologies.
  • Software Knowledge: Experience with construction management software or related technology.
  • Implementation Process Insight: Basic understanding of software implementation processes.
  • Client-Facing Experience: Previous experience in a client-focused role or account management.


Expectations


  • Remote Work: Fully remote position with flexibility and some overlap required with U.S. working hours.
  • Autonomous Drive: Proactive, creative, and capable of driving projects forward independently.
  • Hands-on Approach: Eager to engage with both client challenges and technical solutions directly.


Compensation:

  • Salary: Competitive salary starting at $55,000/year.
  • Benefits: Comprehensive health and wellness benefits.
  • Growth Opportunities: Paths for professional development and career advancement within the company.
  • Culture: A collaborative, inclusive, and innovation-driven workplace that values teamwork and individual initiative.


This role is perfect for a client-focused, tech-savvy professional passionate about transforming the construction industry through technology. Join us to shape the future of construction, drive client success, and take the lead in groundbreaking software implementations!

vagas.description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Telecom Project Coordinator em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Opportunity to Work on Telecommunications Projects!


We are looking for a professional to coordinate and oversee service implementation projects, ensuring alignment among clients, vendors, and internal teams throughout every stage of the operation.


Location: South and Southeast regions of Brazil

  • Monitor and coordinate the execution of service implementation projects.
  • Act as the main point of coordination between clients, vendors, and internal stakeholders.
  • Track project schedules, deliverables, and performance indicators.

  • Experience in telecommunications, technology, or infrastructure environments.
  • Knowledge of Agile methodologies and project management tools.

vagas.description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Salesforce Marketing Cloud Expert em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that helps companies scale their teams on demand.


A Salesforce Marketing Cloud Expert is needed to design, build, launch, and optimize email, messaging, segmentation, and automation solutions. This role will support critical marketing technology initiatives, guide junior developers, and act as a module lead or point of contact for one or more markets or countries.


The role involves working across email development, journey orchestration, audience segmentation, reporting, and platform process improvements.

The expert will work with geographically distributed teams, including developers, project managers, and market stakeholders. Key objectives include improving campaign execution, maintaining reliable system processes, supporting new proof-of-concept initiatives, and identifying trends or issues that can inform future marketing decisions.


Task and deliverables:

  • Build, launch, and monitor email campaigns, messages, journeys, and audience segmentation within Salesforce Marketing Cloud.
  • Implement and support the full lifecycle of email and messaging initiatives, from development through testing, deployment, reporting, and optimization.
  • Develop reusable email templates, content assets, and campaign components using HTML, CSS, AMPscript, SSJS, and Salesforce Marketing Cloud tools.
  • Create and maintain audience segments, automations, and data-driven campaign logic using SQL and relevant SFMC modules.
  • Generate, review, and interpret email performance reports to identify trends, issues, and improvement opportunities.
  • Support campaign asset development, including selecting or adapting imagery and content elements that improve audience response.
  • Guide junior developers on Salesforce Marketing Cloud development activities, standards, and best practices.
  • Act as module lead and point of contact for one or more markets or countries.
  • Document system processes, recurring issues, campaign workflows, and technical recommendations for the project team.
  • Develop and support proof-of-concept initiatives for new Salesforce Marketing Cloud solutions and enhancements.


Required experience:

  • Required: Bachelor’s degree in IT, Computer Science, or equivalent professional experience.

vagas.title: Webflow Developer
vagas.description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Webflow Developer em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Job description


BX Studio, a leading Webflow design-and-development agency, is looking for an experienced Senior Webflow Developer to own and elevate our most complex web projects. You’ll collaborate closely with designers, strategists, and junior developers to deliver pixel-perfect, high-performance sites—on time, on budget, and at the cutting edge of Webflow’s capabilities. Fluency in English and a friendly, professional demeanor are essential.


What you’ll do

  • Lead builds end-to-end—from scoping and wireframes to launch and post-launch optimizations.
  • Architect scalable Webflow systems (components, class structures, CMS schema) using Client-First or similar methodologies.
  • Mentor and review junior developers, establishing best practices for accessibility, performance, and responsive design.
  • Implement advanced features such as memberships, logic flows, complex animations, e-commerce, API and Zapier/Make integrations, and custom code embeds.
  • Translate design files (Figma/Sketch/Adobe XD) into production-ready Webflow sites with perfect fidelity and micro-interaction polish.
  • Optimize SEO, page speed, and analytics, ensuring Lighthouse and Core Web Vitals targets are met.
  • Interface directly with clients and internal stakeholders, providing technical guidance, accurate estimates, and proactive solutions.
  • Continuously improve our workflow, researching new Webflow releases, no-code tools, and automation to keep BX Studio at the forefront of the industry.


Role requirements

  • 3+ years of professional Webflow development (or 6+ years front-end with 3+ in Webflow).
  • Demonstrated portfolio of complex, high-traffic Webflow sites—including CMS, e-commerce, and custom interactions.
  • Expert-level understanding of Client-First nomenclature and component libraries (Relume, Flowbase, etc.).
  • Proficiency with HTML5, CSS/SCSS, JavaScript (ES6+), and REST/GraphQL APIs; comfortable writing custom code when Webflow’s native tools aren’t enough.
  • Sharp eye for detail and commitment to pixel-perfect execution across breakpoints and browsers.
  • Leadership and mentorship experience—able to set code standards, run code reviews, and upskill teammates.
  • Strong project-management skills: accurate scoping, clear documentation, and a track record of hitting deadlines.
  • High degree of reliability, initiative, and integrity in a fully remote environment.
  • Availability to work core hours in either EST or PST time zones.

vagas.title: Video Content Intern
vagas.description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Video Content Intern em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Type: Internship, 6 hours/day (30 hours/week)

Compensation: R$2,000/month

About the Role

We're an early-stage stealth startup in the health and wellness space, building our brand from the ground up. We're looking for a creative, fast-moving video intern who can turn raw footage and ideas into scroll-stopping short-form content for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and ads. You'll work directly with the founder and play a key role in how our brand shows up on video. Great opportunity for someone early in their career who loves editing and wants real ownership over content that thousands of people will see.

What You'll Do

  • Edit short-form video for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and paid ads (15-60 second formats)
  • Turn influencer footage, raw clips, and simple briefs into polished, platform-ready videos
  • Add captions, text overlays, music, and light motion to make content engaging
  • Repurpose one piece of content into multiple formats and cuts
  • Format and optimize videos to spec for each platform
  • Help maintain an organized library of footage and assets
  • Occasionally create simple graphics or thumbnails to support video content

What We're Looking For

  • Fluent in English, written and spoken. The interview will be conducted in English.
  • Strong editing skills in CapCut, and/or CapCut, Premiere, or similar (essential)
  • A real sense for what makes short-form video engaging, hooks, pacing, retention
  • Fast turnaround, comfortable producing multiple edits per day
  • Organized and reliable with deadlines
  • Self-motivated; you'll get briefs and direction, but we want someone who brings ideas
  • Available 6 hours per day

Nice to Have

  • Experience editing for health, wellness, fitness, or DTC/e-commerce brands
  • Basic motion graphics or animation skills
  • An eye for trends, you watch a lot of TikTok and know what's working right now

What You'll Get

  • Real, hands-on experience producing content for a brand from day one
  • Direct mentorship from the founder
  • Flexible remote work
  • Room to grow into a larger creative role as the company scales


How to Apply

In your resume, add a link to a reel or portfolio of your video work, ideally short-form social content you've edited.

vagas.title: Remote Mathematics Specialist
vagas.description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Remote Mathematics Specialist em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L


Role Overview:

The Mathematical Systems & Abstract Reasoning Engineer is responsible for developing advanced reasoning datasets that evaluate and improve the capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs). This role involves designing novel mathematical systems, defining custom rules and axioms, and creating rigorous reasoning challenges that require models to interpret definitions, perform symbolic computations, derive properties, and construct logically sound proofs. The ideal candidate combines deep expertise in abstract mathematics with exceptional analytical and communication skills to produce self-contained, verifiable, and high-quality evaluation tasks.

What does day-to-day look like:

  • PhD / Doctorate
  • Designed and defined novel mathematical systems, operations, and axiomatic frameworks for reasoning evaluations.
  • Authored multi-step reasoning tasks involving symbolic manipulation, expression evaluation, and proof-based problem solving.
  • Developed deterministic solutions, detailed reasoning traces, and comprehensive scoring rubrics for model assessment.
  • Identified and addressed edge cases, ambiguities, and logical inconsistencies to ensure task robustness and reproducibility.
  • Collaborated with reviewers and AI/LLM teams to refine task definitions, evaluation criteria, and dataset quality standards.


Required Qualifications:

  • Strong foundation in abstract mathematics, formal logic, algebraic structures, discrete mathematics, or theoretical computer science.
  • Minimum 2 years of experience in mathematics, computer science, data science, logic, or a related analytical discipline.
  • Proven ability to create structured reasoning problems that assess both conceptual understanding and procedural accuracy.
  • Excellent written communication skills with the ability to document rigorous definitions, proofs, and reasoning processes.
  • Experience evaluating LLM reasoning performance or developing AI training and assessment datasets is preferred.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required : 4 hours of overlap with PST.
  • Engagement type : Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • Duration of contract : 8 weeks.

Who We Are


MAVI is on a mission to globalize the finance and accounting function by connecting the best talent in the world with high-performing US companies. We’re building the world’s largest network of top-tier finance talent, using an AI-powered platform for sourcing, vetting & matching, and disrupting a legacy $100Bn+ industry.



What the Platform Team Does at MAVI


Platform Management drives the strategic side of our recruiting ecosystem, interpreting client needs, aligning talent, and ensuring successful placements. The Platform team is responsible for running the core operations of MAVI’s talent marketplace. They manage the full journey, from understanding customer needs to matching talent, placing them in roles, and ensuring both sides have a great experience. Their work ensures the marketplace runs smoothly, efficiently, and with high-quality service.

vagas.title: Webflow Developer
vagas.description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Webflow Developer em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Job description


BX Studio, a leading Webflow design-and-development agency, is looking for an experienced Senior Webflow Developer to own and elevate our most complex web projects. You’ll collaborate closely with designers, strategists, and junior developers to deliver pixel-perfect, high-performance sites—on time, on budget, and at the cutting edge of Webflow’s capabilities. Fluency in English and a friendly, professional demeanor are essential.


What you’ll do

  • Lead builds end-to-end—from scoping and wireframes to launch and post-launch optimizations.
  • Architect scalable Webflow systems (components, class structures, CMS schema) using Client-First or similar methodologies.
  • Mentor and review junior developers, establishing best practices for accessibility, performance, and responsive design.
  • Implement advanced features such as memberships, logic flows, complex animations, e-commerce, API and Zapier/Make integrations, and custom code embeds.
  • Translate design files (Figma/Sketch/Adobe XD) into production-ready Webflow sites with perfect fidelity and micro-interaction polish.
  • Optimize SEO, page speed, and analytics, ensuring Lighthouse and Core Web Vitals targets are met.
  • Interface directly with clients and internal stakeholders, providing technical guidance, accurate estimates, and proactive solutions.
  • Continuously improve our workflow, researching new Webflow releases, no-code tools, and automation to keep BX Studio at the forefront of the industry.


Role requirements

  • 3+ years of professional Webflow development (or 6+ years front-end with 3+ in Webflow).
  • Demonstrated portfolio of complex, high-traffic Webflow sites—including CMS, e-commerce, and custom interactions.
  • Expert-level understanding of Client-First nomenclature and component libraries (Relume, Flowbase, etc.).
  • Proficiency with HTML5, CSS/SCSS, JavaScript (ES6+), and REST/GraphQL APIs; comfortable writing custom code when Webflow’s native tools aren’t enough.
  • Sharp eye for detail and commitment to pixel-perfect execution across breakpoints and browsers.
  • Leadership and mentorship experience—able to set code standards, run code reviews, and upskill teammates.
  • Strong project-management skills: accurate scoping, clear documentation, and a track record of hitting deadlines.
  • High degree of reliability, initiative, and integrity in a fully remote environment.
  • Availability to work core hours in either EST or PST time zones.

vagas.title: Remote Mathematics Specialist
vagas.description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Remote Mathematics Specialist em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L


Role Overview:

The Mathematical Systems & Abstract Reasoning Engineer is responsible for developing advanced reasoning datasets that evaluate and improve the capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs). This role involves designing novel mathematical systems, defining custom rules and axioms, and creating rigorous reasoning challenges that require models to interpret definitions, perform symbolic computations, derive properties, and construct logically sound proofs. The ideal candidate combines deep expertise in abstract mathematics with exceptional analytical and communication skills to produce self-contained, verifiable, and high-quality evaluation tasks.

What does day-to-day look like:

  • PhD / Doctorate
  • Designed and defined novel mathematical systems, operations, and axiomatic frameworks for reasoning evaluations.
  • Authored multi-step reasoning tasks involving symbolic manipulation, expression evaluation, and proof-based problem solving.
  • Developed deterministic solutions, detailed reasoning traces, and comprehensive scoring rubrics for model assessment.
  • Identified and addressed edge cases, ambiguities, and logical inconsistencies to ensure task robustness and reproducibility.
  • Collaborated with reviewers and AI/LLM teams to refine task definitions, evaluation criteria, and dataset quality standards.


Required Qualifications:

  • Strong foundation in abstract mathematics, formal logic, algebraic structures, discrete mathematics, or theoretical computer science.
  • Minimum 2 years of experience in mathematics, computer science, data science, logic, or a related analytical discipline.
  • Proven ability to create structured reasoning problems that assess both conceptual understanding and procedural accuracy.
  • Excellent written communication skills with the ability to document rigorous definitions, proofs, and reasoning processes.
  • Experience evaluating LLM reasoning performance or developing AI training and assessment datasets is preferred.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required : 4 hours of overlap with PST.
  • Engagement type : Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • Duration of contract : 8 weeks.

vagas.title: Video Content Intern
vagas.description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Video Content Intern em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Type: Internship, 6 hours/day (30 hours/week)

Compensation: R$2,000/month

About the Role

We're an early-stage stealth startup in the health and wellness space, building our brand from the ground up. We're looking for a creative, fast-moving video intern who can turn raw footage and ideas into scroll-stopping short-form content for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and ads. You'll work directly with the founder and play a key role in how our brand shows up on video. Great opportunity for someone early in their career who loves editing and wants real ownership over content that thousands of people will see.

What You'll Do

  • Edit short-form video for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and paid ads (15-60 second formats)
  • Turn influencer footage, raw clips, and simple briefs into polished, platform-ready videos
  • Add captions, text overlays, music, and light motion to make content engaging
  • Repurpose one piece of content into multiple formats and cuts
  • Format and optimize videos to spec for each platform
  • Help maintain an organized library of footage and assets
  • Occasionally create simple graphics or thumbnails to support video content

What We're Looking For

  • Fluent in English, written and spoken. The interview will be conducted in English.
  • Strong editing skills in CapCut, and/or CapCut, Premiere, or similar (essential)
  • A real sense for what makes short-form video engaging, hooks, pacing, retention
  • Fast turnaround, comfortable producing multiple edits per day
  • Organized and reliable with deadlines
  • Self-motivated; you'll get briefs and direction, but we want someone who brings ideas
  • Available 6 hours per day

Nice to Have

  • Experience editing for health, wellness, fitness, or DTC/e-commerce brands
  • Basic motion graphics or animation skills
  • An eye for trends, you watch a lot of TikTok and know what's working right now

What You'll Get

  • Real, hands-on experience producing content for a brand from day one
  • Direct mentorship from the founder
  • Flexible remote work
  • Room to grow into a larger creative role as the company scales


How to Apply

In your resume, add a link to a reel or portfolio of your video work, ideally short-form social content you've edited.

vagas.title: Staffing Specialist
vagas.description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Staffing Specialist em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Who We Are


MAVI is on a mission to globalize the finance and accounting function by connecting the best talent in the world with high-performing US companies. We’re building the world’s largest network of top-tier finance talent, using an AI-powered platform for sourcing, vetting & matching, and disrupting a legacy $100Bn+ industry.



What the Platform Team Does at MAVI


Platform Management drives the strategic side of our recruiting ecosystem, interpreting client needs, aligning talent, and ensuring successful placements. The Platform team is responsible for running the core operations of MAVI’s talent marketplace. They manage the full journey, from understanding customer needs to matching talent, placing them in roles, and ensuring both sides have a great experience. Their work ensures the marketplace runs smoothly, efficiently, and with high-quality service.


About the Role


We’re hiring a Platform Specia list who can help drive the lifeblood of our talent marketplace - the end-to-end process from talent matching, talent placement & account management. This person will work directly with the current Platform Manager at MAVI and work as a tag team to close deals, manage ongoing engagements, resolve ad-hoc issues that arise, improve processes & work with the engineering team to inject automation into various workflows.



What You'll Do


  • Work with Leadership and the Platform Manager to understand job needs, ideal candidate profiles, and help match the right talent to open roles.
  • Serve as the main point of contact for MAVI customers , build trust, manage ongoing engagements, and keep them regularly updated.
  • Build strong, long-term relationships with customers by understanding their goals, preferences, and business needs.
  • Support the end-to-end matching process by reviewing candidate documentation and identifying best-fit talent for open positions.
  • Write compelling, clear, and engaging job descriptions to attract talent from our internal network and match them with active opportunities.
  • Assist in creating professional and polished candidate profiles for presentation to customers.
  • Provide support throughout the hiring process, ensuring consistent communication between talent and customers to keep things moving.
  • Resolve issues that arise during active engagements, ensuring alignment, satisfaction, and long-term success for both parties.
  • Collaborate with leadership and other internal teams to refine and enhance our account and engagement management processes.


What We’re Looking For


  • At least 4-9 years of experience in account management, staffing, recruitment coordination, or a related role.
  • Very strong English communication skills, both written and verbal, is a must.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple priorities, and customer relationships in a dynamic environment.
  • Proven ability to work in high-speed environments, to operate with high urgency, and be extremely customer-centric.
  • High level of discretion and judgment when handling confidential or sensitive information.
  • Experience working with global clients or in remote-first environments.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment and adapt quickly to change.
  • Exceptional communication, organizational, interpersonal, and problem-solving skills, with a proactive and strategic approach.
  • Someone who is humble, hungry and best in class at what they do.


Why You Should Join


  • Impact: You’re not just another cog in the machine; you’ll help build the talent acquisition motion ground up that powers the entire business.
  • No Bureaucracy: Work directly with founders, move fast, and own meaningful projects. We’re playing to win here. This is a startup and we’re looking for new ideas, bold moves, and scrappiness.
  • Competitive Pay: We believe in sharing the upside with those who build it :)
  • Remote-first: Work from anywhere, but expect high velocity and deep collaboration.


Equal Opportunity Statement


At MAVI, we celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all team members. We welcome applicants of every background, identity, and life experience. Employment decisions are based on business needs, qualifications, and merit, without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

vagas.title: Webflow Developer
vagas.description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Webflow Developer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Job description


BX Studio, a leading Webflow design-and-development agency, is looking for an experienced Senior Webflow Developer to own and elevate our most complex web projects. You’ll collaborate closely with designers, strategists, and junior developers to deliver pixel-perfect, high-performance sites—on time, on budget, and at the cutting edge of Webflow’s capabilities. Fluency in English and a friendly, professional demeanor are essential.


What you’ll do

  • Lead builds end-to-end—from scoping and wireframes to launch and post-launch optimizations.
  • Architect scalable Webflow systems (components, class structures, CMS schema) using Client-First or similar methodologies.
  • Mentor and review junior developers, establishing best practices for accessibility, performance, and responsive design.
  • Implement advanced features such as memberships, logic flows, complex animations, e-commerce, API and Zapier/Make integrations, and custom code embeds.
  • Translate design files (Figma/Sketch/Adobe XD) into production-ready Webflow sites with perfect fidelity and micro-interaction polish.
  • Optimize SEO, page speed, and analytics, ensuring Lighthouse and Core Web Vitals targets are met.
  • Interface directly with clients and internal stakeholders, providing technical guidance, accurate estimates, and proactive solutions.
  • Continuously improve our workflow, researching new Webflow releases, no-code tools, and automation to keep BX Studio at the forefront of the industry.


Role requirements

  • 3+ years of professional Webflow development (or 6+ years front-end with 3+ in Webflow).
  • Demonstrated portfolio of complex, high-traffic Webflow sites—including CMS, e-commerce, and custom interactions.
  • Expert-level understanding of Client-First nomenclature and component libraries (Relume, Flowbase, etc.).
  • Proficiency with HTML5, CSS/SCSS, JavaScript (ES6+), and REST/GraphQL APIs; comfortable writing custom code when Webflow’s native tools aren’t enough.
  • Sharp eye for detail and commitment to pixel-perfect execution across breakpoints and browsers.
  • Leadership and mentorship experience—able to set code standards, run code reviews, and upskill teammates.
  • Strong project-management skills: accurate scoping, clear documentation, and a track record of hitting deadlines.
  • High degree of reliability, initiative, and integrity in a fully remote environment.
  • Availability to work core hours in either EST or PST time zones.

vagas.title: Salesforce Marketing Cloud Expert
vagas.description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Salesforce Marketing Cloud Expert em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that helps companies scale their teams on demand.


A Salesforce Marketing Cloud Expert is needed to design, build, launch, and optimize email, messaging, segmentation, and automation solutions. This role will support critical marketing technology initiatives, guide junior developers, and act as a module lead or point of contact for one or more markets or countries.


The role involves working across email development, journey orchestration, audience segmentation, reporting, and platform process improvements.

The expert will work with geographically distributed teams, including developers, project managers, and market stakeholders. Key objectives include improving campaign execution, maintaining reliable system processes, supporting new proof-of-concept initiatives, and identifying trends or issues that can inform future marketing decisions.


Task and deliverables:

  • Build, launch, and monitor email campaigns, messages, journeys, and audience segmentation within Salesforce Marketing Cloud.
  • Implement and support the full lifecycle of email and messaging initiatives, from development through testing, deployment, reporting, and optimization.
  • Develop reusable email templates, content assets, and campaign components using HTML, CSS, AMPscript, SSJS, and Salesforce Marketing Cloud tools.
  • Create and maintain audience segments, automations, and data-driven campaign logic using SQL and relevant SFMC modules.
  • Generate, review, and interpret email performance reports to identify trends, issues, and improvement opportunities.
  • Support campaign asset development, including selecting or adapting imagery and content elements that improve audience response.
  • Guide junior developers on Salesforce Marketing Cloud development activities, standards, and best practices.
  • Act as module lead and point of contact for one or more markets or countries.
  • Document system processes, recurring issues, campaign workflows, and technical recommendations for the project team.
  • Develop and support proof-of-concept initiatives for new Salesforce Marketing Cloud solutions and enhancements.


Required experience:

  • Required: Bachelor’s degree in IT, Computer Science, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Required: 6–7+ years of IT experience, including 3–4+ years of hands-on Salesforce Marketing Cloud experience.
  • Required: Strong knowledge of Salesforce Marketing Cloud and core email marketing, messaging, segmentation, and automation concepts.
  • Required: Experience with at least three Salesforce Marketing Cloud modules, such as Email Studio, Journey Builder, Mobile Studio, Contact Builder, Automation Studio, Content Builder, Advertising Studio, SQL, or audience creation.
  • Required: Experience writing moderately complex SQL queries for segmentation, reporting, or automation use cases.
  • Required: Hands-on experience with HTML, CSS, AMPscript, and SSJS for email and campaign development.
  • Required: Strong attention to detail and experience with email testing, quality assurance, and deployment validation.
  • Required: Understanding of Salesforce best practices for marketing automation, data management, campaign execution, and platform governance.
  • Required: Ability to work independently with a high degree of ownership in a geographically distributed team.
  • Required: Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Nice to have: Experience acting as a module lead, market lead, country point of contact, or technical owner for Salesforce Marketing Cloud workstreams.
  • Nice to have: Experience supporting proofs of concept or implementing new marketing technology solutions.


Engagement highlights:

  • Opportunity to lead Salesforce Marketing Cloud development activities across one or more markets or countries.
  • Hands-on role covering campaign development, automation, reporting, optimization, and new solution design.
  • Collaborative environment with distributed development, project management, and business stakeholder teams.

Confira esta oportunidade para PROMOTOR MERCHANDISING JR (34204) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Descrição da empresa

Na Bosch, moldamos o futuro por meio das inovações tecnológicas de alta qualidade e de serviços que despertam entusiasmo e melhoram a vida das pessoas. Temos uma promessa sólida para nossos colaboradores: crescemos juntos, gostamos do nosso trabalho e inspiramos uns aos outros. Junte-se a nós e sinta a diferença.


Descrição do emprego

Responsabilidades do cargo
Promover a “venda total” dos produtos nas lojas designadas, por meio das seguintes ações:
Abordar os consumidores para demonstrar os produtos e acessórios das marcas Bosch, Skil e Dremel, destacando suas características e benefícios;

Orientar os vendedores da loja sobre novos produtos, lançamentos, características, benefícios e vantagens competitivas;
O promotor trabalhará na região de Salvador, Bahia.


Qualificações

Ensino médio completo (Obrigatório);
Inglês (Diferencial);

vagas.title: Integration Engineer
vagas.description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Integration Engineer em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About the Product

Anterior is on a mission to transform healthcare administration, making it seamless and invisible so clinicians can focus on delivering care. We’ve built an AI-powered platform designed by clinicians, for clinicians, to simplify administrative workflows and improve patient outcomes. By combining clinical expertise with cutting-edge technology, we’re revolutionizing healthcare operations with responsible AI.

We’re growing rapidly and are backed by world-class investors including Sequoia, New Enterprise Associates NEA, and Neo along with notable angels including the founders of DeepMind, Google AI, and Inflection AI.

Anterior is improving the experience of healthcare for everyone. We’re working on the cutting edge of using technology to make clinical decision-making frictionless.We’re building exciting tech for huge customers and we trust in the foundations: keep it simple, build strong foundations, and the rest will follow.


The Team

At Anterior, engineers share a strong “sense of product” and solve meaningful problems that simplify healthcare workflows. We collaborate in multidisciplinary teams to deliver secure, scalable, and user-focused solutions guided by best practices and modular design.

We’re building a dedicated deployments team focused on deploying our platform into large US enterprise healthcare environments. This team works closely with customers and our core platform engineers to ensure seamless, reliable integrations into complex payer systems of record.


About You

You have a passion for doing things The Right Way, you believe Less is More, you want to focus on the foundations of system design and architecture (pacelc, consistency guarantees), you care as much about the code you do not write, you’re tired of the hype treadmill and care about the fundamentals. You have battle scars from over-engineered and underperforming slop, and you care about writing code that lasts.

Your depth is in building integrations, APIs, and data pipelines that connect complex systems together reliably. You’ve worked with enterprise customers, dealt with messy data, conflicting sources of truth, and deduplication challenges.

You’ve owned integration design decisions end-to-end — from scoping requirements with a customer to shipping it to production and making sure it holds up. You may be coming from a health tech company, a scale-up doing enterprise deployments, or a platform team that built the connective tissue between systems — what matters is that you’ve navigated real integration complexity and you want ownership over what you build.

Desenvolvedor(a) Java SR | Spring Boot | Microsserviços

100% REMOTO - PJ


Sobre a oportunidade

Estamos em busca de uma pessoa Desenvolvedora Java SR para atuar no desenvolvimento, evolução e sustentação de soluções escaláveis baseadas em microsserviços.

Esta é uma oportunidade para profissionais com sólida experiência em Java, Spring Boot, arquitetura de sistemas distribuídos e boas práticas de desenvolvimento, segurança e integração.


Você fará parte de um ambiente técnico colaborativo, atuando em parceria com times de arquitetura, produto, QA e operação para construir soluções robustas, seguras, escaláveis e preparadas para alta disponibilidade.


Principais responsabilidades

  • Projetar, desenvolver e implementar soluções baseadas em microsserviços utilizando Java, Spring Boot e tecnologias relacionadas.
  • Aplicar padrões de arquitetura de microsserviços, segurança, escalabilidade e boas práticas de desenvolvimento.
  • Colaborar na definição da arquitetura de sistemas e integrações, garantindo soluções robustas e sustentáveis.
  • Transformar definições técnicas de alto nível em soluções executáveis.
  • Estimar esforços, apoiar entregas em andamento e contribuir para a evolução contínua dos produtos e sistemas.
  • Desenvolver e aprimorar funcionalidades, avaliando viabilidade técnica e impactos de implementação.
  • Atuar em demandas de suporte, melhorias, mudanças e evolução de requisitos ao longo do ciclo de release.
  • Documentar procedimentos técnicos, fases de testes, recomendações e práticas de CI/CD.
  • Participar de testes, garantia de qualidade e integração de aplicações.
  • Acompanhar métricas de desempenho da equipe e apoiar a melhoria dos processos técnicos.


Requisitos obrigatórios

  • 7+ anos de experiência em desenvolvimento de software.
  • Experiência sólida com Java 8+ e Spring Boot/Spring Framework.
  • Vivência com arquitetura de microsserviços e APIs RESTful.
  • Conhecimento em XML, JSON, Swagger e Maven ou Gradle.
  • Experiência com segurança e autenticação, incluindo mTLS, OAuth2 e AWS Cognito.
  • Experiência com bancos de dados SQL e NoSQL.
  • Vivência com Docker, Kubernetes, Git, filas de mensagens e sistemas de cache.
  • Conhecimento em Jenkins, pipelines CI/CD e boas práticas de deploy.
  • Inglês técnico intermediário ou avançado, com foco em leitura, escrita, interpretação de documentação técnica e participação em interações técnicas com times internacionais.


Diferenciais

  • Conhecimento em Angular, Node.js ou atuação full stack.
  • Experiência com ambientes Windows e Linux.
  • Experiência com AWS, GCP ou Terraform.
  • Vivência com AWS EC2, EKS, SQS, Redis, DMS ou RDS.
  • Conhecimento em GCP GCE, GKE, Pub/Sub ou DMS.
  • Vivência com PostgreSQL, RDBMS e consultas complexas.
  • Experiência com monitoramento, depuração e troubleshooting, como New Relic ou ferramentas similares.
  • Conhecimento em Shell Script ou Python.
  • Experiência com suporte à produção, gestão de tickets e SLA.
  • Familiaridade com metodologias Agile/Scrum.
  • Participação em reuniões técnicas internacionais.
  • Conhecimento em princípios de design responsivo.


Perfil que buscamos

Buscamos uma pessoa com boa capacidade analítica, autonomia técnica, atenção à qualidade das entregas e facilidade para colaborar com times multidisciplinares.

É importante ter visão de arquitetura, preocupação com segurança, performance e escalabilidade, além de boa comunicação técnica para atuar em um ambiente dinâmico, colaborativo e com interação técnica em inglês.

vagas.title: Master Data Analyst
vagas.description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Master Data Analyst em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Ready to shape the future of work?

At Genpact, we don’t just adapt to change—we drive it. AI and digital innovation are redefining industries, and we’re leading the charge. Genpact’s AI Gigafactory, our industry-first accelerator, is an example of how we’re scaling advanced technology solutions to help global enterprises work smarter, grow faster, and transform at scale. From large-scale models to agentic AI, our breakthrough solutions tackle companies’ most complex challenges.

If you thrive in a fast-moving, tech-driven environment, love solving real-world problems, and want to be part of a team that’s shaping the future, this is your moment.

Genpact (NYSE: G) is an advanced technology services and solutions company that delivers lasting value for leading enterprises globally. Through our deep business knowledge, operational excellence, and cutting-edge solutions – we help companies across industries get ahead and stay ahead. Powered by curiosity, courage, and innovation, our teams implement data, technology, and AI to create tomorrow, today. Get to know and on LinkedIn, X, YouTube, and Facebook.

-------------



Responsibilities


Master Data Operations

  • Manage day‑to‑day master data operations, ensuring timely and accurate execution of assigned tasks.
  • Maintain vendor, material, and service master records (creation, updates, modifications, deletions) in alignment with SLA requirements across multiple regions.
  • Perform data cleaning, enrichment, and standardization activities to improve overall data quality.


Governance & Compliance

  • Ensure compliance with global governance requirements and internal sourcing policies, including ethics, environmental stewardship, social responsibility, localization, and health & safety standards.
  • Collaborate with internal and external audit teams, preparing documentation, evidence, and supporting materials to address findings and implement recommended actions.


Vendor Management

  • Drive centralized vendor management by maintaining accurate records, consistent classification, and risk validation.
  • Establish and monitor vendor accounts, including non‑preferred vendor listings, to ensure compliance and sustainability reporting.
  • Provide ongoing maintenance and enrichment of vendor data to support continuous improvement.


Continuous Improvement & Systems Support

Track, measure, and implement continuous improvement initiatives related to master data processes.

  • Coordinate with UAT teams to support testing, validation, and deployment of system or process changes.
  • Prepare operational and analytical reports, and support automation of recurring tasks.


Stakeholder Engagement

  • Respond to client and supplier queries, providing timely and effective resolutions within stipulated timeframes.
  • Partner with cross‑functional teams to ensure smooth delivery of master data services and alignment with business needs.


Qualifications we seek in you!

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in information systems, Computer Science, Data Analytics, or a related field
  • 5+ years of experience in Supply Chain Master Data Management & planning, ensuring accuracy, consistency, and strategic alignment of material, service, & vendor master records
  • Strong knowledge of data governance and data quality practices, including cleansing and standardization in large‑scale ERP environments.
  • Industry experience in mining, manufacturing, or heavy industry preferred.
  • Expertise in material and vendor master data, with familiarity in MDM tools (e.g., SAP MDG, Informatica).
  • Comprehensive understanding of procurement and supply chain processes, with emphasis on master data governance.


Technical / Functional Competencies

  • Proficiency in SAP MM, Excel, & data analysis tools
  • Knowledge of UNSPSC, ISO standards, and material classification systems
  • Hands‑on experience with ERP systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle), including workflow processes
  • Strong written, verbal, and presentation skills, with proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite.
  • Familiarity with BI tools (Power BI, Tableau) is an advantage.
  • Understanding of governance methodologies to ensure accuracy, consistency, and resilience across material, service, and vendor records.


General Competencies

  • Strong customer service orientation and stakeholder‑management skills
  • Effective time management and ability to anticipate needs and drive outcomes

A Dimensa está no topo do jogo quando o assunto é tecnologia e infraestrutura para operações financeiras, crédito e risco, e seguros. Nossos sistemas são super escaláveis e adaptáveis, perfeitos para negócios de todos os tamanhos. Nossa equipe de experts vive e respira o setor financeiro, atualizando nossas soluções constantemente para tornar suas operações mais digitais, melhorar a performance, inovar no atendimento aos clientes e garantir que todas as exigências regulatórias sejam 100% cumpridas.


Todas as nossas oportunidades são inclusivas e abertas para pessoas com deficiência.


O DESAFIO :


  • Atuar no desenvolvimento de soluções técnicas de média e alta complexidade, com boa autonomia, utilizando as tecnologias, frameworks e padrões adotados nos projetos da BU de Core Banking.
  • Analisar, compreender e evoluir a arquitetura das aplicações, avaliando componentes, integrações, estrutura, segurança e regras de negócio envolvidas.
  • Desenvolver, manter e evoluir funcionalidades com foco em qualidade, desempenho, segurança, escalabilidade e aderência às necessidades do negócio.
  • Criar, manter e apoiar a evolução de testes manuais e automatizados, contribuindo para a confiabilidade das entregas e para a cobertura dos requisitos funcionais e técnicos.
  • Participar ativamente da definição técnica das soluções, contribuindo com análises, sugestões de melhoria e apoio ao time na tomada de decisão.
  • Documentar implementações, fluxos, decisões técnicas e etapas do desenvolvimento, utilizando ferramentas de versionamento, rastreabilidade e documentação técnica.
  • Realizar detalhamento técnico de demandas em conjunto com clientes, analistas de negócio e demais áreas envolvidas, transformando requisitos funcionais em soluções viáveis, sustentáveis e aderentes à arquitetura definida.
  • Garantir a qualidade do software por meio da aplicação de boas práticas de desenvolvimento, revisão de código, padronização e uso adequado de frameworks, servidores de aplicação e ferramentas corporativas.
  • Atuar em conjunto com desenvolvedores, analistas, QA e áreas parceiras, promovendo alinhamento técnico e funcional ao longo do ciclo de desenvolvimento.
  • Participar de reuniões técnicas e funcionais com time e cliente, apoiando o esclarecimento de dúvidas, o refinamento de escopo e a evolução contínua das soluções.


O QUE VOCÊ PRECISA:


  • Experiência com Java JDK 8 ou 17
  • Vivência com Spring Boot, JAX-WS, JAX-RS, CDI, JPA, JEE, JSF, EJB e AngularJS
  • Experiência com WildFly 11 e/ou 18
  • Conhecimento em construção e consumo de APIs REST e SOAP
  • Experiência com Keycloak , utilizando OAuth2 / OpenID Connect (Bearer Token)
  • Conhecimento sólido em JPA / Hibernate
  • Experiência com banco de dados Oracle
  • Vivência com Git
  • Aplicação de boas práticas de desenvolvimento e princípios de design como SOLID
  • Vivência com Maven para build e gerenciamento de dependências
  • Experiência em análise, desenvolvimento, manutenção e sustentação de sistemas corporativos
  • Capacidade de atuar com autonomia na análise e solução de problemas técnicos
  • Boa comunicação para interação com time técnico, áreas de negócio e clientes


VOCÊ VAI BRILHAR AINDA MAIS SE TIVER :


  • Vivência em sustentação, suporte e atendimento a clientes em ambientes corporativos
  • Experiência com SQL Server ou ORACLE
  • Conhecimento em Kafka para mensageria e integração entre sistemas
  • Atuação em times que utilizam Métodos Ágeis
  • Vivência no uso de Inteligência Artificial aplicada ao desenvolvimento de software , com foco em produtividade, apoio à análise técnica, documentação, testes e troubleshooting

vagas.title: Corretor parceiro
vagas.description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Corretor parceiro em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Sobre a Oportunidade

A Chegolá Consórcio está expandindo o programa Indicalá. Buscamos pessoas conectadas, com boa rede de contatos e que queiram monetizar suas conexões de forma simples e transparente. Como Parceiro Independente, seu papel é ser a ponte entre pessoas que desejam adquirir bens (imóveis, veículos ou investimentos) e nossas soluções de consórcio especializado.


O que você fará:

  • Identificar oportunidades: Perceber quem no seu círculo profissional,de amigos, familiares está planejando comprar um bem ou investir.
  • Indicar: Cadastrar os dados do interessado em nossa plataforma exclusiva.
  • Acompanhar: Monitorar o status da sua indicação através do seu painel de embaixador.


Diferenciais do Programa:

  • Não precisa ter conhecimento técnico: Você não precisa fechar o negócio nem ser técnico no assunto. Nosso time de especialistas assume o atendimento após a sua indicação.
  • Liberdade Total: Sem metas, sem cobranças e sem horários fixos. Você indica quando e se quiser.
  • Renda Escalável: Não há limite de indicações. Ganhe recompensass expressivas (ex: R$ 1.000 para cada R$ 200 mil em crédito contratado).
  • Custo Zero: A participação é 100% gratuita.


Perfil Desejado:

  • Profissionais que já atuam com público (corretores, vendedores, consultores financeiros, influenciadores locais).
  • Pessoas com perfil comunicativo e bom relacionamento interpessoal.
  • Quem busca uma fonte de receita complementar sem comprometer sua atividade principal.


Como participar:

Todos que tem interesse irão receber um convite para uma live explicativa do programa.

vagas.title: Desenvolvedor(a) Sênior
vagas.description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Desenvolvedor(a) Sênior em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

O Centro de Integração Empresa Escola - CIEE é uma instituição filantrópica sem fins lucrativos e de fins não econômicos, reconhecida como entidade de assistência social que, por meio de diversos programas, dentre eles o de aprendizagem e o estágio de estudantes, possibilita aos adolescentes e jovens uma formação integral, ingressando-os ao mundo do trabalho.


O CIEE tem um programa de diversidade que acolhe e respeita como você é e como quiser ser!


Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Construir e manter aplicações web (frontend e backend), além de definir boas práticas a serem adotadas pelo CIEE.
  • Criar, consumir e manter APIs REST, garantindo integração eficiente entre sistemas internos e externos.
  • Escrever testes unitários e revisar código (code review).
  • Traduzir requisitos, estórias e regras de negócio em soluções eficientes.
  • Definir arquitetura de software e banco de dados.
  • Identificar e corrigir bugs, refatorar e resolver débitos técnicos nos sistemas implantados.
  • Documentar todas as atividades desenvolvidas, fluxos, integrações e regras de negócio.
  • Estimar esforço, prazo e impedimentos para cada demanda.
  • Participar de cerimônias ágeis (planejamento, dailies, retrospectivas e revisões).
  • Direcionar estagiários e desenvolvedores na execução de demandas.
  • Manter arquivos, registros e controles da área atualizados e acessíveis.


Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Escolaridade: Ensino superior concluído em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia da Computação, Análise e Desenvolvimento de Sistemas, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas.


  • Experiência: em atividades de desenvolvimento de software.


  • Conhecimentos específicos: Linguagens e Frameworks (Domínio em ao menos uma linguagem de programação orientada a objetos: Java, PHP ou Python. Domínio de desenvolvimento web: HTML, CSS e JavaScript. Domínio de frameworks backend Spring Boot. Banco de Dados (Domínio com SQL e banco de dados relacional (Oracle ou MySQL) e Experiência com modelagem de dados.). Versionamento e Colaboração ( Git e fluxo de versionamento (commits, branches e pull requests). Integração e Arquitetura ( Domínio de APIs REST (criação e consumo) e Domínio com microsserviços e componentização). Qualidade de Software ( Experiência com testes unitários e Domínio com Clean Code e boas práticas de desenvolvimento.). Metodologia ( Experiência com métodos ágeis: Scrum e/ou Kanban)Infraestrutura (básico): Experiência com Docker (criação de imagens e containers) e Inglês técnico para leitura de documentação.


Horário: 08:00 às 17:30 - segunda à sexta

vagas.title: Gerente de projetos SAP
vagas.description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Gerente de projetos SAP em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Modelo de trabalho: 100% Remoto

Área: Projetos SAP | Reforma Tributária


Sobre a oportunidade

Buscamos um(a) Gerente de Projetos SAP para liderar iniciativas estratégicas relacionadas à adequação dos sistemas e processos empresariais às exigências da Reforma Tributária brasileira.

O profissional será responsável pelo planejamento, governança e execução dos projetos, atuando como principal ponto de contato entre áreas de negócio, times de tecnologia, consultorias parceiras e fornecedores, garantindo a conformidade legal e o sucesso das entregas dentro dos prazos estabelecidos.


Principais responsabilidades

  • Gerenciar projetos SAP relacionados à implementação dos requisitos da Reforma Tributária (CBS, IBS e demais impactos regulatórios).
  • Elaborar e acompanhar cronogramas, orçamento, riscos, dependências e indicadores dos projetos.
  • Coordenar equipes multidisciplinares compostas por consultores SAP, especialistas fiscais, desenvolvedores e usuários-chave.
  • Conduzir reuniões executivas de acompanhamento e reportar status para stakeholders e liderança.
  • Garantir o alinhamento entre requisitos legais, processos de negócio e soluções sistêmicas.
  • Atuar na gestão de fornecedores e consultorias parceiras.
  • Liderar as fases de levantamento, desenho de solução, testes integrados, homologação e go-live.
  • Gerenciar riscos, impactos e mudanças de escopo, assegurando a governança do projeto.
  • Apoiar a definição de estratégias para adequação fiscal e tributária nos ambientes SAP ECC e/ou S/4HANA.
  • Garantir a qualidade das entregas e a aderência às metodologias de gestão de projetos adotadas pela organização.


Requisitos

  • Experiência consolidada como Gerente de Projetos SAP.
  • Vivência em projetos de implantação, rollout, conversão ou transformação SAP.
  • Conhecimento dos impactos da Reforma Tributária brasileira nos processos de negócio e sistemas corporativos.
  • Experiência na gestão de equipes multidisciplinares e fornecedores.
  • Conhecimento de metodologias de gestão de projetos (PMBOK, Agile, SAP Activate ou similares).
  • Capacidade de conduzir reuniões executivas e apresentações para alta liderança.
  • Conhecimento dos processos fiscais e integrações entre módulos SAP.


Diferenciais

  • Participação em projetos relacionados à Reforma Tributária.
  • Experiência com soluções fiscais como DRC, Soficom, Tax One, Mastersaf, Synchro, Guepardo, Vertex ou similares.
  • Conhecimento dos módulos SAP FI, SD, MM e Tax.
  • Certificação PMP, PMI-ACP, SAP Activate ou equivalente.
  • Experiência em ambientes SAP S/4HANA.
  • Inglês avançado.


O que esperamos deste profissional

Procuramos um(a) profissional com forte capacidade de liderança, visão de negócio e experiência em projetos SAP de alta complexidade, capaz de conduzir iniciativas críticas relacionadas à Reforma Tributária, garantindo conformidade legal, eficiência operacional e geração de valor para a organização.

vagas.title: Executivo(a) de Vendas Pleno -SUSEP
vagas.description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Executivo(a) de Vendas Pleno -SUSEP em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Somos a Seguros Unimed, a Seguradora do Sistema Unimed, uma empresa criada por médicos e que tem o cooperativismo na essência. Cuidamos das instituições e das pessoas, para que possam viver bem o presente e planejar o futuro com segurança. Trabalhamos todos os dias para oferecer soluções completas, que potencializem novos negócios. E estamos ao lado dos nossos clientes na hora em que mais precisam. Acreditamos que a cooperação nos conecta para crescermos juntos.


Pelo 7º ano consecutivo, a Seguros Unimed integra o ranking dos Lugares Mais Incríveis para Trabalhar 2025 , da FIA e do Estadão. E este ano, alcançamos o patamar MÁXIMO: somos O MAIS INCRÍVEL!


O que oferecemos nessa Jornada:

  • Remuneração compatível com o mercado;
  • PPR - Programa de Participação nos Resultados;
  • Vale Refeição e Alimentação;
  • Vale transporte ou desconto em estacionamento;
  • Seguro Saúde;
  • Convênio Odontológico;
  • Seguro de Vida e Acidentes Pessoais;
  • Previdência Privada;
  • Assistência a Viagens;
  • Garantia Funeral;
  • Auxílio Creche ou Babá;
  • Convênio com farmácia;
  • Convênio com academia;
  • Happy Day - um dia de folga no aniversário.



Além disso, você encontra por aqui:

  • Trilha de desenvolvimento;
  • Plataforma exclusiva com treinamentos;
  • Diversas parcerias e descontos pela região.


No seu dia-a-dia:


  • Realizar as atividades de vendas corporativas, planos e iniciativas de gestão e relacionamento comercial com clientes diferenciados com médio impacto financeiro, realizando prospecções e ofertas, entendendo necessidades realizando contatos e visitas para mapeamento e/ou monitoramento da qualidade e grau de satisfação dos produtos adquiridos da Seguros Unimed, buscando e avaliando informações que permitam a criação, atendimento a novas demandas e promoção de alterações em contratos/condições comerciais e/ou no desenvolvimento/produção de produtos, assegurando nível de satisfação e continuidade de contratos;
  • Realizar visitas aos clientes, identificar e oferecer através de análise do potencial de negócios do cliente, novos serviços, buscando alavancar negócios de pós vendas, desenvolvendo soluções para renovações e up grade das contas ativas da Cia;
  • Organizar toda a demanda ou processos advindos do escritório regional, corretoras ou a pessoa jurídica, sendo resolutivo, revendo prazos, rotinas e assegurando treinamentos quando identificada a necessidade de melhorias, alinhada ao perfil do cliente;
  • Responsável pelo relacionamento com o cliente, visando assegurar a satisfação, atendimento, fidelização, rentabilização e a retenção dos clientes de todos os segmentos de negócios da Seguros Unimed;
  • Realizar negociações dentro dos padrões e normas definidas pela empresa, através da orientação, análise e validação dos contratos comerciais, acompanhamento e monitoramento dos processos de negociações;
  • Realizar vendas de produtos e soluções, de contas de médio porte e impacto financeiro, buscando o atingimento das metas de vendas, através do acompanhamento dos resultados, elaboração de planos de ações para expansão do mercado e desenvolvimento de novos mercados;
  • Manter cadastro de clientes atualizado, bem como manter-se informado do potencial e situação financeira dos mesmos;
  • Identificar novas demandas externas, quais as necessidades e o potencial do mercado, desenvolvendo novos clientes e buscando continuamente novas oportunidades de negócios para a empresa;
  • Promover e fortalecer a imagem da empresa no mercado, cumprindo a estratégia e plano de ações de marketing, identificando necessidades e oportunidades de divulgação e disseminação dos produtos, soluções e marca, monitorando efetividade das ações mercadológicas;
  • Organizar toda a demanda ou processos advindos do escritório regional, corretoras ou a pessoa jurídica, sendo resolutivo, revendo prazos, rotinas e assegurando treinamentos quando identificada a necessidade de melhorias, alinhada ao perfil do cliente;
  • Acompanhar o desempenho do mercado e da concorrência, procurando conhecer os produtos e a similaridade dos mesmos com os produtos da empresa.;
  • Participar ativamente de programas de melhoria da qualidade dos produtos, serviços e meio ambiente, cumprir as normas internas e de segurança do trabalho;
  • Prestar suporte aos clientes e parceiros, no que se refere às peculiaridades da empresa, contribuindo com a melhoria dos serviços a serem prestados;
  • Buscar a geração de novas oportunidades, mediante identificação dos pontos que podem ser trabalhados no cliente, imaginando e propondo soluções;
  • Contribuir para soluções técnicas e aperfeiçoamento técnico dos produtos através de informações de mercado;
  • Controlar reclamações de clientes, fazendo follow-up na área competente para retorno e devolução rápida, bem como acompanhar a resolução de problemas internos do pós venda;
  • Elaborar relatórios de vendas, especificando os resultados obtidos e mantendo o superior hierárquico informado sobre o andamento das vendas, volume de vendas e tendências futuras do mercado;
  • Cumprir o regulamento interno, normas e procedimentos de saúde, higiene e segurança do trabalho inerentes ao setor, bem como as observações dos requisitos de compliance, observação e o cumprimento das regulamentações atinentes à empresa;
  • Desenvolver outras atividades inerentes ao cargo ou a critério de seu superior imediato, desde que habilitado e estejam de acordo com o seu conhecimento e experiência;




Esperamos de você:

  • Superior completo em Administração de Empresas, Economia ou área afins.
  • Habilitação - CNH (obrigatório);
  • Informática – Pacote Office;
  • Foco em Resultados e Execução;
  • Boa comunicação;


*Importante ter disponibilidade para viagens.



Informações adicionais

  • Vaga extensiva a Pessoa com Deficiência - PcD;
  • Tipo de contrato: CLT
  • Horário de trabalho: de segunda a sexta-feira, comercial flexível;
  • Local de trabalho: Salvador - BA
  • Todos os nossos processos seletivos são totalmente online nas etapas iniciais.


A Seguros Unimed respeita a pluralidade de identidades e trabalha para promover uma cultura inclusiva. Não fazemos distinção de raça, cor, religião, identidade de gênero, orientação sexual, nacionalidade, deficiência ou idade em nenhuma etapa do processo seletivo, reforçando nosso compromisso de uma empresa focada em cooperar e no seu cliente interno e externo.

vagas.title: Desenvolvedor Full Stack SR | Java / React
vagas.description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Desenvolvedor Full Stack SR | Java / React em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Na Stefanini, acreditamos no poder da colaboração. Co-criamos soluções inovadoras em parceria com nossos clientes, combinando tecnologia de ponta, inteligência artificial e a criatividade humana. Estamos na vanguarda da resolução de problemas de negócios, proporcionando impacto real em escala global.


Ao se juntar à Stefanini, você se torna parte de uma jornada global de transformação. Estamos empenhados em criar impacto positivo não apenas nos negócios, mas também na vida de nossos colaboradores. Se você procura uma oportunidade de crescimento profissional em uma empresa que valoriza inovação, respeito, autonomia e parceria, você encontra aqui!

Junte-se a nós e seja parte da mudança!

Responsabilidades e atribuições

O que esperamos que você realize:

  • Liderar o desenho, desenvolvimento e evolução de aplicações e serviços de alta performance utilizando Java e Micronaut .
  • Projetar e implementar arquiteturas baseadas em microsserviços , mensageria e eventos utilizando Kafka .
  • Desenvolver interfaces modernas, responsivas e escaláveis com React e TypeScript .
  • Modelar, otimizar e manter bancos de dados PostgreSQL , garantindo performance e confiabilidade.
  • Definir e implementar padrões de segurança, observabilidade, monitoramento e resiliência em ambientes AWS .
  • Realizar code reviews, garantindo qualidade, manutenibilidade e aderência às melhores práticas de desenvolvimento.
  • Apoiar a investigação e resolução de incidentes, conduzindo análises de causa raiz e ações de melhoria contínua.
  • Atuar como referência técnica para o time, compartilhando conhecimento e apoiando o desenvolvimento de profissionais de diferentes níveis.
  • Participar ativamente de definições arquiteturais e decisões técnicas de longo prazo.

Requisitos e qualificações

O que precisamos que você tenha de conhecimento:

  • Experiência sólida com Java 11+ e frameworks modernos para desenvolvimento de APIs e microsserviços, preferencialmente Micronaut .
  • Domínio de React , TypeScript e conceitos modernos de desenvolvimento Front-End.
  • Experiência avançada com Apache Kafka , incluindo tópicos, partições, consumer groups, estratégias de processamento e arquiteturas orientadas a eventos.
  • Conhecimento aprofundado em PostgreSQL , modelagem de dados, otimização de consultas e performance tuning.
  • Experiência com serviços AWS , incluindo recursos de infraestrutura, integração e monitoramento.
  • Vivência com arquiteturas distribuídas, sistemas escaláveis e padrões de integração.
  • Conhecimento em práticas de CI/CD , testes automatizados e infraestrutura como código.
  • Experiência atuando em projetos de alta complexidade técnica e apoiando decisões arquiteturais.


Diferenciais:

  • Experiência com DataDog, OpenTelemetry, Feature Flags ou ferramentas similares de observabilidade.
  • Conhecimento em DDD (Domain-Driven Design) , CQRS e Event Sourcing .
  • Atuação prévia como Tech Lead ou referência técnica em squads de desenvolvimento.
  • Experiência com arquiteturas distribuídas de alta disponibilidade, tolerância a falhas e ambientes multi-região.




Importante: Para seguirmos com a avaliação técnica dos candidatos, será necessário realizar um teste técnico compatível com as atividades e tecnologias da posição. Essa etapa faz parte do processo seletivo e tem como objetivo avaliar conhecimentos práticos relacionados ao desafio da vaga.

Informações adicionais

Vale-alimentação ou vale-refeição;

Desconto em cursos, universidades e instituições de idiomas;

Academia Stefanini — plataforma com cursos on-line, gratuitos, atualizados e com certificado;

Mentoring;

Clube de vantagens para consultas e exames;

Assistência médica;

vagas.title: Product Owner
vagas.description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Product Owner em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We are looking for a remote, full-time Product Owner with 3-5 years of product owner or technical product manager experience. In this role, you will bridge the client needs and technical execution, managing both high-touch, custom audience requests and the development of the client's syndicated audience products.

As the Product Owner, you must be strategic and detail-oriented as you lead the end-to-end product lifecycle. You will own the \"how\" and \"when\" of our audience delivery, collaborating closely with Data Science, Engineering, and Client Success teams to ensure every segment release is built to specification, rigorously QA'd, and delivered on schedule.

If you are a self-starter who enjoys a fast-paced, dynamic, and autonomous environment and thrives in challenging situations, Collage is the place for you. You will be at the heart of our data engine, directly impacting how our clients understand and reach their customers. This is a high-visibility role where your ability to streamline processes and ensure data integrity will be a key driver of the company's growth.

Our client unleashes the power of culture, driving brand growth with consumer insights, analytics, tools, and best practices for over 250 iconic U.S. brands. Its solutions are fueled by its cultural intelligence platform, which allows its customers to more effectively and efficiently understand, reach, and engage consumers while the U.S. undergoes significant demographic shifts. Brands build cultural fluency to activate consumers across race, ethnicity, generations, gender, and sexual identity.

Our client comprises creative, analytical, diverse, hardworking, and fun individuals with an insatiable curiosity for the new collage of behaviors and patterns driving consumers today. The possibilities of the moment and opportunity to help organizations unlock their cultural capacity inspire them to seek out predictive insights and brand impacts that are unique to their model.


Responsibilities

  • End-to-End Delivery: Own the scoping, building, QA, and release phases for all custom and syndicated audience segments
  • Cross-Functional Leadership: Act as the primary point of contact between stakeholders and the Data Science team responsible for building audiences to translate complex marketing requirements into technical roadmaps
  • Backlog Management: Prioritize the audience creation queue, balancing urgent custom requests from enterprise clients with long-term product goals, including audience pipeline improvements
  • Quality Assurance: Develop and oversee rigorous QA protocols to ensure audience accuracy before release
  • Process Optimization: Continuously refine the audience build workflow to reduce \"time-to-market\" for new segments
  • Market Insight: Stay ahead of trends in MarTech and identity resolution to ensure Collage's segmentation capabilities remain best-in-class


Required Experience

  • Communication Skills : Excellent English communication skills
  • Proven PO Experience :3–5 years of professional experience in a Product Owner or Technical Product Manager role, specifically within an Agile environment
  • MarTech Experience : A deep understanding of the marketing technology ecosystem , specifically regarding audience segmentation, DMPs, CDPs, or programmatic advertising
  • Agile Software: Proficiency in Jira, Monday.com, or Azure DevOps for backlog grooming and sprint planning
  • Data Literacy: Ability to speak \"data\"—comfortable discussing SQL, data schemas, or statistical confidence with technical peers
  • Data Science Collaboration : A track record of successfully managing projects that involve complex data modeling, large datasets, and collaboration with data scientists
  • Project Precision : Demonstrated ability to manage multiple high-stakes projects simultaneously without losing sight of the \"fine print\" during the QA process
  • Stakeholder Influence : Experience navigating the needs of both commercial/sales teams and technical engineering teams to find the optimal path forward
  • High Impact Delivery : Proven delivery experience in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment
  • Soft Skills : Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Desired Experience

  • Marketing Platforms: Familiarity with how audiences are activated in platforms like LiveRamp, Trade Desk, or Facebook Manager


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP

We are a rapidly growing, nearshore company providing expert Latin American resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer expert talent that enjoys taking on challenging work, wants to grow their skills and experiences, and excels in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class, remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!
