Job Title: AI Visual Storytelling Designer/AI Creative Producer


About the Role

Our client company (a US-based Creative Agency) is looking for 2–3 highly creative AI-native talents who can combine generative AI, motion design, video editing, and visual storytelling to create modern, high-performing social content for brands and ventures.


This is not a traditional graphic design or video editing role. We are looking for creatives who deeply understand internet aesthetics, AI-powered workflows, cinematic social visuals, and short-form content that captures attention immediately.


You will work across AI-generated imagery, motion graphics, editing, creative direction, and experimental visual concepts to produce premium content similar to the examples below:

  • Fast-paced visual storytelling
  • AI-generated cinematic visuals
  • Social-first brand content
  • Stylized motion design
  • Creative AI advertising assets
  • Premium/High-end startup and venture-style aesthetics


Responsibilities

  • Create visually compelling AI-powered social content for Instagram and paid ads
  • Produce short-form videos using AI-generated visuals, motion graphics, editing, and sound design
  • Develop creative concepts and visual storytelling ideas from briefs or creative direction
  • Use generative AI tools to create unique imagery, animations, environments, and visual sequences
  • Edit high-quality content with strong pacing, transitions, typography, and cinematic composition
  • Stay up to date with AI creative trends, social content trends, and emerging tools
  • Maintain strong brand aesthetics and visual consistency across projects
  • Iterate quickly and efficiently in a fast-paced startup environment


Ideal Candidate

  • Strong portfolio showcasing AI-generated visuals, motion graphics, or cinematic social content
  • Experience creating modern social-first creative content for startups, agencies, brands, or creators
  • Strong understanding of visual storytelling, pacing, composition, typography, and internet culture
  • Ability to combine creativity with execution speed
  • Self-directed, proactive, and highly collaborative
  • Strong aesthetic taste and attention to detail
  • Comfortable experimenting with new creative workflows and AI tools


Preferred Tools & Skills

Experience with several of the following:

  • Runway

  • Generative AI workflows
  • Motion graphics and animation
  • Short-form content editing
  • Creative direction
  • Storyboarding and concept development
  • Sound design and pacing
  • Brand storytelling


Nice to Have

  • Experience creating paid social creatives or performance marketing content
  • Understanding of viral short-form content frameworks
  • Experience with 3D or experimental visual workflows
  • Familiarity with creative automation workflows

vagas.title: Senior Creative Director
vagas.description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Creative Director em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Creative Director

Talent Global LLC — Remote

Part-Time (10 hrs/week) | US Time Zones | Long-Term Contract


About the Role

Our client is a US-based performance marketing agency that builds and scales creative content for brands across paid social and digital channels. They are looking for a Creative Director to serve as the internal quality gate for all creative output — both video and graphics — before it reaches the client. This person will work closely with the agency's leadership team, taking ownership of creative review, direction, and strategy across active accounts.


Key Responsibilities

  • Review and QA all video and graphic creative assets before client delivery, ensuring quality, brand alignment, and strategic clarity
  • Provide clear, actionable creative direction to designers and video editors based on client briefs and performance goals
  • Develop creative strategies for new content batches — defining concept, visual direction, messaging angle, and format
  • Identify creative weaknesses across active accounts and propose improvements proactively
  • Maintain a high creative bar across all output, with strong attention to detail in both visual execution and storytelling


Requirements

  • Proven experience as a Creative Director, Senior Art Director, or equivalent role at a marketing agency or performance-focused creative team
  • Strong portfolio spanning both video and graphic content — social ads, brand content, or performance creative
  • Ability to both review/direct existing work and develop new creative strategies from scratch
  • Deep understanding of what makes creative perform on paid social channels (Meta, TikTok, YouTube)
  • Experience working with or managing designers and video editors
  • Excellent written and verbal English — able to communicate creative feedback clearly and professionally
  • Self-directed and highly detail-oriented — comfortable working async with a lean team
  • Familiarity with AI creative tools (Midjourney, Runway, or similar) is a plus


Ideal Candidate

This role is for someone who has a natural eye for what's working and what isn't — and can articulate why with precision. They thrive in fast-moving agency environments where standards are high and feedback cycles are tight. They are equally comfortable directing a video edit and reviewing a static ad set, and they understand that creative strategy and execution are inseparable. They don't need to be reminded to raise the bar — they set it.

vagas.description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Talent Acquisitions Specialist em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Company Description

Mosaic Puzzles is a jigsaw puzzle company based in Alpharetta, Georgia. At Mosaic, we design and build unique wooden puzzles where every piece is part of the puzzle’s story. We are a fast-paced startup built by ex-Uber and Amazon employees. Check our website for more information:


Role Description

This is a full time remote role for a Talent Acquisitions Specialist. The Talent Acquisitions Specialist will be responsible for managing the full recruitment cycle, sourcing candidates, conducting interviews, coordinating with hiring managers, and onboarding new employees. Additional tasks include maintaining employee records, providing onboarding administrative support, and supporting the development and implementation of HR initiatives. 


The position follows U.S. Eastern Time business hours, generally Monday through Friday. Working hours will vary slightly throughout the year due to business needs but will typically align with approximately 9:00 AM–6:00 PM EST.


Qualifications

  • C1 or C2 level of English. Candidates below C1 level will not be considered . 
  • 3-8 years experience in recruitment, sourcing candidates, and conducting interviews
  • Skills in employee relations, HR policies, and labor law compliance
  • Strong interpersonal, communication, and organizational skills
  • The ability to maintain clear, consistent communication with hiring managers and internal stakeholders regarding the status of active searches, candidate pipelines, timelines, and next steps.
  • Proficiency in HR software and Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS)
  • Ability to manage multiple sourcing channels simultaneously, including alternative platforms and outreach methods beyond traditional job boards.
  • Analytical skills with attention to detail
  • Ability to work independently and remotely
  • Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related field required


Mosaic Cultural Values Alignment:

The ideal candidate will embody Mosaic’s cultural values, including:

  • Owner’s Mindset: Working hard, helping others, and proactively contributing.
  • Process Orientation: Showing your work and thinking ahead.
  • Moving Quickly: Taking initiative and being proactive.
  • Taking Responsibility: Owning your actions.
  • Valuing Ideas Over Hierarchy: Contributing creatively and openly.
  • Continuous Improvement: Always seeking better ways to work.
  • Doing the Right Thing: Acting with integrity.
  • Believing in Meritocracy: Recognizing and rewarding performance.
  • Resourcefulness: Finding cost-effective and practical solutions.


How to Apply:

Interested candidates must submit their resumes in English (Resumes in other languages will not be considered).

Location: Brazil/Remote

Contract: Permanent / Freelance

Experience Level: Senior

Language: English and Portuguese



Mission Overview

We are looking for a Senior Warehouse Automation Specialist to lead the design, implementation, and optimization of advanced automation solutions within distribution and logistics environments.

You will act as a key System Engineer , bridging operational needs with cutting-edge technologies such as robotics, RTLS (Real-Time Locating Systems), and machine vision systems to drive efficiency, accuracy, and scalability.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives in complex environments and enjoys combining technical expertise, data analysis, and project leadership to transform warehouse operations.


Key Responsibilities

System Design & Implementation

  • Design and deploy automated warehouse systems (AS/RS, conveyors, AGVs, robotic picking solutions)
  • Integrate RTLS solutions for real-time tracking of assets and inventory
  • Lead end-to-end system architecture aligned with operational requirements

Technical Optimization & Performance

  • Analyze workflows and system performance to identify bottlenecks
  • Implement data-driven improvements to maximize throughput and efficiency
  • Optimize warehouse execution systems (WES), warehouse management systems (WMS), and automation tools

Maintenance & Troubleshooting

  • Monitor and ensure high availability of automation systems (robotics, sensors, vision systems)

  • Maintain system documentation and continuous improvement processes

Project Management & Delivery

  • Lead or contribute to automation projects from concept to deployment
  • Coordinate with cross-functional teams (operations, IT, engineering)

Training & Change Management

  • Provide training and documentation for system usage and best practices

Safety & Compliance

  • Ensure all systems comply with safety standards and industry regulations
  • Contribute to improving workplace safety and ergonomics


Required Qualifications

  • 7+ years of experience in warehouse automation, system engineering, or industrial automation
  • Proven experience with RTLS (Real-Time Locating Systems)
  • Strong background in machine vision systems
  • Hands-on experience with:
  • WMS / WES systems
  • Robotics, AGVs, or automated material handling systems
  • Solid understanding of electro-mechanical systems, sensors, and control systems
  • Willingness and ability to travel regularly (nationally and/or internationally) to support project deployments and client sites


Nice to Have

  • Portuguese knowledge


Key Skills

Creative Video Editor - DTC Brand


Location: Fully Remote (must be based in LATAM)

Job Type: Full-Time


Create scroll-stopping content for a scaling DTC brand. We need a performance-focused video editor who can turn raw footage into high-converting ads and social content - with creative freedom and direct feedback loops on what's working.


About Uproot Clean

Uproot Clean is a fast-growing, eco-friendly pet care brand expanding across major retailers like Walmart, Target, and Chewy. Our marketing team is scaling rapidly, and we're looking for a video editor who wants to grow their skills in performance marketing while building a long-term role with a mission-driven company.


The Role

You'll be our go-to editor for short-form video content that drives sales—think Facebook/Instagram ads, TikTok content, and social clips. You'll work with a steady flow of creator and product footage, turning it into thumb-stopping content that performs. This isn't agency churn-and-burn; you'll see what converts, iterate based on data, and refine your craft with real-time feedback.


What You'll Do

Video Editing & Production

  • Create high-performing Facebook/Instagram ad creatives and social media clips
  • Edit short-form content optimized for platform-specific formats
  • Source and organize B-roll and stock footage using the provided subscriptions
  • Manage creator content in Frame.io and maintain organized asset libraries

Graphic Design & Assets

  • Design marketing images, thumbnails, and social graphics
  • Create on-brand visual assets using Photoshop, Illustrator, or Canva

Project Management

  • Track assignments and status updates in ClickUp
  • Follow naming conventions and file organization protocols
  • Communicate proactively about timelines, blockers, and questions


Requirements

  • 3-5+ years of video editing experience, specializing in short-form content
  • Expert-level Adobe Premiere Pro skills (required)
  • Proven experience creating or editing Facebook/Instagram ads
  • Mid-level proficiency with Photoshop, Illustrator, or Canva
  • Strong fundamentals in typography, color theory, composition, and motion graphics
  • Fluent English — excellent written and verbal communication
  • Self-managed — strong time management and ability to meet daily/weekly deadlines
  • Proactive communicator — asks questions early, flags issues before they become problems
  • Portfolio required — you must submit a portfolio showcasing your video editing work. Applications without portfolios will not be considered.

vagas.description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Creative Director em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Creative Director

Talent Global LLC — Remote

Part-Time (10 hrs/week) | US Time Zones | Long-Term Contract


About the Role

Our client is a US-based performance marketing agency that builds and scales creative content for brands across paid social and digital channels. They are looking for a Creative Director to serve as the internal quality gate for all creative output — both video and graphics — before it reaches the client. This person will work closely with the agency's leadership team, taking ownership of creative review, direction, and strategy across active accounts.


Key Responsibilities

  • Review and QA all video and graphic creative assets before client delivery, ensuring quality, brand alignment, and strategic clarity
  • Provide clear, actionable creative direction to designers and video editors based on client briefs and performance goals
  • Develop creative strategies for new content batches — defining concept, visual direction, messaging angle, and format
  • Identify creative weaknesses across active accounts and propose improvements proactively
  • Maintain a high creative bar across all output, with strong attention to detail in both visual execution and storytelling


Requirements

  • Proven experience as a Creative Director, Senior Art Director, or equivalent role at a marketing agency or performance-focused creative team
  • Strong portfolio spanning both video and graphic content — social ads, brand content, or performance creative
  • Ability to both review/direct existing work and develop new creative strategies from scratch
  • Deep understanding of what makes creative perform on paid social channels (Meta, TikTok, YouTube)
  • Experience working with or managing designers and video editors
  • Excellent written and verbal English — able to communicate creative feedback clearly and professionally
  • Self-directed and highly detail-oriented — comfortable working async with a lean team
  • Familiarity with AI creative tools (Midjourney, Runway, or similar) is a plus


Ideal Candidate

This role is for someone who has a natural eye for what's working and what isn't — and can articulate why with precision. They thrive in fast-moving agency environments where standards are high and feedback cycles are tight. They are equally comfortable directing a video edit and reviewing a static ad set, and they understand that creative strategy and execution are inseparable. They don't need to be reminded to raise the bar — they set it.

Confira esta oportunidade para Senior .Net Engineer (WFH) em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Senior .Net Engineer


Resume: English Version only. Resume should have detailed discussion of project overview and job description. Highlight the following if applicable - Maui (Blazor, Razor, Xamarin); Healthcare projects; HIPAA knowledge; SAAS projects; US-based projects

Role: Full time contractor; Fully Remote

Work Hours : US time zone

Location: Brazil

Rate: R$20,000-22,000 per month


About the Company

We are a forward-thinking technology organization dedicated to developing innovative software solutions that improve outcomes for clients and end-users. Our engineering team designs, builds, and maintains scalable, high-quality applications that drive efficiency and innovation across industries. We are seeking an experienced Level III Software Engineer (contractor) to join our distributed team, contributing to complex projects with a focus on code quality, security, and collaboration.


Position Overview

As a Level III Software Engineer (contractor), you will apply your technical expertise to deliver high-quality code for moderately to highly complex projects. Working remotely with a U.S.-based team, you'll gain deep system knowledge and contribute to an Agile development workflow using Azure DevOps.

You will begin with automated testing and peer reviews, expanding into broader development tasks by months 2–3. The role will continue to evolve based on your strengths and project needs, while maintaining rigorous adherence to coding and security standards.


Key Responsibilities

  • Product Design & Development: Collaborate with stakeholders to design and implement software solutions aligned with technical and business objectives.
  • Code Contributions: Write, optimize, and maintain efficient code, including enhancement of existing codebases, beginning around months 3–4.
  • Testing & Quality: Design and implement automated end-to-end (E2E) tests (e.g., using Microsoft Playwright) to ensure feature stability—especially during the first 6–9 months.
  • Peer Reviews: Participate in pre-release feature reviews and early post-release bug analysis (first 90 days), transitioning to broader ownership over time.
  • Agile Workflow Participation: Actively contribute to sprints, pull requests, and releases within a 2-week sprint / 6-week release cycle using Azure DevOps.
  • Collaboration: Communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical team members across multiple time zones.


Qualifications


Experience

  • 5–8 years of software engineering experience with a demonstrated record of success on complex projects.


Technical Skills

  • Proficiency in C# ASP.NET (.NET 8) for web applications and APIs.
  • Experience with .NET MAUI and Blazor Web Applications (.NET 8) , leveraging web expertise for cross-platform or mobile development.
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Azure services, including Azure App Service, Azure SQL, and Azure Storage.
  • Strong understanding of modern development tools (e.g., Visual Studio, Git, Azure DevOps).
  • Knowledge of secure coding practices and general cybersecurity principles.
  • Experience with cloud platforms and Agile methodologies .


Soft Skills

  • Excellent problem-solving and analytical abilities.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills for remote collaboration.
  • Ability to work independently and within a collaborative team environment.


Preferred

  • Experience with regulated or data-sensitive software environments (e.g., healthcare, financial services, HIPAA, PHI).
  • Prior experience conducting pull-request reviews and participating in Agile sprints.


What We Offer

  • Opportunity to work on impactful, large-scale technology projects.
  • Collaborative, high-performance engineering culture focused on quality and innovation.
  • Flexible remote work environment with a structured onboarding process for success.


How We Work

  • Agile Workflow: Two-week sprints within a six-week release cycle, including daily stand-ups (3:00 PM CT), sprint planning, and reviews.
  • Code Standards: Strict adherence to best practices, peer reviews, and security testing (e.g., OWASP, Detectify).
  • Tool Stack: Azure DevOps, Visual Studio, SQL Server Management Studio, Datadog, Microsoft Playwright, and related technologies.
  • Team Culture: A focus on accountability, collaboration, and excellence in delivery.

• Working knowledge of AWS

• Experience of working in a cloud native environment

• Practical use of Jira and confluence

vagas.title: Talent Acquisition Partner
vagas.description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Talent Acquisition Partner em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Talent Acquisition Partner (Active Sourcing)


Location: Fully Remote (Must be based in LATAM)

Job Type: Full-Time



About Uproot Clean

Uproot Clean is a fast-growing consumer products company with more than 5 million customers using our products. Our products are sold not only through DTC and Amazon, but also through major retailers, including Walmart, Target, and Petco, along with more than 10,000 retail doors across the country. Uproot has also been featured across major television and media platforms, including QVC, Good Morning America, and Fox, helping introduce millions of consumers to the brand.

We care deeply about building products that genuinely solve problems for pet owners while operating with high standards across every part of the business. We are building a company focused on long-term excellence, creating significant opportunities for highly capable people who want real and meaningful impact, and the ability to help shape the future of the company.

About the Role

This is a hands-on execution role focused 100% on active sourcing. You will proactively identify and engage high-quality talent across multiple functions and seniority levels using multiple sourcing channels, advanced search techniques, and thoughtful outreach.

Success requires high-output execution, strong judgment, persistence, excellent communication, and the ability to operate with urgency in a fast-moving environment.



Responsibilities


Active Sourcing

  • Proactively source candidates across multiple job boards, platforms, and sourcing channels
  • Use advanced Boolean search techniques to identify strong talent
  • Build pipelines across multiple functions and seniority levels
  • Identify strong passive candidates
  • Partner closely with recruiting and hiring managers to align on hiring needs.

Candidate Outreach

  • Write outbound messaging that drives candidate engagement
  • Qualify candidates early in the process
  • Move qualified candidates into the recruiting workflow

Pipeline Management

  • Maintain organized sourcing workflows and candidate tracking
  • Continuously improve sourcing strategies and outreach quality
  • Continuously iterate on sourcing methods, messaging, and targeting

What Success Looks Like

  • Consistently builds high-quality candidate pipelines
  • Surfaces strong candidates quickly across multiple functions
  • Generates strong response and assessment completion rates
  • Operates with speed, consistency, and minimal oversight
  • Raises the overall talent bar of the company over time


Requirements

Must Have

  • 1+ year of full-time active sourcing experience - mandatory
  • Experience sourcing across multiple job boards and sourcing platforms
  • Strong outbound recruiting and candidate outreach skills
  • Experience using advanced Boolean search techniques
  • Excellent written English communication skills
  • Ability to manage multiple open searches simultaneously

Strong Plus

  • Experience sourcing across multiple functions and seniority levels
  • Experience in high-growth, e-commerce, or performance-driven companies
  • Familiarity with LinkedIn Recruiter and modern sourcing tools

Work Requirements

⏰ Schedule: Monday-Friday, 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM EST

Workspace: Fixed, professional setup (no digital nomads)

Output: Daily briefs and feedback loops (high consistency required)


Who This Role Is For (& Not For)

This Role Is For You If:

  • You enjoy the challenge of finding exceptional people before anyone else does
  • You are naturally proactive and internally driven
  • You move quickly, stay organized, and maintain high standards
  • You enjoy performance-oriented environments with accountability
  • You think recruiting is a high-leverage business function, not administrative work
  • You enjoy improving systems, processes, and sourcing quality over time

This Role Is NOT For You If:

  • You need constant direction or external motivation
  • You struggle with consistency and follow-through
  • You are uncomfortable persuading passive candidates
  • You treat recruiting as scheduling and coordination only


Compensation & Benefits

Uproot Clean is a high ownership, high accountability environment with high standards for communication, speed, execution, and quality. We care far more about ability, judgment, and ownership than credentials or years of experience.

  • Salary : Competitive base salary + performance-based bonus structure
  • Significant autonomy with the ability to directly influence the company’s growth and direction
  • Fully remote : work from anywhere
  • PTO : 2 Weeks
  • Flex Day : An additional quarterly day off dedicated to rest and recovery
  • Thinking Day: one dedicated day each quarter to step away from day-to-day execution and think deeply about your role, systems, ideas, and long-term impact
  • Wellness Reimbursement: $100-$300/month, based on location, to help support your wellness.
  • Pet Reimbursement: $40-100/month, based on location to help support parenting a pet.
  • Coaching credits: $1,000+/year for coaching, education, and professional development


Ready to Apply?

If you are excited by high standards, proactive recruiting, and the challenge of building world-class talent pipelines, we’d love to hear from you.

vagas.title: Senior Software Engineer (Go)
vagas.description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Software Engineer (Go) em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Together with the Zoolatech team, our partner, a leading construction management company, is at the forefront of developing a cloud-based software solution. This innovative platform is instrumental in the successful completion of major projects including skyscrapers, hospitals, data centers, stadiums, and schools. It streamlines the management of finances, quality, teams, and risks, making these processes transparent, convenient, and regulation-compliant. Our partner is not only an expert in construction management but also a significant technology innovator, actively developing web and mobile solutions.


Currently Directory business unit owns user identity and access management across their entire platform ecosystem. They've just launched a brand-new Go-based service into closed beta — a ground-up rebuild of how users and companies are managed across the platform. It's live, but not yet actively used. The work ahead is substantial: migrating data and business logic out of a Ruby monolith, building new features in parallel, and accelerating the service toward full production ownership. Now we are looking for reinforcement for the team to develop the new service and help with the migration from the legacy platform.


Responsibilities

  • Build and maintain backend services in Go, implementing event-driven systems governed by CQRS and event sourcing patterns
  • Drive migration of business logic and data from the Ruby legacy monolith into the new Go service
  • Contribute to the new service while it moves from closed beta toward becoming authoritative — building ongoing features in parallel with migration
  • Develop and extend GraphQL Federation schemas that power the federated API gateway
  • Partner with Engineering, Product, and UX to design and build solutions that address user and company management challenges
  • Use a systems engineering approach to make technical design decisions that improve scalability, performance, and reliability
  • Write highly performant code that supports a distributed, multi-tenant SaaS architecture
  • Conduct code reviews, provide mentorship, and actively drive engineering excellence across the team
  • Communicate complex technical problems and solutions clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders


Skills Required

  • 5+ years in Software Engineering across full-stack distributed applications
  • 3+ years of hands-on Go in production microservices
  • Experience with CQRS and event sourcing patterns
  • Experience with Kafka or similar distributed event streaming platforms
  • Experience with PostgreSQL, including data modeling and query optimization
  • Familiarity with GraphQL, including schema design
  • Working knowledge of React and TypeScript for frontend contributions
  • Comfort working across the full development lifecycle: design, testing, staging, deployment, monitoring
  • Strong communication skills — ability to collaborate across US and international time zones
  • US time zone or compatible overlap (EST/CST);

Would be a huge plus:

  • Experience with Ruby/Rails systems, including incremental refactoring and modernization


Engagement Model: Direct Independent Contractor (Please read carefully)


This is an independent contractor opportunity based on a direct contractual relationship between Zoolatech and the individual service provider.


To facilitate this direct partnership, we engage with professionals who are registered and operate as a sole proprietorship, private entrepreneur, or an equivalent self-employment status in your country.


Please note, our model does not accommodate contracts through third-party intermediaries such as agencies, incubators, or umbrella companies. The essential requirement is your ability to enter into a service agreement and invoice Zoolatech directly. This is not an offer of direct employment


Please note that only candidates whose profiles closely match our requirements will be contacted.

Job Title: Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) / Infrastructure Operations MID LEVEL


Role Overview

Responsible for managing day-to-day infrastructure operations, including monitoring, alerting, and driving stability improvements across the environment.


Key Responsibilities

  • Monitor overall infrastructure health and system performance
  • Track key performance metrics such as CPU, memory, and disk utilization
  • Tune alerts to improve signal-to-noise ratio and reduce alert fatigue
  • Support disaster recovery (DR) rehearsals and readiness activities
  • Maintain and update runbooks, documentation, and operational reports


Required Experience

  • 4–6 years of experience in Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) or infrastructure operations
  • Hands-on experience with VMware environments
  • Experience with monitoring tools such as PRTG, Datadog, or similar platforms
  • Strong incident management experience, including response and resolution processes


Core Skills & Competencies

  • Solid understanding of infrastructure performance metrics (CPU, memory, disk, etc.)
  • Experience with alert tuning and optimization
  • Ability to proactively detect and troubleshoot performance issues
  • Strong incident management and operational response capabilities


Screening Signals

Look for candidates who:

  • Understand CPU Ready thresholds and their impact on performance
  • Have hands-on experience tuning alerts to reduce noise
  • Can proactively identify and resolve performance bottlenecks
  • Demonstrate strong incident management experience in production environments

  • Hands-on experience with AI-assisted development tools
  • Experience with workflow automation and process orchestration
  • Strong understanding of APIs, integrations, and modern application architectures

Experience in several of the following areas is preferred:

  • .NET/ C#
  • Node.js
  • React

Fully remote within Brazil

vagas.title: Talent Acquisition Partner
vagas.description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Talent Acquisition Partner em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Talent Acquisition Partner (Active Sourcing)


Location: Fully Remote (Must be based in LATAM)

Job Type: Full-Time



About Uproot Clean

Uproot Clean is a fast-growing consumer products company with more than 5 million customers using our products. Our products are sold not only through DTC and Amazon, but also through major retailers, including Walmart, Target, and Petco, along with more than 10,000 retail doors across the country. Uproot has also been featured across major television and media platforms, including QVC, Good Morning America, and Fox, helping introduce millions of consumers to the brand.

We care deeply about building products that genuinely solve problems for pet owners while operating with high standards across every part of the business. We are building a company focused on long-term excellence, creating significant opportunities for highly capable people who want real and meaningful impact, and the ability to help shape the future of the company.

About the Role

This is a hands-on execution role focused 100% on active sourcing. You will proactively identify and engage high-quality talent across multiple functions and seniority levels using multiple sourcing channels, advanced search techniques, and thoughtful outreach.

Success requires high-output execution, strong judgment, persistence, excellent communication, and the ability to operate with urgency in a fast-moving environment.



Responsibilities


Active Sourcing

  • Proactively source candidates across multiple job boards, platforms, and sourcing channels
  • Use advanced Boolean search techniques to identify strong talent
  • Build pipelines across multiple functions and seniority levels
  • Identify strong passive candidates
  • Partner closely with recruiting and hiring managers to align on hiring needs.

Candidate Outreach

  • Write outbound messaging that drives candidate engagement
  • Qualify candidates early in the process
  • Move qualified candidates into the recruiting workflow

Pipeline Management

  • Maintain organized sourcing workflows and candidate tracking
  • Continuously improve sourcing strategies and outreach quality
  • Continuously iterate on sourcing methods, messaging, and targeting

What Success Looks Like

  • Consistently builds high-quality candidate pipelines
  • Surfaces strong candidates quickly across multiple functions
  • Generates strong response and assessment completion rates
  • Operates with speed, consistency, and minimal oversight
  • Raises the overall talent bar of the company over time


Requirements

Must Have

  • 1+ year of full-time active sourcing experience - mandatory
  • Experience sourcing across multiple job boards and sourcing platforms
  • Strong outbound recruiting and candidate outreach skills
  • Experience using advanced Boolean search techniques
  • Excellent written English communication skills
  • Ability to manage multiple open searches simultaneously

Strong Plus

  • Experience sourcing across multiple functions and seniority levels
  • Experience in high-growth, e-commerce, or performance-driven companies
  • Familiarity with LinkedIn Recruiter and modern sourcing tools

Work Requirements

⏰ Schedule: Monday-Friday, 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM EST

Workspace: Fixed, professional setup (no digital nomads)

Output: Daily briefs and feedback loops (high consistency required)


Who This Role Is For (& Not For)

This Role Is For You If:

  • You enjoy the challenge of finding exceptional people before anyone else does
  • You are naturally proactive and internally driven
  • You move quickly, stay organized, and maintain high standards
  • You enjoy performance-oriented environments with accountability
  • You think recruiting is a high-leverage business function, not administrative work
  • You enjoy improving systems, processes, and sourcing quality over time

This Role Is NOT For You If:

  • You need constant direction or external motivation
  • You struggle with consistency and follow-through
  • You are uncomfortable persuading passive candidates
  • You treat recruiting as scheduling and coordination only


Compensation & Benefits

Uproot Clean is a high ownership, high accountability environment with high standards for communication, speed, execution, and quality. We care far more about ability, judgment, and ownership than credentials or years of experience.

  • Salary : Competitive base salary + performance-based bonus structure
  • Significant autonomy with the ability to directly influence the company’s growth and direction
  • Fully remote : work from anywhere
  • PTO : 2 Weeks
  • Flex Day : An additional quarterly day off dedicated to rest and recovery
  • Thinking Day: one dedicated day each quarter to step away from day-to-day execution and think deeply about your role, systems, ideas, and long-term impact
  • Wellness Reimbursement: $100-$300/month, based on location, to help support your wellness.
  • Pet Reimbursement: $40-100/month, based on location to help support parenting a pet.
  • Coaching credits: $1,000+/year for coaching, education, and professional development


Ready to Apply?

If you are excited by high standards, proactive recruiting, and the challenge of building world-class talent pipelines, we’d love to hear from you.

vagas.title: Subject Matter Expert - Finance
vagas.description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Subject Matter Expert - Finance em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L


Role Overview:

We’re hiring finance professionals who know AP, AR, accounting close, or finance systems inside-out — and want to help shape how AI understands finance workflows.

In this role, you’ll use your real-world experience with QuickBooks, Bill.com, and Concur to create realistic finance scenarios, evaluate AI outputs, and improve the accuracy of next-generation AI systems.


What does day-to-day life look like?

  • Create finance workflow prompts and real-world accounting scenarios
  • Review and evaluate AI-generated responses for accuracy and reasoning
  • Build synthetic invoices, bills, reconciliations, and GL datasets
  • Identify edge cases such as duplicate bills, sync failures, policy violations, and GAAP errors
  • Help improve AI performance across finance operations and controls


We're looking for:

Professionals with hands-on experience in one or more of the following:

  • Accounts Payable
  • Accounts Receivable
  • Accounting & Month-End Close
  • Controller / Finance Management
  • Finance Systems Administration


Requirements:

  • 4–12 years of finance/accounting experience
  • Strong working knowledge of QuickBooks, Bill.com, and/or Concur
  • Understanding of US GAAP and finance controls
  • Excellent written communication skills
  • Comfortable using AI tools like ChatGPT or Claude
  • CPA/CMA preferred (required for Controller-level roles)


Nice to have:

  • Experience with AI evaluation, RLHF, or LLM projects
  • ERP migrations, multi-entity or multi-currency exposure
  • Basic Python or SQL skills


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Work at the intersection of Finance + AI
  • Influence how AI systems reason about accounting workflows


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required: 40 hours per week with overlap of 4 hours with PST.
  • Engagement Type: Contractor assignment (no medical/paid leave)
  • Duration of contract : 4 weeks; (expected start date is next week)

Job Title: AI Visual Storytelling Designer/AI Creative Producer


About the Role

Our client company (a US-based Creative Agency) is looking for 2–3 highly creative AI-native talents who can combine generative AI, motion design, video editing, and visual storytelling to create modern, high-performing social content for brands and ventures.


This is not a traditional graphic design or video editing role. We are looking for creatives who deeply understand internet aesthetics, AI-powered workflows, cinematic social visuals, and short-form content that captures attention immediately.


You will work across AI-generated imagery, motion graphics, editing, creative direction, and experimental visual concepts to produce premium content similar to the examples below:

  • Fast-paced visual storytelling
  • AI-generated cinematic visuals
  • Social-first brand content
  • Stylized motion design
  • Creative AI advertising assets
  • Premium/High-end startup and venture-style aesthetics


Responsibilities

  • Create visually compelling AI-powered social content for Instagram and paid ads
  • Produce short-form videos using AI-generated visuals, motion graphics, editing, and sound design
  • Develop creative concepts and visual storytelling ideas from briefs or creative direction
  • Use generative AI tools to create unique imagery, animations, environments, and visual sequences
  • Edit high-quality content with strong pacing, transitions, typography, and cinematic composition
  • Stay up to date with AI creative trends, social content trends, and emerging tools
  • Maintain strong brand aesthetics and visual consistency across projects
  • Iterate quickly and efficiently in a fast-paced startup environment

Senior Software Engineer (Full Stack)

Location: Remote

Experience: 7+ Years


About the Role

We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer (Full Stack) to join a high-performing engineering team focused on delivering exceptional customer experiences and building scalable software solutions. This role offers the opportunity to work on complex technical challenges, contribute to strategic initiatives, and collaborate with cross-functional teams in a fast-paced environment.

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will serve as both a hands-on developer and technical leader, helping drive engineering excellence, mentoring team members, and contributing to the evolution of the platform and architecture.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, test, and maintain scalable, high-quality software solutions.
  • Build and enhance customer-facing web applications and services.
  • Collaborate with product managers, designers, and engineers to deliver business-critical features.
  • Participate in technical design discussions and contribute to architectural decisions.
  • Review code and provide constructive feedback to peers.
  • Mentor engineers through collaboration, pair programming, and knowledge sharing.
  • Deploy, monitor, and support applications in production environments.
  • Continuously evaluate and adopt modern technologies and engineering best practices.

Required Qualifications

  • 7+ years of professional software development experience.
  • Strong proficiency in Java and/or Kotlin.
  • Experience working in Ruby on Rails environments.
  • Expertise in JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML, and CSS.
  • Strong experience with React and related front-end technologies.
  • Experience with Node.js and modern development tooling.
  • Familiarity with RESTful APIs, Git, version control systems, and deployment processes.
  • Understanding of GraphQL, event-driven architectures, and database design concepts.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration abilities.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Kafka or other event-streaming platforms.
  • Experience working with Elixir.
  • Experience decomposing monolithic applications into microservices.
  • Familiarity with distributed systems and service-oriented architectures.
  • Experience building scalable applications in cloud environments.

Technical Environment

  • Java
  • Kotlin
  • TypeScript
  • React
  • GraphQL
  • Kafka
  • AWS Lambda
  • PostgreSQL
  • DynamoDB
  • Ruby on Rails
  • Elixir

  • Sobre a SolutionMall

A SolutionMall é uma plataforma global B2B de entrega de produtos e soluções integradas, atendendo necessidades em energia, sistemas elétricos, infraestrutura, telecomunicações, data centers, instalações industriais, equipamentos técnicos e projetos institucionais.

Diferente das plataformas tradicionais que apenas exibem produtos, a SolutionMall se concentra na entrega estruturada de soluções. Apoiamos clientes na clarificação de requisitos, seleção de produtos, coordenação técnica, suporte a RFQ, coordenação de cotações, acompanhamento de entrega e suporte de projetos de longo prazo.

No setor de energia e sistemas elétricos, a SolutionMall pode apoiar necessidades relacionadas a:

Sistemas de energia e distribuição elétrica

Equipamentos elétricos industriais e comerciais

UPS e sistemas de energia de backup

Baterias e soluções de armazenamento de energia

Cabos, conectores e materiais elétricos auxiliares

Sistemas de aterramento e proteção contra descargas atmosféricas

Equipamentos para telecomunicações e data centers

Instrumentos de teste, medição e manutenção elétrica

Soluções de energia para instalações industriais e comerciais

Pacotes integrados de soluções para projetos de energia e infraestrutura

Estamos procurando um Engenheiro de Sistemas de Energia – Brasil para apoiar o desenvolvimento técnico e a coordenação de projetos da SolutionMall no mercado brasileiro.

Esta é uma função flexível baseada em cooperação, adequada para profissionais com experiência em sistemas de energia, engenharia elétrica, distribuição elétrica, UPS, baterias, aterramento, proteção contra descargas atmosféricas, cabos, telecomunicações, data centers, instalações industriais, manutenção elétrica ou projetos de infraestrutura.

A função tem como foco compreender necessidades técnicas dos clientes, apoiar a seleção de produtos, revisar requisitos de projetos, auxiliar no desenvolvimento de RFQ, coordenar informações técnicas e ajudar a SolutionMall a promover soluções adequadas de energia e sistemas elétricos no Brasil.

Não se trata apenas de uma função operacional ou de manutenção diária. É uma função B2B de suporte técnico, coordenação de soluções e desenvolvimento de oportunidades, focada em clientes industriais, empreiteiras, distribuidores, integradores, empresas de telecomunicações, data centers, instalações comerciais e projetos de infraestrutura.

Suporte técnico para sistemas elétricos

• Experiência prática com Docker e ferramentas de orquestração.

• Conhecimento em administração de bancos de dados MySQL (backups, otimização e migrações).

• Capacidade de desenvolver scripts de automação em Python ou Bash.

vagas.title: Subject Matter Expert - Banking
vagas.description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Subject Matter Expert - Banking em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Turing

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L


Role Overview

We’re hiring banking and fintech professionals with hands-on experience across Chase, PayPal, Venmo, and Mint to evaluate AI systems handling payments, disputes, fraud, and personal finance scenarios.


What does day-to-day life look like?

  • Create banking and payments workflow prompts
  • Build synthetic transaction, dispute, and reconciliation scenarios
  • Evaluate AI responses for accuracy and compliance
  • Identify issues like failed transfers, fraud false positives, and sync failures


Requirements

  • 4–9+ years in banking, fintech, fraud ops, merchant payments, or personal finance
  • Experience with Chase, PayPal, Venmo, Mint, or related platforms
  • Understanding of consumer banking regulations (Reg E, Reg Z, AML/KYC)
  • Strong analytical and written communication skills
  • Comfort using AI tools like ChatGPT or Claude


Nice to have

  • Experience with Stripe, Square, Cash App, Plaid, or Robinhood
  • AI evaluation or RLHF experience
  • Knowledge of fintech integrations and data aggregation


Perks of Freelancing With Turing

  • Work in a fully remote environment.


Offer Details

  • Commitments Required: 40 hours per week with overlap of 4 hours with PST.
  • Engagement Type: Contractor assignment (no medical/paid leave)
  • Duration of contract : 4 weeks; (expected start date is next week)

We're hiring account managers who'd rather grow a customer than keep one.


R$181,130 to R$524,000 CAD | Remote Brazil | Unlimited PTO


WeTransact is looking for an Account Manager to join our growing team.


Your Mission

  • Own the account after go-live : You're the customer's main point of contact once they're live and transactable, and you're accountable for their revenue growth on the marketplace.
  • Advise on the right path : You assess where each ISV is and recommend the program or plan that moves them forward, from IP Co-sell eligibility to Certified Software status to new channels.
  • Drive adoption into revenue : You implement the work that converts a live listing into transactions: CRM integration, Crossbeam setup, sales comp parity, and Microsoft incentives.
  • Challenge the customer : When results aren't there, you challenge their structure and bring them a revised plan rather than a status update.
  • Navigating the Microsoft Field : You connect customers to the right AEs and PDMs and build the co-sell motion that moves deals.
  • Compounding with AI : AI is part of your daily workflow across research, QBR prep, and pipeline. This isn't a perk we offer, it's how we operate.


What We're Looking For

  • +4 years in sales at a B2B tech company. Quota-carrying, with a track record of growing accounts. CSM or account management background is a plus, not a substitute.
  • You think in revenue. Adoption is the means, not the metric.
  • English fluent. You present to Customer or Microsoft stakeholders in English without prep.
  • Daily, instinctive use of AI tools.
  • Comfortable being the one who tells a customer their approach isn't working — and what to do instead.
  • You manage 30+ accounts without dropping the ball.


What You Get

  • Unlimited PTO.
  • AI-first culture across the business.
  • Direct access to Microsoft teams and the partner ecosystem most companies spend years trying to reach.
  • Real ownership of a revenue book, measured in outcomes not activity.
  • Path to senior measured in quarters, not years.
  • Global team in more than 12 countries with a strong culture.


About WeTransact

Most companies in our space raise tens of millions and burn it chasing this market. We bootstrapped, turned a profit, and built the software that 500+ companies now use to sell through Microsoft. Titles don't matter here. Accountability does, and so does winning as a team.

vagas.title: Senior Warehouse Automation Specialist
vagas.description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Warehouse Automation Specialist em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Location: Brazil/Remote

Contract: Permanent / Freelance

Experience Level: Senior

Language: English and Portuguese



Mission Overview

We are looking for a Senior Warehouse Automation Specialist to lead the design, implementation, and optimization of advanced automation solutions within distribution and logistics environments.

You will act as a key System Engineer , bridging operational needs with cutting-edge technologies such as robotics, RTLS (Real-Time Locating Systems), and machine vision systems to drive efficiency, accuracy, and scalability.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives in complex environments and enjoys combining technical expertise, data analysis, and project leadership to transform warehouse operations.


Key Responsibilities

System Design & Implementation

  • Design and deploy automated warehouse systems (AS/RS, conveyors, AGVs, robotic picking solutions)
  • Integrate RTLS solutions for real-time tracking of assets and inventory
  • Lead end-to-end system architecture aligned with operational requirements

Technical Optimization & Performance

  • Analyze workflows and system performance to identify bottlenecks
  • Implement data-driven improvements to maximize throughput and efficiency
  • Optimize warehouse execution systems (WES), warehouse management systems (WMS), and automation tools

Maintenance & Troubleshooting

  • Monitor and ensure high availability of automation systems (robotics, sensors, vision systems)
  • Diagnose and resolve system issues across hardware and software layers
  • Maintain system documentation and continuous improvement processes

Project Management & Delivery

  • Lead or contribute to automation projects from concept to deployment
  • Coordinate with cross-functional teams (operations, IT, engineering)
  • Ensure minimal disruption to live operations during implementation

Training & Change Management

  • Support operational teams in adopting new technologies
  • Provide training and documentation for system usage and best practices

Safety & Compliance

  • Ensure all systems comply with safety standards and industry regulations
  • Contribute to improving workplace safety and ergonomics


Required Qualifications

  • 7+ years of experience in warehouse automation, system engineering, or industrial automation
  • Proven experience with RTLS (Real-Time Locating Systems)
  • Strong background in machine vision systems
  • Hands-on experience with:
  • WMS / WES systems
  • Robotics, AGVs, or automated material handling systems
  • Solid understanding of electro-mechanical systems, sensors, and control systems
  • Willingness and ability to travel regularly (nationally and/or internationally) to support project deployments and client sites


Nice to Have

  • Experience in project management (PMP or equivalent is a plus)
  • Knowledge of programming/scripting (Python or similar)
  • Experience with data analysis and performance optimization
  • Background in industrial engineering, robotics, or logistics systems
  • Portuguese knowledge


Key Skills

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities
  • System-level thinking and architecture mindset
  • Ability to work in complex, fast-paced environments
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills

vagas.title: Senior Machine Learning Architect (Databricks) - Remote
vagas.description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Machine Learning Architect (Databricks) - Remote em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Your connection with Aubay starts in the following lines:

Aubay Portugal is a French multinational company that has been operating in the country since 2007, with offices in Lisbon and Porto. We are a leading technology consultancy with a presence in seven European Union countries, specializing in the management, implementation, development and maintenance of information systems.

With more than 150 active partners, we operate in strategic sectors such as banking, insurance, automotive, aviation, telecommunications, services and energy, driving innovation and digital transformation.

Excellence, proximity and innovation are the pillars that distinguish us and enable us to support companies in building technological solutions that make a difference.


What are we looking for?


  • 8+ years of experience in Data, AI, or Machine Learning Engineering roles;
  • 3+ years of experience designing ML platforms or AI architecture at scale;
  • Strong hands-on experience with Databricks, Apache Spark, Python, and SQL;
  • Proficient understanding of MLOps, ML lifecycle management, distributed ML systems, feature engineering, and model deployment patterns;
  • Experience with Databricks Unity Catalog, Delta Lake, and Lakehouse architecture;
  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP);
  • Proven ability to deploy ML models into production environments;
  • Strong knowledge of data architecture and scalable ETL/ELT patterns;
  • Experience with orchestration frameworks such as Apache Airflow.


What do we have to offer you?

  • Comprehensive health insurance, including dental coverage;
  • Feedback&Coffee – our integrated performance management system, with regular feedback sessions and a structured Career Progression Model;
  • Aubay Training Academy, designed for your development: technical and behavioural training (in-class and e-learning), Meet&Techs, Webinars, Mentoring and Technology Centers;
  • Events and team building activities that strengthen team spirit and promote closeness;
  • Digital platform for mental health and emotional well-being, with free psychology consultations, so you can take care of yourself at any time;
  • Health and well-being programme, with workshops and initiatives for our employees and other activities open to the community;
  • We grow with you and your family - we offer a Mini-Aubilous Kit when your children are born and annual support for school supplies, from pre-school to higher education;
  • Language platform, with conversation classes in 12 languages;
  • Working model: remote.


What makes us different?

  • Our organisational culture is based on solid values: commitment, excellence, team spirit, well-being, happiness and empathy;
  • We value and recognise those who are part of our history, with referral awards and a special birthday gift;

vagas.title: Customer Service Representative
vagas.description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Customer Service Representative em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Customer Service Representative

Location: Fully Remote (LATAM)

Job Type: Full-Time


Love helping people and solving problems fast? We’re looking for someone who can deliver high-quality customer experiences at scale, while keeping every interaction clear, human, and efficient. This is a hands-on role where responsiveness, empathy, and execution matter every day.


About Uproot Clean

Uproot Clean is a fast-growing, performance-driven consumer brand built for pet owners. We create high-performance, eco-friendly cleaning solutions designed to make life easier without compromising sustainability.

Customer experience is at the core of our brand. Every interaction matters, and how we show up for our customers directly impacts retention, trust, and growth.


The Role

This is a high-volume, execution-focused role. You will manage day-to-day customer interactions across multiple channels, ensuring fast, accurate, and human responses.

You are not just answering tickets—you are shaping how customers experience the brand.


This Role Is For You If:

  • You communicate clearly, empathetically, and efficiently
  • You are comfortable handling high volumes of customer interactions
  • You stay calm under pressure and solve problems quickly
  • You pay attention to details and don’t let things slip
  • You take ownership of issues until they are fully resolved
  • You are comfortable working independently in a remote environment


This Role Is NOT For You If:

  • You avoid dealing with difficult customers
  • You prioritize speed over accuracy and quality
  • You are not comfortable multitasking across platforms


What You'll Do

Customer Support Execution

  • Manage and respond to customer inquiries via email and support platforms
  • Ensure fast, accurate, and high-quality responses at scale
  • Maintain a consistent and professional brand voice

Social Media Support

  • Respond to DMs and comments across platforms like Instagram, Facebook, and TikTok
  • Engage with the community while maintaining brand tone and consistency

Order & Refund Management

  • Process order changes, cancellations, refunds, and exchanges
  • Ensure all actions follow company policies and are accurately executed

Conflict Resolution

  • Handle complaints with empathy and clarity
  • Investigate issues thoroughly and provide complete resolutions

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Share customer feedback and recurring issues with internal teams
  • Help identify patterns that can improve product or operations


Requirements

Must have:

  • Experience in customer service (ecommerce or DTC preferred)
  • +1 years of experience using Shopify
  • Strong written communication skills in English
  • Experience handling social media interactions is a strong plus
  • High attention to detail and ability to multitask
  • Comfortable working in fast-paced environments

Work Requirements

⏰ Schedule: Monday-Friday, 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM EST

Workspace: Fixed, professional setup required (stable internet + backup plan)


Benefits & Compensation

  • Fully remote - work from anywhere in LATAM.
  • Monthly salary: $3,000 - $4,000 USD
  • Paid time off
  • Flex days. Enjoy an extra quarterly day off to unwind and recharge energies whenever you desire
  • Ownership & autonomy - trusted to build and execute strategy
  • Professional development - opportunities to learn and grow with the business

Ready to Apply?

If you care about delivering great customer experiences and want to be part of a fast-moving team, apply now.

vagas.description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior .Net Engineer (WFH) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Senior .Net Engineer


Resume: English Version only. Resume should have detailed discussion of project overview and job description. Highlight the following if applicable - Maui (Blazor, Razor, Xamarin); Healthcare projects; HIPAA knowledge; SAAS projects; US-based projects

Role: Full time contractor; Fully Remote

Work Hours : US time zone

Location: Brazil

Rate: R$20,000-22,000 per month


About the Company

We are a forward-thinking technology organization dedicated to developing innovative software solutions that improve outcomes for clients and end-users. Our engineering team designs, builds, and maintains scalable, high-quality applications that drive efficiency and innovation across industries. We are seeking an experienced Level III Software Engineer (contractor) to join our distributed team, contributing to complex projects with a focus on code quality, security, and collaboration.


Position Overview

As a Level III Software Engineer (contractor), you will apply your technical expertise to deliver high-quality code for moderately to highly complex projects. Working remotely with a U.S.-based team, you'll gain deep system knowledge and contribute to an Agile development workflow using Azure DevOps.

You will begin with automated testing and peer reviews, expanding into broader development tasks by months 2–3. The role will continue to evolve based on your strengths and project needs, while maintaining rigorous adherence to coding and security standards.


Key Responsibilities

  • Product Design & Development: Collaborate with stakeholders to design and implement software solutions aligned with technical and business objectives.
  • Code Contributions: Write, optimize, and maintain efficient code, including enhancement of existing codebases, beginning around months 3–4.
  • Testing & Quality: Design and implement automated end-to-end (E2E) tests (e.g., using Microsoft Playwright) to ensure feature stability—especially during the first 6–9 months.
  • Peer Reviews: Participate in pre-release feature reviews and early post-release bug analysis (first 90 days), transitioning to broader ownership over time.
  • Agile Workflow Participation: Actively contribute to sprints, pull requests, and releases within a 2-week sprint / 6-week release cycle using Azure DevOps.
  • Collaboration: Communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical team members across multiple time zones.


Qualifications


Experience

  • 5–8 years of software engineering experience with a demonstrated record of success on complex projects.


Technical Skills

  • Proficiency in C# ASP.NET (.NET 8) for web applications and APIs.
  • Experience with .NET MAUI and Blazor Web Applications (.NET 8) , leveraging web expertise for cross-platform or mobile development.
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Azure services, including Azure App Service, Azure SQL, and Azure Storage.
  • Strong understanding of modern development tools (e.g., Visual Studio, Git, Azure DevOps).
  • Knowledge of secure coding practices and general cybersecurity principles.
  • Experience with cloud platforms and Agile methodologies .


Soft Skills

  • Excellent problem-solving and analytical abilities.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills for remote collaboration.
  • Ability to work independently and within a collaborative team environment.


Preferred

  • Experience with regulated or data-sensitive software environments (e.g., healthcare, financial services, HIPAA, PHI).
  • Prior experience conducting pull-request reviews and participating in Agile sprints.


What We Offer

  • Opportunity to work on impactful, large-scale technology projects.
  • Collaborative, high-performance engineering culture focused on quality and innovation.
  • Flexible remote work environment with a structured onboarding process for success.


How We Work

  • Agile Workflow: Two-week sprints within a six-week release cycle, including daily stand-ups (3:00 PM CT), sprint planning, and reviews.
  • Code Standards: Strict adherence to best practices, peer reviews, and security testing (e.g., OWASP, Detectify).
  • Tool Stack: Azure DevOps, Visual Studio, SQL Server Management Studio, Datadog, Microsoft Playwright, and related technologies.
  • Team Culture: A focus on accountability, collaboration, and excellence in delivery.

vagas.title: Senior Software Engineer (Go)
vagas.description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Software Engineer (Go) em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Together with the Zoolatech team, our partner, a leading construction management company, is at the forefront of developing a cloud-based software solution. This innovative platform is instrumental in the successful completion of major projects including skyscrapers, hospitals, data centers, stadiums, and schools. It streamlines the management of finances, quality, teams, and risks, making these processes transparent, convenient, and regulation-compliant. Our partner is not only an expert in construction management but also a significant technology innovator, actively developing web and mobile solutions.


Currently Directory business unit owns user identity and access management across their entire platform ecosystem. They've just launched a brand-new Go-based service into closed beta — a ground-up rebuild of how users and companies are managed across the platform. It's live, but not yet actively used. The work ahead is substantial: migrating data and business logic out of a Ruby monolith, building new features in parallel, and accelerating the service toward full production ownership. Now we are looking for reinforcement for the team to develop the new service and help with the migration from the legacy platform.


Responsibilities

  • Build and maintain backend services in Go, implementing event-driven systems governed by CQRS and event sourcing patterns
  • Drive migration of business logic and data from the Ruby legacy monolith into the new Go service
  • Contribute to the new service while it moves from closed beta toward becoming authoritative — building ongoing features in parallel with migration
  • Develop and extend GraphQL Federation schemas that power the federated API gateway
  • Partner with Engineering, Product, and UX to design and build solutions that address user and company management challenges
  • Use a systems engineering approach to make technical design decisions that improve scalability, performance, and reliability
  • Write highly performant code that supports a distributed, multi-tenant SaaS architecture
  • Conduct code reviews, provide mentorship, and actively drive engineering excellence across the team
  • Communicate complex technical problems and solutions clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders


Skills Required

  • 5+ years in Software Engineering across full-stack distributed applications
  • 3+ years of hands-on Go in production microservices
  • Experience with CQRS and event sourcing patterns
  • Experience with Kafka or similar distributed event streaming platforms
  • Experience with PostgreSQL, including data modeling and query optimization
  • Familiarity with GraphQL, including schema design
  • Working knowledge of React and TypeScript for frontend contributions
  • Comfort working across the full development lifecycle: design, testing, staging, deployment, monitoring
  • Strong communication skills — ability to collaborate across US and international time zones
  • US time zone or compatible overlap (EST/CST);

Would be a huge plus:

  • Experience with Ruby/Rails systems, including incremental refactoring and modernization


Engagement Model: Direct Independent Contractor (Please read carefully)


This is an independent contractor opportunity based on a direct contractual relationship between Zoolatech and the individual service provider.


To facilitate this direct partnership, we engage with professionals who are registered and operate as a sole proprietorship, private entrepreneur, or an equivalent self-employment status in your country.


Please note, our model does not accommodate contracts through third-party intermediaries such as agencies, incubators, or umbrella companies. The essential requirement is your ability to enter into a service agreement and invoice Zoolatech directly. This is not an offer of direct employment


Please note that only candidates whose profiles closely match our requirements will be contacted.

vagas.title: Talent Acquisition Partner
vagas.description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Talent Acquisition Partner em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Talent Acquisition Partner (Active Sourcing)


Location: Fully Remote (Must be based in LATAM)

Job Type: Full-Time



About Uproot Clean

Uproot Clean is a fast-growing consumer products company with more than 5 million customers using our products. Our products are sold not only through DTC and Amazon, but also through major retailers, including Walmart, Target, and Petco, along with more than 10,000 retail doors across the country. Uproot has also been featured across major television and media platforms, including QVC, Good Morning America, and Fox, helping introduce millions of consumers to the brand.

We care deeply about building products that genuinely solve problems for pet owners while operating with high standards across every part of the business. We are building a company focused on long-term excellence, creating significant opportunities for highly capable people who want real and meaningful impact, and the ability to help shape the future of the company.

About the Role

This is a hands-on execution role focused 100% on active sourcing. You will proactively identify and engage high-quality talent across multiple functions and seniority levels using multiple sourcing channels, advanced search techniques, and thoughtful outreach.

Success requires high-output execution, strong judgment, persistence, excellent communication, and the ability to operate with urgency in a fast-moving environment.



Responsibilities


Active Sourcing

  • Proactively source candidates across multiple job boards, platforms, and sourcing channels
  • Use advanced Boolean search techniques to identify strong talent
  • Build pipelines across multiple functions and seniority levels
  • Identify strong passive candidates
  • Partner closely with recruiting and hiring managers to align on hiring needs.

Candidate Outreach

  • Write outbound messaging that drives candidate engagement
  • Qualify candidates early in the process
  • Move qualified candidates into the recruiting workflow

Pipeline Management

  • Maintain organized sourcing workflows and candidate tracking
  • Continuously improve sourcing strategies and outreach quality
  • Continuously iterate on sourcing methods, messaging, and targeting

What Success Looks Like

  • Consistently builds high-quality candidate pipelines
  • Surfaces strong candidates quickly across multiple functions
  • Generates strong response and assessment completion rates
  • Operates with speed, consistency, and minimal oversight
  • Raises the overall talent bar of the company over time


Requirements

Must Have

  • 1+ year of full-time active sourcing experience - mandatory
  • Experience sourcing across multiple job boards and sourcing platforms
  • Strong outbound recruiting and candidate outreach skills
  • Experience using advanced Boolean search techniques
  • Excellent written English communication skills
  • Ability to manage multiple open searches simultaneously

Strong Plus

  • Experience sourcing across multiple functions and seniority levels
  • Experience in high-growth, e-commerce, or performance-driven companies
  • Familiarity with LinkedIn Recruiter and modern sourcing tools

Work Requirements

⏰ Schedule: Monday-Friday, 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM EST

Workspace: Fixed, professional setup (no digital nomads)

Output: Daily briefs and feedback loops (high consistency required)


Who This Role Is For (& Not For)

This Role Is For You If:

  • You enjoy the challenge of finding exceptional people before anyone else does
  • You are naturally proactive and internally driven
  • You move quickly, stay organized, and maintain high standards
  • You enjoy performance-oriented environments with accountability
  • You think recruiting is a high-leverage business function, not administrative work
  • You enjoy improving systems, processes, and sourcing quality over time

This Role Is NOT For You If:

  • You need constant direction or external motivation
  • You struggle with consistency and follow-through
  • You are uncomfortable persuading passive candidates
  • You treat recruiting as scheduling and coordination only


Compensation & Benefits

Uproot Clean is a high ownership, high accountability environment with high standards for communication, speed, execution, and quality. We care far more about ability, judgment, and ownership than credentials or years of experience.

  • Salary : Competitive base salary + performance-based bonus structure
  • Significant autonomy with the ability to directly influence the company’s growth and direction
  • Fully remote : work from anywhere
  • PTO : 2 Weeks
  • Flex Day : An additional quarterly day off dedicated to rest and recovery
  • Thinking Day: one dedicated day each quarter to step away from day-to-day execution and think deeply about your role, systems, ideas, and long-term impact
  • Wellness Reimbursement: $100-$300/month, based on location, to help support your wellness.
  • Pet Reimbursement: $40-100/month, based on location to help support parenting a pet.
  • Coaching credits: $1,000+/year for coaching, education, and professional development


Ready to Apply?

If you are excited by high standards, proactive recruiting, and the challenge of building world-class talent pipelines, we’d love to hear from you.
