vagas.title: Remote Business Analyst (German)
vagas.description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Remote Business Analyst (German) em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.

Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.


Role Overview:

We are looking for candidates with strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in the content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles!

Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


What does day-to-day look like:

You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples which models might get wrong and you would have to give the correct answer and explanation to enable the models to learn:

  • Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?)
  • In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.


Requirements:

  • Multilingual capabilities are mandatory. (English and German)
  • Analytical Skills : Good research and analytical skills
  • Feedback Skills : Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Creative Thinking : Creative and lateral thinking abilities.
  • Communication : Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence : Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Commitment : Ability to commit to 40 hours per week for the contract duration overlapping US hours.
  • Technical Setup : Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. We are open to candidates who do not have a Bachelor's degree but have experience in the area.
  • Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.)
  • Understanding of Excel and Google Suite.
  • Proficiency in Data interpretation, Logical reasoning and Basic arithmetic is highly desirable.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Engagement type : Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • Commitments Required : Availability of up to 40 hours/week is preferred. This role will require some overlap with UTC-8:00 (2-5 hrs/day) America/Los_Angeles


Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

vagas.title: Engenheiro de dados S
vagas.description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Engenheiro de dados S em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?


Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


Sobre a posição

Como parte de uma equipe global de tecnologia, o(a) Engenheiro(a) de Dados Sênior atuará no desenvolvimento, manutenção e evolução de produtos de dados em ambiente Cloud. O profissional será responsável por projetar e implementar soluções de engenharia de dados, garantindo qualidade, confiabilidade e escalabilidade dos dados utilizados pela organização.


A posição exige forte atuação em projetos de dados utilizando plataformas como Azure e Snowflake, além de colaboração constante com arquitetos, times ágeis e stakeholders de negócio para entrega de soluções analíticas de alto valor.


Principais Responsabilidades

• Projetar, desenvolver e manter soluções de engenharia de dados em ambiente Cloud.

• Desenvolver pipelines de dados batch e streaming utilizando plataformas Azure e Snowflake.

• Implementar processos de extração, transformação e carga de dados (ETL/ELT) provenientes de múltiplas fontes.

• Garantir a qualidade, governança e integridade dos dados ao longo de todo o ciclo de processamento.

• Desenvolver e manter soluções utilizando Snowflake, dbt e tecnologias do ecossistema Azure.

• Construir e otimizar consultas SQL, procedures e rotinas de processamento de dados.

• Implementar integrações entre diferentes sistemas e fontes de dados corporativas.

• Participar de provas de conceito (POCs), avaliações técnicas e demonstrações de novas tecnologias.

Colaboração e Entrega de Projetos

• Trabalhar em conjunto com equipes de negócio, arquitetos de soluções e times técnicos para levantamento de requisitos e definição de soluções.

• Traduzir necessidades de negócio em modelos de dados, fluxos automatizados e soluções escaláveis.

• Garantir aderência às melhores práticas de arquitetura, desenvolvimento, governança e segurança de dados.

• Participar ativamente de cerimônias ágeis e processos de melhoria contínua.

DevOps e Qualidade

• Atuar seguindo práticas de CI/CD, DevOps e padrões de desenvolvimento estabelecidos pela organização.

• Utilizar ferramentas de versionamento e gestão de código-fonte, como GitHub e Azure DevOps.

• Apoiar processos de automação, testes e monitoramento das soluções desenvolvidas.

• Contribuir para a evolução contínua da plataforma de dados e das práticas de engenharia adotadas pela equipe.


Requisitos Obrigatórios

• Experiência sólida em Engenharia de Dados (mínimo de 5 anos).

• Experiência prática com Snowflake.

• Conhecimento sólido em SQL, incluindo consultas complexas e stored procedures.

• Conhecimento sólido em dbt (Data Build Tool).

• Experiência na construção e manutenção de pipelines ETL/ELT em ambiente Cloud.

• Experiência com serviços Azure, incluindo ADF, Functions, Event Hub e Azure DevOps.

• Conhecimento em Python para desenvolvimento e automação de processos de dados.

• Conhecimento de modelagem de dados

• Experiência com práticas de CI/CD, DevOps e versionamento de código utilizando GitHub.

• Conhecimento em metodologias ágeis (Scrum e/ou Kanban).

• Inglês avançado para comunicação em ambiente corporativo global.

Diferenciais

• Experiência com ferramentas de replicação de dados, como Qlik Replicate, SLT ou Click.

• Experiência em projetos de Data & Analytics.

• Conhecimento em SQL Server e otimização de consultas.

• Conhecimento em ferramentas de visualização de dados, como Power BI ou Tableau será um diferencial.

• Experiência com plataformas de streaming de dados, como Kafka.

Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?


Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


Sobre a posição

Como parte de uma equipe global de tecnologia, o(a) Engenheiro(a) de Dados Sênior atuará no desenvolvimento, manutenção e evolução de produtos de dados em ambiente Cloud. O profissional será responsável por projetar e implementar soluções de engenharia de dados, garantindo qualidade, confiabilidade e escalabilidade dos dados utilizados pela organização.


A posição exige forte atuação em projetos de dados utilizando plataformas como Azure e Snowflake, além de colaboração constante com arquitetos, times ágeis e stakeholders de negócio para entrega de soluções analíticas de alto valor.


Principais Responsabilidades

• Projetar, desenvolver e manter soluções de engenharia de dados em ambiente Cloud.

• Desenvolver pipelines de dados batch e streaming utilizando plataformas Azure e Snowflake.

• Implementar processos de extração, transformação e carga de dados (ETL/ELT) provenientes de múltiplas fontes.

• Garantir a qualidade, governança e integridade dos dados ao longo de todo o ciclo de processamento.

• Desenvolver e manter soluções utilizando Snowflake, dbt e tecnologias do ecossistema Azure.

• Construir e otimizar consultas SQL, procedures e rotinas de processamento de dados.

• Implementar integrações entre diferentes sistemas e fontes de dados corporativas.

• Participar de provas de conceito (POCs), avaliações técnicas e demonstrações de novas tecnologias.

Colaboração e Entrega de Projetos

• Trabalhar em conjunto com equipes de negócio, arquitetos de soluções e times técnicos para levantamento de requisitos e definição de soluções.

• Traduzir necessidades de negócio em modelos de dados, fluxos automatizados e soluções escaláveis.

• Garantir aderência às melhores práticas de arquitetura, desenvolvimento, governança e segurança de dados.

• Participar ativamente de cerimônias ágeis e processos de melhoria contínua.

DevOps e Qualidade

• Atuar seguindo práticas de CI/CD, DevOps e padrões de desenvolvimento estabelecidos pela organização.

• Utilizar ferramentas de versionamento e gestão de código-fonte, como GitHub e Azure DevOps.

• Apoiar processos de automação, testes e monitoramento das soluções desenvolvidas.

• Contribuir para a evolução contínua da plataforma de dados e das práticas de engenharia adotadas pela equipe.


Requisitos Obrigatórios

• Experiência sólida em Engenharia de Dados (mínimo de 5 anos).

• Experiência prática com Snowflake.

• Conhecimento sólido em SQL, incluindo consultas complexas e stored procedures.

• Conhecimento sólido em dbt (Data Build Tool).

• Experiência na construção e manutenção de pipelines ETL/ELT em ambiente Cloud.

• Experiência com serviços Azure, incluindo ADF, Functions, Event Hub e Azure DevOps.

• Conhecimento em Python para desenvolvimento e automação de processos de dados.

• Conhecimento de modelagem de dados

• Experiência com práticas de CI/CD, DevOps e versionamento de código utilizando GitHub.

• Conhecimento em metodologias ágeis (Scrum e/ou Kanban).

• Inglês avançado para comunicação em ambiente corporativo global.

Diferenciais

• Experiência com ferramentas de replicação de dados, como Qlik Replicate, SLT ou Click.

• Experiência em projetos de Data & Analytics.

• Conhecimento em SQL Server e otimização de consultas.

• Conhecimento em ferramentas de visualização de dados, como Power BI ou Tableau será um diferencial.

• Experiência com plataformas de streaming de dados, como Kafka.

Confira esta oportunidade para Executive Assistant em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Executive Assistant to a US CEO — Sales-Driven, Self-Starters Only

Read this whole thing before you apply. It's a filter.

We place Executive Assistants with US home-service business owners. You won't be a task-rabbit. You'll be the CEO's right hand — the person who moves the needle on whatever the business needs that week.


Your #1 job: make sure deals close. Appointment setting, direct sales, follow-up that doesn't quit. From there it widens — hiring providers, dispatching, customer satisfaction, finding new ways to grow the business. We're not hiring an assistant. We're hiring a mini-CEO who makes the big CEO's life bigger.


This role is for people who take the reins. Nobody is going to hand you a checklist every morning. You see the gap, you close the gap. If you need to be told what to do next, stop reading — this will frustrate both of us.


The pay grows when you do:

  • Start at $1,000/mo
  • Hit your first KPI → $1,250/mo
  • Hit the next → $1,400/mo
  • Performance bonuses from the business owner on top — up to $400/mo more

The ceiling moves because you move it. We don't cap people who produce.


What you need to have:

  • Fluent, clear, neutral English — easy for a US homeowner to understand on a call
  • Proven sales or appointment-setting background (show us the receipts)
  • Comfortable owning a number, not just doing tasks
  • Cold calling is a plus, not a must


The non-negotiables — apply only if these are a yes:

  • Available across all US time zones (PST/CST/MST/EST)
  • Up to 50 hours/week. This is firm.
  • Saturday mornings when the business needs it
  • Comfortable with Hubstaff time tracking. We use it for transparency, not to micromanage or punish — that's not how we operate. But it's part of the job.


If you read the hours and the ownership bar and felt more interested, not less — you're who we're looking for. Hit Easy Apply. If you're a fit, we'll come back to you fast — we move quick when we find the right person.

vagas.title: Talent Acquisition Partner
vagas.description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Talent Acquisition Partner em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Talent Acquisition Partner (Active Sourcing)


Location: Fully Remote (Must be based in LATAM)

Job Type: Full-Time



About Uproot Clean

Uproot Clean is a fast-growing consumer products company with more than 5 million customers using our products. Our products are sold not only through DTC and Amazon, but also through major retailers, including Walmart, Target, and Petco, along with more than 10,000 retail doors across the country. Uproot has also been featured across major television and media platforms, including QVC, Good Morning America, and Fox, helping introduce millions of consumers to the brand.

We care deeply about building products that genuinely solve problems for pet owners while operating with high standards across every part of the business. We are building a company focused on long-term excellence, creating significant opportunities for highly capable people who want real and meaningful impact, and the ability to help shape the future of the company.

About the Role

This is a hands-on execution role focused 100% on active sourcing. You will proactively identify and engage high-quality talent across multiple functions and seniority levels using multiple sourcing channels, advanced search techniques, and thoughtful outreach.

Success requires high-output execution, strong judgment, persistence, excellent communication, and the ability to operate with urgency in a fast-moving environment.



Responsibilities


Active Sourcing

  • Proactively source candidates across multiple job boards, platforms, and sourcing channels
  • Use advanced Boolean search techniques to identify strong talent
  • Build pipelines across multiple functions and seniority levels
  • Identify strong passive candidates
  • Partner closely with recruiting and hiring managers to align on hiring needs.

Candidate Outreach

  • Write outbound messaging that drives candidate engagement
  • Qualify candidates early in the process
  • Move qualified candidates into the recruiting workflow

Pipeline Management

  • Maintain organized sourcing workflows and candidate tracking
  • Continuously improve sourcing strategies and outreach quality
  • Continuously iterate on sourcing methods, messaging, and targeting

What Success Looks Like

  • Consistently builds high-quality candidate pipelines
  • Surfaces strong candidates quickly across multiple functions
  • Generates strong response and assessment completion rates
  • Operates with speed, consistency, and minimal oversight
  • Raises the overall talent bar of the company over time


Requirements

Must Have

  • 1+ year of full-time active sourcing experience - mandatory
  • Experience sourcing across multiple job boards and sourcing platforms
  • Strong outbound recruiting and candidate outreach skills
  • Experience using advanced Boolean search techniques
  • Excellent written English communication skills
  • Ability to manage multiple open searches simultaneously

Strong Plus

  • Experience sourcing across multiple functions and seniority levels
  • Experience in high-growth, e-commerce, or performance-driven companies
  • Familiarity with LinkedIn Recruiter and modern sourcing tools

Work Requirements

⏰ Schedule: Monday-Friday, 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM EST

Workspace: Fixed, professional setup (no digital nomads)

Output: Daily briefs and feedback loops (high consistency required)


Who This Role Is For (& Not For)

This Role Is For You If:

  • You enjoy the challenge of finding exceptional people before anyone else does
  • You are naturally proactive and internally driven
  • You move quickly, stay organized, and maintain high standards
  • You enjoy performance-oriented environments with accountability
  • You think recruiting is a high-leverage business function, not administrative work
  • You enjoy improving systems, processes, and sourcing quality over time

This Role Is NOT For You If:

  • You need constant direction or external motivation
  • You struggle with consistency and follow-through
  • You are uncomfortable persuading passive candidates
  • You treat recruiting as scheduling and coordination only


Compensation & Benefits

Uproot Clean is a high ownership, high accountability environment with high standards for communication, speed, execution, and quality. We care far more about ability, judgment, and ownership than credentials or years of experience.

  • Salary : Competitive base salary + performance-based bonus structure
  • Significant autonomy with the ability to directly influence the company’s growth and direction
  • Fully remote : work from anywhere
  • PTO : 2 Weeks
  • Flex Day : An additional quarterly day off dedicated to rest and recovery
  • Thinking Day: one dedicated day each quarter to step away from day-to-day execution and think deeply about your role, systems, ideas, and long-term impact
  • Wellness Reimbursement: $100-$300/month, based on location, to help support your wellness.
  • Pet Reimbursement: $40-100/month, based on location to help support parenting a pet.
  • Coaching credits: $1,000+/year for coaching, education, and professional development


Ready to Apply?

If you are excited by high standards, proactive recruiting, and the challenge of building world-class talent pipelines, we’d love to hear from you.

vagas.title: Senior Software Engineer (Go)
vagas.description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Software Engineer (Go) em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Together with the Zoolatech team, our partner, a leading construction management company, is at the forefront of developing a cloud-based software solution. This innovative platform is instrumental in the successful completion of major projects including skyscrapers, hospitals, data centers, stadiums, and schools. It streamlines the management of finances, quality, teams, and risks, making these processes transparent, convenient, and regulation-compliant. Our partner is not only an expert in construction management but also a significant technology innovator, actively developing web and mobile solutions.


Currently Directory business unit owns user identity and access management across their entire platform ecosystem. They've just launched a brand-new Go-based service into closed beta — a ground-up rebuild of how users and companies are managed across the platform. It's live, but not yet actively used. The work ahead is substantial: migrating data and business logic out of a Ruby monolith, building new features in parallel, and accelerating the service toward full production ownership. Now we are looking for reinforcement for the team to develop the new service and help with the migration from the legacy platform.


Responsibilities

  • Build and maintain backend services in Go, implementing event-driven systems governed by CQRS and event sourcing patterns
  • Drive migration of business logic and data from the Ruby legacy monolith into the new Go service
  • Contribute to the new service while it moves from closed beta toward becoming authoritative — building ongoing features in parallel with migration
  • Develop and extend GraphQL Federation schemas that power the federated API gateway
  • Partner with Engineering, Product, and UX to design and build solutions that address user and company management challenges
  • Use a systems engineering approach to make technical design decisions that improve scalability, performance, and reliability
  • Write highly performant code that supports a distributed, multi-tenant SaaS architecture
  • Conduct code reviews, provide mentorship, and actively drive engineering excellence across the team
  • Communicate complex technical problems and solutions clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders


Skills Required

  • 5+ years in Software Engineering across full-stack distributed applications
  • 3+ years of hands-on Go in production microservices
  • Experience with CQRS and event sourcing patterns
  • Experience with Kafka or similar distributed event streaming platforms
  • Experience with PostgreSQL, including data modeling and query optimization
  • Familiarity with GraphQL, including schema design
  • Working knowledge of React and TypeScript for frontend contributions
  • Comfort working across the full development lifecycle: design, testing, staging, deployment, monitoring
  • Strong communication skills — ability to collaborate across US and international time zones
  • US time zone or compatible overlap (EST/CST);

Would be a huge plus:

  • Experience with Ruby/Rails systems, including incremental refactoring and modernization


Engagement Model: Direct Independent Contractor (Please read carefully)


This is an independent contractor opportunity based on a direct contractual relationship between Zoolatech and the individual service provider.


To facilitate this direct partnership, we engage with professionals who are registered and operate as a sole proprietorship, private entrepreneur, or an equivalent self-employment status in your country.


Please note, our model does not accommodate contracts through third-party intermediaries such as agencies, incubators, or umbrella companies. The essential requirement is your ability to enter into a service agreement and invoice Zoolatech directly. This is not an offer of direct employment


Please note that only candidates whose profiles closely match our requirements will be contacted.

vagas.title: Site Reliability Engineer
vagas.description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Site Reliability Engineer em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Job Title: Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) / Infrastructure Operations MID LEVEL


Role Overview

Responsible for managing day-to-day infrastructure operations, including monitoring, alerting, and driving stability improvements across the environment.


Key Responsibilities

  • Monitor overall infrastructure health and system performance
  • Track key performance metrics such as CPU, memory, and disk utilization
  • Tune alerts to improve signal-to-noise ratio and reduce alert fatigue
  • Support disaster recovery (DR) rehearsals and readiness activities
  • Maintain and update runbooks, documentation, and operational reports


Required Experience

  • 4–6 years of experience in Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) or infrastructure operations
  • Hands-on experience with VMware environments
  • Experience with monitoring tools such as PRTG, Datadog, or similar platforms
  • Strong incident management experience, including response and resolution processes


Core Skills & Competencies

  • Solid understanding of infrastructure performance metrics (CPU, memory, disk, etc.)
  • Experience with alert tuning and optimization
  • Ability to proactively detect and troubleshoot performance issues
  • Strong incident management and operational response capabilities


Screening Signals

Look for candidates who:

  • Understand CPU Ready thresholds and their impact on performance
  • Have hands-on experience tuning alerts to reduce noise
  • Can proactively identify and resolve performance bottlenecks
  • Demonstrate strong incident management experience in production environments

vagas.title: AI Developer
vagas.description:
Confira esta oportunidade para AI Developer em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We're partnering with a global software organization that is investing heavily in AI-driven products, automation, and intelligent workflow solutions. This is an opportunity to join a growing AI & Automation team focused on building real-world applications that deliver measurable business value. The team is moving beyond experimentation and proof-of-concepts into production-grade systems used by customers and internal stakeholders.


About the Role

If you're a software engineer who uses AI to build better software, not someone who simply prompts AI tools, this could be a strong fit.


Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and deploy production-ready software solutions
  • Build AI-enabled applications and automation workflows
  • Evaluate and implement new technologies through rapid prototyping and proof-of-concept development
  • Collaborate with engineering and business teams to deliver scalable solutions
  • Contribute to architecture decisions, coding standards, and technical best practices
  • Integrate AI services, APIs, and automation platforms into business applications
  • Help drive the adoption of modern software development practices, including AI-assisted development


Qualifications

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience


Required Skills

  • Strong software design and problem-solving skills
  • Experience building and supporting production applications
  • Hands-on experience with AI-assisted development tools
  • Experience with workflow automation and process orchestration
  • Strong understanding of APIs, integrations, and modern application architectures
  • Ability to learn new technologies quickly and work across multiple projects


Technical Environment

Experience in several of the following areas is preferred:

  • .NET/ C#
  • Node.js
  • React
  • JavaScript / TypeScript
  • PostgreSQL
  • MongoDB or document databases
  • REST APIs
  • Cloud platforms (Azure or AWS)
  • AI integrations and automation platforms
  • Claude
  • CodeRAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation)
  • n8n or similar workflow automation tools

What Makes Someone Successful Here

This team is looking for engineers who:

  • Can take a concept from idea to production
  • Know when AI-generated code is useful and when it needs refinement
  • Understand software engineering fundamentals beyond prompting tools
  • Enjoy solving business problems through automation
  • Thrive in environments where new technologies are evaluated and adopted quickly

What This Role Is Not

This is not a machine learning research position. This is not a prompt engineering role. This is a hands-on software engineering position focused on building production applications that leverage AI and automation technologies.


Why Consider This Opportunity?

  • Work on AI-enabled products that are actively being deployed
  • Join a team focused on innovation and delivery
  • Exposure to modern AI, automation, and software development practices


Fully remote within Brazil

This is a CLT Role - Compensation is R$15,000/month

vagas.title: IT Support Engineer (M365 & Azure)
vagas.description:
Confira esta oportunidade para IT Support Engineer (M365 & Azure) em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We are seeking a \"IT Support Engineer \" for our client, a top service provider renowned for trading and refurbishing used technology, such as cellphones and laptops. This company is dedicated to assisting manufacturers with sustainable practices and plays a significant role in reducing new tech expenses on a global scale.


Key Responsibilities


• To provide operational support across Alchemy’s estate of devices, network infrastructure,

and end user computing related cloud services including health checks and reporting.

• Diagnose and resolve faults in physical and cloud-based services and infrastructure supported

by the Technical Operations team

• Take ownership of configuring and maintaining Alchemy’s Physical and virtual network

infrastructure, including LAN, WAN and Telephony

• Maintain the Security integrity of the Technical Operations service portfolio including

patching, automated vulnerability assessments, Firewalls, software Security suites and MDM

• Proactively educate Alchemists, instilling a security first mindset through the use of our

automated phishing and exploit awareness toolsets

• Support Alchemists in become as self-sufficient as possible by providing self-service tools, and

creating knowledge base articles to improve incident and event resolution efficiency

• Managing incidents, problems, requests and changes in line with ITIL best practice and

ensuring that SLA's are maintained

• Act as a cross-media Point of Resolution for all Support Engineering related issues

• Analyse and measure your services to develop, communicate and action continual process and

technology improvements

• Work without continuous supervision and be trusted to provide professional support services

to your fellow Alchemists

• Provide proactive monitoring and management of Technical Operations services to your fellow

Alchemists

• Guide Alchemy in your personal development and self-educate to attain industry standard IT

accreditations

• Manage, respond to and resolve all End User based incidents and events

• Install, configure and manage End User Devices and Applications

• Work to proactively prevent Security threats to your service portfolio, End User Devices and

Applications. Should any occur, immediately respond effectively to and contain those IT

Security threats and incidents

• Maintaining agreed SLA levels and assure quality of delivery at all times

• Ordering and installation of hardware as required

• Delivery of project-related tasks

• Creation of relevant technical diagrams and documentation

• Ensure that your estate and environments adhere to established standards and frameworks,

meeting any compliance requirements at all times.

• Input into the design and implementation of new platforms, services and infrastructure

including the creation of associated documentation

• Completing internal moves and changes as required

• Setting up new sites and locations as required

• Ensure all logs for equipment and users are maintained

• Providing support to Alcehmists whether remotely or in person

• Keeping up to date with industry trends and technology developments

• Identifying and sharing relevant architectural patterns

• Contributing towards creating a culture of metrics and data to drive continuous improvement

• Working closely with Infosec to ensure Security ‘shifts left’

• Collaborating gclosely with the Engineering teams, promoting a DevOps culture


Your Behaviors:

• Communicator – You can make yourself concisely and clearly understood through positive

interactions with people across all levels of Alchemy regardless of their seniority, geography

and culture

• People Focused – You understand that people make Alchemy a success

• Problem Solver – You love to fix things

• Lifelong Learner – Everyday is a chance to discover/teach something new

• Creative – You are a fountain of innovative ideas and love experimenting

• Logical – You look for facts and think your way to a conclusion

• Forward looking – You embrace new and better ways of doing things, and relish the

opportunity to take others on the journey with you

• Confident – You embrace having positive, open and candid discussions with individuals at all

levels

• Diplomatic – The message is always delivered with consideration of others needs

• Decisive – you have a keen sense of prioritisation and make intelligent decisions

independently

• Motivated – You are a self-starter with a ‘can-do’ attitude and the ability to work

independently under light supervision

• Reliable - You’re the person stakeholders and peers always want to work with, remaining

visible as the face of IT to listen to concerns and share as needed

• Professional – It’s never personal, you understand what is happening from the end users

perspective

• Presentable – You don’t need suits and ties to inspire confidence, we do so through our

smart casual appearance

• Compassionate – You understand that people in need require careful attention

• Energetic - You bring bags of energy every day, the only way is forward

• Organised - You are detail oriented and manage your time and the time of others well

• Data driven – Information is your friend; you love to use facts and evidence to help ensure

success for the team and our customer


Qualifications, Knowledge & Experince

Essential:

• A high degree of technical knowledge and competence

• Demonstrable ability to troubleshoot complex, technical, multi-site and multi-discipline

incidents and problems

• At least 4 years administration, management and setup of Microsoft Office 365 technologies

and their associated security implementations

• At least 4 years hands on experience with Microsoft Azure technologies (Servers Active

Directory, DNS, Group Policy etc)

• At least 6 years’ experience working in similar 2nd/3rd Line internal IT Service Desk role

supporting a globally distributed organisation

• 2nd/3rd line knowledge of a wide range end user devices including printers, workstations,

tablets, phones, laptops and associated modern operating systems for Windows, Apple,

Linux

• Practical deployment and administration experience of standard end-point security and Disk

Encryption tools

• Senior level experience of supporting standard software suites

• Demonstrable practical experience of management of Microsoft Exchange Online and email

Talent Acquisition Partner (Active Sourcing)


Location: Fully Remote (Must be based in LATAM)

Job Type: Full-Time



About Uproot Clean

Uproot Clean is a fast-growing consumer products company with more than 5 million customers using our products. Our products are sold not only through DTC and Amazon, but also through major retailers, including Walmart, Target, and Petco, along with more than 10,000 retail doors across the country. Uproot has also been featured across major television and media platforms, including QVC, Good Morning America, and Fox, helping introduce millions of consumers to the brand.

We care deeply about building products that genuinely solve problems for pet owners while operating with high standards across every part of the business. We are building a company focused on long-term excellence, creating significant opportunities for highly capable people who want real and meaningful impact, and the ability to help shape the future of the company.

About the Role

This is a hands-on execution role focused 100% on active sourcing. You will proactively identify and engage high-quality talent across multiple functions and seniority levels using multiple sourcing channels, advanced search techniques, and thoughtful outreach.

Success requires high-output execution, strong judgment, persistence, excellent communication, and the ability to operate with urgency in a fast-moving environment.



Responsibilities


Active Sourcing

  • Proactively source candidates across multiple job boards, platforms, and sourcing channels
  • Use advanced Boolean search techniques to identify strong talent
  • Build pipelines across multiple functions and seniority levels
  • Identify strong passive candidates
  • Partner closely with recruiting and hiring managers to align on hiring needs.

Candidate Outreach

  • Write outbound messaging that drives candidate engagement
  • Qualify candidates early in the process
  • Move qualified candidates into the recruiting workflow

Pipeline Management

  • Maintain organized sourcing workflows and candidate tracking
  • Continuously improve sourcing strategies and outreach quality
  • Continuously iterate on sourcing methods, messaging, and targeting

What Success Looks Like

  • Consistently builds high-quality candidate pipelines
  • Surfaces strong candidates quickly across multiple functions
  • Generates strong response and assessment completion rates
  • Operates with speed, consistency, and minimal oversight
  • Raises the overall talent bar of the company over time


Requirements

Must Have

  • 1+ year of full-time active sourcing experience - mandatory
  • Experience sourcing across multiple job boards and sourcing platforms
  • Strong outbound recruiting and candidate outreach skills
  • Experience using advanced Boolean search techniques
  • Excellent written English communication skills
  • Ability to manage multiple open searches simultaneously

Strong Plus

  • Experience sourcing across multiple functions and seniority levels
  • Experience in high-growth, e-commerce, or performance-driven companies
  • Familiarity with LinkedIn Recruiter and modern sourcing tools

Work Requirements

⏰ Schedule: Monday-Friday, 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM EST

Workspace: Fixed, professional setup (no digital nomads)

Output: Daily briefs and feedback loops (high consistency required)


Who This Role Is For (& Not For)

This Role Is For You If:

  • You enjoy the challenge of finding exceptional people before anyone else does
  • You are naturally proactive and internally driven
  • You move quickly, stay organized, and maintain high standards
  • You enjoy performance-oriented environments with accountability
  • You think recruiting is a high-leverage business function, not administrative work
  • You enjoy improving systems, processes, and sourcing quality over time

This Role Is NOT For You If:

  • You need constant direction or external motivation
  • You struggle with consistency and follow-through
  • You are uncomfortable persuading passive candidates
  • You treat recruiting as scheduling and coordination only


Compensation & Benefits

Uproot Clean is a high ownership, high accountability environment with high standards for communication, speed, execution, and quality. We care far more about ability, judgment, and ownership than credentials or years of experience.

  • Salary : Competitive base salary + performance-based bonus structure
  • Significant autonomy with the ability to directly influence the company’s growth and direction
  • Fully remote : work from anywhere
  • PTO : 2 Weeks
  • Flex Day : An additional quarterly day off dedicated to rest and recovery
  • Thinking Day: one dedicated day each quarter to step away from day-to-day execution and think deeply about your role, systems, ideas, and long-term impact
  • Wellness Reimbursement: $100-$300/month, based on location, to help support your wellness.
  • Pet Reimbursement: $40-100/month, based on location to help support parenting a pet.
  • Coaching credits: $1,000+/year for coaching, education, and professional development


Ready to Apply?

If you are excited by high standards, proactive recruiting, and the challenge of building world-class talent pipelines, we’d love to hear from you.

vagas.title: Tech Lead
vagas.description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Tech Lead em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Descrição da vaga

A Verity está buscando novos talentos!


Somos uma aceleradora de soluções digitais e buscamos Tech Lead para fazer parte dessa jornada.


Olha só quais são as experiências e conhecimentos que você precisa ter para acelerar e transformar com a gente:


Responsabilidades e atribuições

O Líder Técnico (LT) é fundamental para o desenho e a implementação de melhores práticas no desenvolvimento de software, sempre pautado em metodologias ágeis. Dentro do Dev Team, o LT atua ativamente nas cerimônias ágeis, no refinamento, na análise de impacto e no desenho dos itens do Backlog do produto.


• Liderança Técnica: Atuar como líder técnico para os desenvolvedores, orientando e apoiando o time no dia a dia.

• Melhores Práticas e Qualidade: Desenhar e promover um conjunto de melhores práticas para o desenvolvimento de software utilizando métodos ágeis.

• Refinamento e Análise: Participar ativamente do refinamento, análise de impacto e desenho dos itens do Backlog do produto.

• Discovery e Hipóteses de Negócio: Contribuir ativamente nas sessões de Discovery, oferecendo insights sobre as hipóteses de negócio sob a perspectiva de práticas de desenvolvimento e construção de aplicações.

• Direção Técnica: Ajudar a definir a direção técnica do produto, garantindo a evolução e a qualidade do desenvolvimento.

• Comunicação e Alinhamento: Garantir a comunicação clara entre as definições de arquitetura e os componentes de software.

• Padrões e Normas: Assegurar o atendimento aos padrões de desenvolvimento de software da Porto, incluindo desenvolvimento seguro e demais normas aplicáveis à tecnologia utilizada pela Squad.

• Otimização de Processos: Propor processos e ferramentas que facilitem o dia a dia da Squad.

• Promoção de Ritos Técnicos: Promover entre os Desenvolvedores a adoção de processos e ritos técnicos como estimativas, definições técnicas, gitflow e mapeamento de débitos técnicos.

• Qualidade do Código: Ser responsável pela qualidade do código desenvolvido, adequação aos critérios de aceite, manutenção e melhoria contínua.

• Alinhamento Estratégico: Seguir os direcionamentos das disciplinas de Arquitetura, Tech Leads, Segurança da Informação e demais disciplinas relacionadas à Engenharia de Software.


Requisitos e qualificações

• Formação: Superior completo ou cursando na área de Tecnologia.

• Metodologias Ágeis e DevOps: Conhecimento e experiência comprovada em equipes com metodologias ágeis e práticas de DevOps.

• Linguagens de Programação: Conhecimento sólido em linguagens como Java, Python, jQuery, JavaScript, HTML, Angular e PL-SQL.

• Cloud: Conhecimento em plataformas Cloud (AWS, Azure e GCP).

• Arquitetura de Software: Conhecimento em arquitetura de software, incluindo princípios SOLID, DDD (Domain-Driven Design) e boas práticas de desenvolvimento.

• Microsserviços: Conhecimento em arquitetura de Microsserviços.

• Containers: Experiência com Containers e Orquestração de Containers (Docker, Kubernetes).

• Experiência com Chatbots: Experiência em linguagens de programação relevantes para o entendimento do código subjacente de chatbots, facilitando ajustes e colaboração com o time de desenvolvimento.


Informações adicionais


Aqui nós somos humanos, somos digitais, somos Verity!


Tudo o que fazemos se baseia em nossos 8 POWER PRINCIPLES:

  • Amar tecnologia;
  • Assumir grandes responsabilidades;
  • Cultivar relações de confiança por meio da transparência;
  • Dar atenção e ser orientado pela necessidade e experiência do cliente;
  • Encarar desafios de forma ágil;
  • Colaborar entre pessoas e equipes;
  • Encorajar a autonomia consciente;
  • Atingir resultados de forma consciente.


É assim que criamos experiências inovadoras para o mundo digital, inspirando protagonismo e gerando resultados incríveis aos nossos clientes, sempre focados em metodologia, tecnologia e pessoas.


Fomos certificados como uma das melhores empresas para se trabalhar pelo Great Place To Work, e a cada dia criamos ações que melhoram ainda mais o ambiente de trabalho, aqui na Verity você tem:

  • Vale refeição
  • Vale alimentação
  • Auxílio home office
  • Assistência médica
  • Assistência odontológica
  • Seguro de vida
  • Parcerias de descontos
  • Convênios em estabelecimentos e instituições de ensino
  • Treinamentos de agilidade recorrentes
  • Verity Learning
  • Intervalo Verity
  • #VerityComVocê


E aí, topa criar experiências inovadoras para o mundo digital?


Etapas do processo

  • Etapa 1: Cadastro
  • Etapa 2: Entrevista RH
  • Etapa 3: Entrevista Tech
  • Etapa 4: Entrevista Final
  • Etapa 5: Processo de Contratação
  • Etapa 6: Contratação


Somos uma consultoria de Transformação e Engenharia Digital


A Verity é uma consultoria de Transformação e Engenharia Digital.


Estruturamos tecnologia para funcionar, escalar e gerar valor real. Atuamos na Modernização de Aplicações, decisões críticas de Arquitetura, Engenharia de Software e Dados, Experiência Digital e orquestração de processos com Inteligência Artificial.


Com o Verity Quantum®, nosso orquestrador de IA, conectamos engenharia, plataformas e operações para modernizar legados, otimizar código e acelerar decisões com impacto direto no negócio.


Há 16 anos, trabalhamos ao lado de mais de 100 empresas líderes em seus mercados, nos setores financeiro, saúde, varejo, indústria e serviços, transformando estratégia em soluções tecnológicas que geram eficiência, escala e vantagem competitiva.


Desde 2019, somos certificados como Great Place to Work - GPTW, reconhecimento que reforça nossa cultura baseada em transparência, confiança e compromisso real com a entrega.



INICIATIVAS VERITY_

Aqui na Verity temos diversas ações que estimulam a troca de conhecimento:



FAZER O MELHOR E O QUE É CERTO, SEMPRE_

Esse é o mantra que nos guia da modernização à aceleração digital para ofereceremos soluções de ponta a ponta da jornada de tecnologia.


VAGA PERFEITA_

Ser Veriter é ter coragem para evoluir, pensar diferente e contribuir com insights antes nunca imaginados. Aqui na Verity você tem vale refeição e alimentação, assistência médica e odontológica, seguro de vida, parceria com a Total Pass para cuidar da saúde, auxílio home office, acesso a cursos para desenvolvimento, day off no aniversário e outras iniciativas que não param de surgir.

vagas.title: Senior Backend Engineer – DevOps & Cloud Exposure
vagas.description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Backend Engineer – DevOps & Cloud Exposure em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We're looking for a Senior Backend Engineer with strong Java Spring experience. This is not a standard backend role — it's designed for engineers who are technically broad, adaptable, and comfortable operating across development, operations, and cloud environments.


At Qubika , we design, develop, and deploy custom software solutions for organizations making an impact through technology.


What you'll do:

  • Develop and maintain backend solutions using Java Spring / Spring Boot
  • Support applications deployed in Kubernetes and AWS-based cloud environments
  • Maintain and troubleshoot Jenkins pipelines and GitLab CI/CD workflows
  • Contribute to scripting and automation tasks as needed (Python or similar)
  • Collaborate with infrastructure and DevOps teams on platform-related activities
  • Adapt to changing client priorities and a broad range of technical requests

What we're looking for

  • Strong Java Spring / Spring Boot experience
  • Practical knowledge of Kubernetes (clusters, pods, deployments, troubleshooting)
  • Familiarity with AWS services: EKS, IAM, Parameter Store, Secrets Manager, Security Groups
  • Experience with Jenkins pipelines and GitLab CI/CD
  • Basic understanding of Terraform and IaC concepts
  • Scripting skills in Python or equivalent
  • Resilience and adaptability in dynamic, fast-changing environments

Good to have

  • Previous experience in the financial services industry
  • Background in mixed roles combining development and operational tasks

What we offer:

  • A creative working environment with a positive and collaborative atmosphere within an open-minded community.
  • A senior team that offers mentorship opportunities to help you excel in your career.
  • Various benefits include flexible work hours, ongoing skill development, language lessons, travel opportunities, engaging activities, expert talks, and more.

About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L


Role Overview:

We’re hiring finance professionals who know AP, AR, accounting close, or finance systems inside-out — and want to help shape how AI understands finance workflows.

In this role, you’ll use your real-world experience with QuickBooks, Bill.com, and Concur to create realistic finance scenarios, evaluate AI outputs, and improve the accuracy of next-generation AI systems.


What does day-to-day life look like?

  • Create finance workflow prompts and real-world accounting scenarios

  • Help improve AI performance across finance operations and controls


We're looking for:

Professionals with hands-on experience in one or more of the following:

  • Accounts Payable
  • Accounts Receivable
  • Accounting & Month-End Close
  • Controller / Finance Management
  • Finance Systems Administration


Requirements:

  • 4–12 years of finance/accounting experience
  • Strong working knowledge of QuickBooks, Bill.com, and/or Concur
  • Understanding of US GAAP and finance controls
  • Excellent written communication skills
  • Comfortable using AI tools like ChatGPT or Claude
  • CPA/CMA preferred (required for Controller-level roles)


Nice to have:

  • Experience with AI evaluation, RLHF, or LLM projects
  • ERP migrations, multi-entity or multi-currency exposure
  • Basic Python or SQL skills

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Work at the intersection of Finance + AI
  • Influence how AI systems reason about accounting workflows


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required: 40 hours per week with overlap of 4 hours with PST.
  • Engagement Type: Contractor assignment (no medical/paid leave)
  • Duration of contract : 4 weeks; (expected start date is next week)

Confira esta oportunidade para Full Stack Engineer em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Senior Software Engineer (Full Stack)

Location: Remote

Experience: 7+ Years


About the Role

We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer (Full Stack) to join a high-performing engineering team focused on delivering exceptional customer experiences and building scalable software solutions. This role offers the opportunity to work on complex technical challenges, contribute to strategic initiatives, and collaborate with cross-functional teams in a fast-paced environment.

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will serve as both a hands-on developer and technical leader, helping drive engineering excellence, mentoring team members, and contributing to the evolution of the platform and architecture.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, test, and maintain scalable, high-quality software solutions.
  • Build and enhance customer-facing web applications and services.
  • Collaborate with product managers, designers, and engineers to deliver business-critical features.
  • Participate in technical design discussions and contribute to architectural decisions.
  • Review code and provide constructive feedback to peers.
  • Mentor engineers through collaboration, pair programming, and knowledge sharing.
  • Deploy, monitor, and support applications in production environments.
  • Continuously evaluate and adopt modern technologies and engineering best practices.

Required Qualifications

  • 7+ years of professional software development experience.
  • Strong proficiency in Java and/or Kotlin.
  • Experience working in Ruby on Rails environments.
  • Expertise in JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML, and CSS.
  • Strong experience with React and related front-end technologies.
  • Experience with Node.js and modern development tooling.
  • Familiarity with RESTful APIs, Git, version control systems, and deployment processes.
  • Understanding of GraphQL, event-driven architectures, and database design concepts.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration abilities.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Kafka or other event-streaming platforms.
  • Experience working with Elixir.
  • Experience decomposing monolithic applications into microservices.
  • Familiarity with distributed systems and service-oriented architectures.
  • Experience building scalable applications in cloud environments.

Technical Environment

  • Java
  • Kotlin
  • TypeScript
  • React
  • GraphQL
  • Kafka
  • AWS Lambda
  • PostgreSQL
  • DynamoDB
  • Ruby on Rails
  • Elixir

vagas.title: Especialista em Engenharia - Sistemas de Potência
vagas.description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Especialista em Engenharia - Sistemas de Potência em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.
  • Sobre a SolutionMall

A SolutionMall é uma plataforma global B2B de entrega de produtos e soluções integradas, atendendo necessidades em energia, sistemas elétricos, infraestrutura, telecomunicações, data centers, instalações industriais, equipamentos técnicos e projetos institucionais.

Diferente das plataformas tradicionais que apenas exibem produtos, a SolutionMall se concentra na entrega estruturada de soluções. Apoiamos clientes na clarificação de requisitos, seleção de produtos, coordenação técnica, suporte a RFQ, coordenação de cotações, acompanhamento de entrega e suporte de projetos de longo prazo.

No setor de energia e sistemas elétricos, a SolutionMall pode apoiar necessidades relacionadas a:

Sistemas de energia e distribuição elétrica

Equipamentos elétricos industriais e comerciais

UPS e sistemas de energia de backup

Baterias e soluções de armazenamento de energia

Cabos, conectores e materiais elétricos auxiliares

Sistemas de aterramento e proteção contra descargas atmosféricas

Equipamentos para telecomunicações e data centers

Instrumentos de teste, medição e manutenção elétrica

Soluções de energia para instalações industriais e comerciais

Pacotes integrados de soluções para projetos de energia e infraestrutura

  • Visão Geral da Função

Estamos procurando um Engenheiro de Sistemas de Energia – Brasil para apoiar o desenvolvimento técnico e a coordenação de projetos da SolutionMall no mercado brasileiro.

Esta é uma função flexível baseada em cooperação, adequada para profissionais com experiência em sistemas de energia, engenharia elétrica, distribuição elétrica, UPS, baterias, aterramento, proteção contra descargas atmosféricas, cabos, telecomunicações, data centers, instalações industriais, manutenção elétrica ou projetos de infraestrutura.

A função tem como foco compreender necessidades técnicas dos clientes, apoiar a seleção de produtos, revisar requisitos de projetos, auxiliar no desenvolvimento de RFQ, coordenar informações técnicas e ajudar a SolutionMall a promover soluções adequadas de energia e sistemas elétricos no Brasil.

Não se trata apenas de uma função operacional ou de manutenção diária. É uma função B2B de suporte técnico, coordenação de soluções e desenvolvimento de oportunidades, focada em clientes industriais, empreiteiras, distribuidores, integradores, empresas de telecomunicações, data centers, instalações comerciais e projetos de infraestrutura.

O candidato ideal poderá apoiar em:

Análise de requisitos técnicos

Suporte à seleção de produtos

Coordenação de RFQ e cotações

Comunicação de soluções de energia

Suporte técnico para sistemas elétricos

Coordenação com distribuidores e contratantes

Feedback do mercado local

Apoio ao avanço de projetos

Desenvolvimento de cooperação regional de longo prazo

  • Principais Responsabilidades

Suporte Técnico e Análise de Requisitos

Apoiar a SolutionMall na análise e esclarecimento de requisitos técnicos para oportunidades de energia e sistemas elétricos no Brasil, incluindo:

Empresas industriais

Empresas de energia e infraestrutura

Operadoras de telecomunicações

Data centers e salas técnicas

Edifícios comerciais

Empreiteiras elétricas

Empresas de engenharia e construção

Integradores de sistemas

Distribuidores de equipamentos elétricos

Equipes de compras de projetos institucionais e privados

Ajudar a compreender requisitos do cliente, cenários de aplicação, condições do local, capacidade necessária, especificações técnicas, expectativas de segurança, necessidades de instalação, manutenção e prazos de entrega.

Apoiar a SolutionMall na seleção de produtos e soluções adequados para projetos de energia, distribuição elétrica, backup de energia, aterramento, proteção contra descargas atmosféricas, cabos e infraestrutura técnica no Brasil.

Suporte a Soluções de Energia e Sistemas Elétricos

Apoiar a comunicação técnica e a promoção dos recursos da SolutionMall, incluindo:

Equipamentos de distribuição elétrica

UPS e sistemas de energia de backup

Baterias e soluções de armazenamento de energia

Cabos elétricos e materiais auxiliares

Sistemas de aterramento

Sistemas de proteção contra descargas atmosféricas

Equipamentos para data centers e salas técnicas

Instrumentos de teste e medição elétrica

Soluções de energia para telecomunicações

Soluções elétricas para instalações industriais e comerciais

Produtos de suporte, instalação e manutenção para projetos

Ajudar clientes e parceiros a selecionar produtos e soluções adequados com base no cenário de aplicação, capacidade do sistema, condições do local, orçamento, segurança, manutenção, vida útil e requisitos técnicos do projeto.

Acompanhamento de RFQ e Coordenação de Projetos

Acompanhar informações de projetos, necessidades dos clientes, requisitos elétricos, condições do local, especificações técnicas, orçamento, prazos de entrega, RFQs e cotações.

Ajudar a converter discussões técnicas iniciais em RFQs mais claros e requisitos práticos de cotação.

Coordenar com as equipes da SolutionMall, fornecedores, fabricantes, distribuidores, contratantes, integradores e clientes para avançar oportunidades qualificadas.

Apoiar a seleção de produtos, esclarecimento técnico, comunicação de cotações, verificação de requisitos, confirmação de soluções, discussões comerciais e acompanhamento de pedidos quando necessário.

Feedback de Mercado e Coordenação Técnica

Ajudar a SolutionMall a fortalecer seu entendimento do mercado brasileiro de sistemas de energia, equipamentos elétricos e infraestrutura técnica.

Obrigatórios

Mínimo de 3 anos de experiência em uma ou mais das seguintes áreas:

Engenharia elétrica

Sistemas de energia

Distribuição elétrica

UPS e sistemas de energia de backup

Baterias ou armazenamento de energia

Instalações elétricas industriais ou comerciais

Projetos de telecomunicações ou data centers

Aterramento e proteção contra descargas atmosféricas

Cabos elétricos e materiais auxiliares

Instrumentos de teste e medição elétrica

Suporte técnico para projetos elétricos

Coordenação técnica de projetos

Acompanhamento de RFQ e cotações

Cooperação com contratantes, integradores ou distribuidores

Bom conhecimento de produtos elétricos, sistemas de energia ou soluções de infraestrutura, com capacidade para compreender necessidades do cliente, requisitos técnicos, seleção de produtos e coordenação de cotações.

Boas habilidades de comunicação e capacidade de coordenar com clientes, contratantes, distribuidores, integradores, empresas de engenharia ou equipes de projetos no Brasil.

Proficiência profissional em português. Capacidade de comunicação em inglês será considerada uma vantagem.

Preferenciais

Recursos existentes de clientes, contratantes, distribuidores ou canais técnicos no Brasil

Experiência em projetos de energia, telecomunicações, data centers, edifícios comerciais ou instalações industriais

Experiência em acompanhamento de RFQ, esclarecimento técnico, seleção de produtos, coordenação de cotações ou suporte técnico-comercial

Familiaridade com o ecossistema brasileiro de compras de equipamentos elétricos e soluções de energia

Experiência com UPS, baterias, distribuição elétrica, aterramento, proteção contra descargas atmosféricas, cabos ou equipamentos de medição será uma vantagem importante

Conhecimento de requisitos locais de certificação, importação, instalação ou conformidade elétrica será valorizado

  • Modelo de Trabalho

Esta função segue um modelo flexível de cooperação técnica e desenvolvimento de negócios.

As principais áreas de trabalho incluem:

Análise de requisitos técnicos

Comunicação de produtos e soluções

Suporte a RFQ e cotações

Coordenação com clientes e projetos

Coordenação com distribuidores e contratantes

Feedback do mercado local

Apoio ao avanço de projetos

Desenvolvimento de cooperação regional de longo prazo

Para candidatos adequados, a SolutionMall pode oferecer oportunidades de cooperação de longo prazo no Brasil, com base em recursos de clientes verificados, avanço de projetos, contribuição técnica e resultados reais de negócios.

Esta função é especialmente adequada para profissionais que já tenham experiência ou acesso a clientes, contratantes, distribuidores, integradores ou canais de projetos em energia, sistemas elétricos, telecomunicações, data centers, instalações industriais ou infraestrutura técnica no Brasil.

  • Remuneração e Benefícios de Cooperação

A SolutionMall oferece um modelo de cooperação vinculado ao desempenho e baseado na contribuição técnica e comercial real, incluindo:

Contribuição de suporte técnico

Criação de oportunidades qualificadas

Avanço de RFQ

Avanço de projetos

Resultados de pedidos e negócios

Valor de cooperação de longo prazo

Os termos detalhados de cooperação podem ser discutidos de acordo com a experiência do candidato, capacidade técnica, recursos de clientes, capacidade regional, relacionamentos comerciais, idioma e contribuição para projetos.

  • Como se Candidatar

Candidate-se com uma breve nota destacando sua experiência relevante em:

Engenharia elétrica

Sistemas de energia

UPS ou energia de backup

Distribuição elétrica

Baterias ou armazenamento de energia

Aterramento e proteção contra descargas atmosféricas

Cabos e materiais elétricos

Equipamentos de teste e medição

Projetos de telecomunicações ou data centers

Instalações industriais ou comerciais

Coordenação técnica de projetos

Acompanhamento de RFQ e cotações

vagas.title: Account Manager
vagas.description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Account Manager em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We're hiring account managers who'd rather grow a customer than keep one.


R$181,130 to R$524,000 CAD | Remote Brazil | Unlimited PTO


WeTransact is looking for an Account Manager to join our growing team.


Your Mission

  • Own the account after go-live : You're the customer's main point of contact once they're live and transactable, and you're accountable for their revenue growth on the marketplace.
  • Advise on the right path : You assess where each ISV is and recommend the program or plan that moves them forward, from IP Co-sell eligibility to Certified Software status to new channels.
  • Drive adoption into revenue : You implement the work that converts a live listing into transactions: CRM integration, Crossbeam setup, sales comp parity, and Microsoft incentives.
  • Challenge the customer : When results aren't there, you challenge their structure and bring them a revised plan rather than a status update.
  • Navigating the Microsoft Field : You connect customers to the right AEs and PDMs and build the co-sell motion that moves deals.
  • Compounding with AI : AI is part of your daily workflow across research, QBR prep, and pipeline. This isn't a perk we offer, it's how we operate.


What We're Looking For

  • +4 years in sales at a B2B tech company. Quota-carrying, with a track record of growing accounts. CSM or account management background is a plus, not a substitute.
  • You think in revenue. Adoption is the means, not the metric.
  • English fluent. You present to Customer or Microsoft stakeholders in English without prep.
  • Daily, instinctive use of AI tools.
  • Comfortable being the one who tells a customer their approach isn't working — and what to do instead.
  • You manage 30+ accounts without dropping the ball.


What You Get

  • Unlimited PTO.
  • AI-first culture across the business.
  • Direct access to Microsoft teams and the partner ecosystem most companies spend years trying to reach.
  • Real ownership of a revenue book, measured in outcomes not activity.
  • Path to senior measured in quarters, not years.
  • Global team in more than 12 countries with a strong culture.


About WeTransact

Most companies in our space raise tens of millions and burn it chasing this market. We bootstrapped, turned a profit, and built the software that 500+ companies now use to sell through Microsoft. Titles don't matter here. Accountability does, and so does winning as a team.

We're hiring account managers who'd rather grow a customer than keep one.


R$181,130 to R$524,000 CAD | Remote Brazil | Unlimited PTO


WeTransact is looking for an Account Manager to join our growing team.


Your Mission

  • Own the account after go-live : You're the customer's main point of contact once they're live and transactable, and you're accountable for their revenue growth on the marketplace.
  • Advise on the right path : You assess where each ISV is and recommend the program or plan that moves them forward, from IP Co-sell eligibility to Certified Software status to new channels.

  • Compounding with AI : AI is part of your daily workflow across research, QBR prep, and pipeline. This isn't a perk we offer, it's how we operate.


What We're Looking For

  • +4 years in sales at a B2B tech company. Quota-carrying, with a track record of growing accounts. CSM or account management background is a plus, not a substitute.
  • You think in revenue. Adoption is the means, not the metric.
  • English fluent. You present to Customer or Microsoft stakeholders in English without prep.
  • Daily, instinctive use of AI tools.

What You Get

  • Unlimited PTO.

  • Direct access to Microsoft teams and the partner ecosystem most companies spend years trying to reach.
  • Real ownership of a revenue book, measured in outcomes not activity.
  • Path to senior measured in quarters, not years.

Most companies in our space raise tens of millions and burn it chasing this market. We bootstrapped, turned a profit, and built the software that 500+ companies now use to sell through Microsoft. Titles don't matter here. Accountability does, and so does winning as a team.

Creative Video Editor - DTC Brand


Location: Fully Remote (must be based in LATAM)

Job Type: Full-Time


Create scroll-stopping content for a scaling DTC brand. We need a performance-focused video editor who can turn raw footage into high-converting ads and social content - with creative freedom and direct feedback loops on what's working.


About Uproot Clean

Uproot Clean is a fast-growing, eco-friendly pet care brand expanding across major retailers like Walmart, Target, and Chewy. Our marketing team is scaling rapidly, and we're looking for a video editor who wants to grow their skills in performance marketing while building a long-term role with a mission-driven company.


The Role

You'll be our go-to editor for short-form video content that drives sales—think Facebook/Instagram ads, TikTok content, and social clips. You'll work with a steady flow of creator and product footage, turning it into thumb-stopping content that performs. This isn't agency churn-and-burn; you'll see what converts, iterate based on data, and refine your craft with real-time feedback.

Video Editing & Production

Schedule

  • Paid time off
  • Flex days. Enjoy an extra quarterly day off to unwind and recharge energies whenever you desire.
  • Professional development - opportunities to learn and grow with the business


Ready to Apply?

If you love creating high-performing video content and have a portfolio that showcases your work, we want to see it. Apply now.

Note: Applications without portfolio samples will not be reviewed.

Estamos em busca de um Engenheiro DevOps talentoso e proativo para integrar nossa equipe de arquitetura de soluções. • Domínio avançado de Jenkins (Pipelines as Code, Shared Libraries).

• Experiência prática com Docker e ferramentas de orquestração.

• Conhecimento em administração de bancos de dados MySQL (backups, otimização e migrações).

• Capacidade de desenvolver scripts de automação em Python ou Bash.

• Experiência com serviços da AWS (EC2, S3, RDS, IAM) para suporte a ambientes híbridos.

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Contract: Permanent / Freelance

Experience Level: Senior

Language: English and Portuguese



Mission Overview

We are looking for a Senior Warehouse Automation Specialist to lead the design, implementation, and optimization of advanced automation solutions within distribution and logistics environments.

You will act as a key System Engineer , bridging operational needs with cutting-edge technologies such as robotics, RTLS (Real-Time Locating Systems), and machine vision systems to drive efficiency, accuracy, and scalability.

System Design & Implementation

Maintenance & Troubleshooting

Safety & Compliance

  • Ensure all systems comply with safety standards and industry regulations
  • Contribute to improving workplace safety and ergonomics


Required Qualifications

  • 7+ years of experience in warehouse automation, system engineering, or industrial automation
  • Proven experience with RTLS (Real-Time Locating Systems)
  • Strong background in machine vision systems
  • Hands-on experience with:
  • WMS / WES systems
  • Robotics, AGVs, or automated material handling systems
  • Solid understanding of electro-mechanical systems, sensors, and control systems
  • Willingness and ability to travel regularly (nationally and/or internationally) to support project deployments and client sites


Nice to Have

  • Experience in project management (PMP or equivalent is a plus)
  • Knowledge of programming/scripting (Python or similar)
  • Experience with data analysis and performance optimization
  • Background in industrial engineering, robotics, or logistics systems
  • Portuguese knowledge


Key Skills

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities
  • System-level thinking and architecture mindset
  • Ability to work in complex, fast-paced environments
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills

vagas.title: Customer Service Representative
vagas.description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Customer Service Representative em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Customer Service Representative

Location: Fully Remote (LATAM)

Job Type: Full-Time


Love helping people and solving problems fast? We’re looking for someone who can deliver high-quality customer experiences at scale, while keeping every interaction clear, human, and efficient. This is a hands-on role where responsiveness, empathy, and execution matter every day.


About Uproot Clean

Uproot Clean is a fast-growing, performance-driven consumer brand built for pet owners. We create high-performance, eco-friendly cleaning solutions designed to make life easier without compromising sustainability.

Customer experience is at the core of our brand. Every interaction matters, and how we show up for our customers directly impacts retention, trust, and growth.


The Role

This is a high-volume, execution-focused role. You will manage day-to-day customer interactions across multiple channels, ensuring fast, accurate, and human responses.

You are not just answering tickets—you are shaping how customers experience the brand.


This Role Is For You If:

  • You communicate clearly, empathetically, and efficiently
  • You are comfortable handling high volumes of customer interactions
  • You stay calm under pressure and solve problems quickly
  • You pay attention to details and don’t let things slip
  • You take ownership of issues until they are fully resolved
  • You are comfortable working independently in a remote environment


This Role Is NOT For You If:

  • You avoid dealing with difficult customers
  • You prioritize speed over accuracy and quality
  • You are not comfortable multitasking across platforms


What You'll Do

Customer Support Execution

  • Manage and respond to customer inquiries via email and support platforms
  • Ensure fast, accurate, and high-quality responses at scale
  • Maintain a consistent and professional brand voice

Social Media Support

  • Respond to DMs and comments across platforms like Instagram, Facebook, and TikTok
  • Engage with the community while maintaining brand tone and consistency

Order & Refund Management

  • Process order changes, cancellations, refunds, and exchanges
  • Ensure all actions follow company policies and are accurately executed

Conflict Resolution

  • Handle complaints with empathy and clarity
  • Investigate issues thoroughly and provide complete resolutions

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Share customer feedback and recurring issues with internal teams
  • Help identify patterns that can improve product or operations


Requirements

Must have:

  • Experience in customer service (ecommerce or DTC preferred)
  • +1 years of experience using Shopify
  • Strong written communication skills in English
  • Experience handling social media interactions is a strong plus
  • High attention to detail and ability to multitask
  • Comfortable working in fast-paced environments

Work Requirements

⏰ Schedule: Monday-Friday, 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM EST

Workspace: Fixed, professional setup required (stable internet + backup plan)


Benefits & Compensation

  • Fully remote - work from anywhere in LATAM.
  • Monthly salary: $3,000 - $4,000 USD
  • Paid time off
  • Flex days. Enjoy an extra quarterly day off to unwind and recharge energies whenever you desire
  • Ownership & autonomy - trusted to build and execute strategy
  • Professional development - opportunities to learn and grow with the business

Ready to Apply?

If you care about delivering great customer experiences and want to be part of a fast-moving team, apply now.

Fully remote within Brazil
